Game Name: Magicians need to learn healing magic
Detailed Description: This is a world where magic and technology coexist. The protagonist was originally a magician. In order to cure his illness, he learned to heal magic with his mother. In the game, there are plots of the protagonist interacting with different characters and items, battle maps, different conversations. The protagonist originally intended to go to Wang Capital for a magic test. After talking with his mother, he found that he should learn to cure magic. The first chapter of the battle scene will let the protagonist fight against monsters such as Slime and bats. The three characters of the team are magic envoys, soldiers and sacrifices. The game is mainly based on the plot, including dialogue and novels.

Detailed Description:
The Nightmare Begins is a survival horror game set in a richly detailed steampunk world. Players take on the role of an experienced supernatural detective tasked with unraveling a series of enigmatic events and sinister cases that plague a dark and immersive city.

The game features meticulously designed environments, ranging from decaying streets to ancient, crumbling buildings, each brimming with atmospheric tension. As you explore these locales, you will uncover hidden clues, solve intricate puzzles, and face off against a variety of supernatural threats in strategic combat.

The Nightmare Begins combines intense exploration, challenging puzzles, and strategic combat with a crucial item management mechanic. Players must carefully manage and transport items to solve challenges and survive the horrors that lie ahead. The gripping narrative unfolds as you confront the unknown, uncover dark secrets, and piece together the truth behind the events threatening to engulf the city in chaos.

Prepare for a chilling and unforgettable journey through a world teeming with mystery and danger in The Nightmare Begins.

The most notorious among them were the Knights of Virtue. The Knights of Virtue seized the famed Fountain of Elovelle and built a fortress around it. Ferality spreads throughout the realm.This is the story of one who would try to heal the broken heart of this city.And how I stopped her…

Game Name: SORROW: TALES FROM A WORSE WORLD
Detailed Description: SORROW is a third person survival game set 5 days after the outbreak of a brutal parasitic entity. It follows the perspective of a survivor who has survived the initial chaos, and now has to survive the harsh reality of a American continent after humanity's dominance has been tipped.Your main objective is to survive by any means possible, including murder. The creatures that you once called a human didn't lose their intelligence, and will be able to flank you, dodge your attacks, and even vault over obstacles you do. However, it is best to remember one thing, nothing lasts forever. Your randomized character will inevitably meet their end.Features:Real life small towns from across the US in different regions, with a occasional (fictional) city.randomized interiors for each house/building. no two are the same!A choice between stealth or action at the start of every playthrough.Basic survival mechanics alongside a infection meter that fills up when being attacked, don't let it get too high or you'll turn.Completely randomized characters, you could have a man who was keen on melee one playthrough while another could be better at stealth.A radio system that chronicles the downfall of civilizationHouse securing system, barricade windows and block doors to delay the attacks of the creatures. (only on houses in rural areas)When your character dies, the next character you create will have a higher chance of following in their footsteps.Multiplayer is planned however won't come until after story mode.

Detailed Description: OverviewIn Avalon Lost, you embark on a legendary quest mixed with danger and adventure following the destruction of the town you once called home. During this quest, you will be met with trials that test your will to survive and force you to rise above the challenges that threaten the realm of Albion, all while discovering numerous stories and tales befitting the Arthurian mythos.Avalon Lost is a Sandbox Survival Game with an emphasis on player agency, through the use of RPG elements, customizable equipment and a plethora of skills, heroic points, and statistics to ensure that you can embark on the adventure that you wish to have, rather than to have everything predefined for you.Game Features:Explore the realm of Albion, once the proud region of King Arthur, Camelot and the Knights of the Round Table. Misfortune and suffering have fallen upon the kingdom following Mordred's ascension to the throne.Venture deep into the mythology of the Arthurian legends and uncover new stories and mysteries that led to the events that fell upon this once beautiful realm.Progress throughout the land and create your own story, growing from that of a small township peasant to that of an adventurer, or legends beyond. Promoting character development where choices matter, actions have consequences and players hold agency in the type of legend they wish to become.Rich levels of character progression expressed through over 100 skills, each with multiple active and passive abilities to utilize, countless types of equipment that allows for customization and unique bonuses to further expand upon character builds, and heroic points to emphasize additional means of character growth that serves as a foundational bonus.Build and establish your own encampments and domains. Raising the banner of your claim inside of the realm and defend it with sharpened steel or potent magic.Discover hidden ruins, dungeons and caverns that hide valuable wealth but promise terrible dangers to those foolhardy enough to venture through them.Harvest and gather valuable resources and materials from the landscape and the world around you to support you on your quest, and further solidify the strength of your domain.Venture through thirteen unique biomes, each with their own secrets, wonders and dangers alike. The realm itself is alive through the use of dynamic weather and an ever-shaping world through both action and inaction of the many factions, lordships and groups within.Face off against countless foes and monsters alike, spanning across numerous biomes and covered by the looming threat of King Mordred and his armies. Boasting over a hundred unique types of enemies and foes throughout the realm.Stand United or Stake Your Claim as you seek your own fortunes within Albion amongst many other players who seek to do the same within private or publicly hosted servers upwards to 50 players at a time. Though you always have a choice to venture through Albion alone if you so desire.Rise up to the Legend through numerous custom difficulty options and presets that not only make selecting various challenges within gameplay easier, but it allows for you to dramatically change your gameplay experience - whether you prefer challenging combat, gritty survival, or an opportunity to venture into the unknown and chart your own path. The difficulty settings are designed to allow YOU to choose the type of adventure you want to have, and to always have more options to explore in the future when you choose to return to Albion.=================================================================NarrativeWith the decisive battle of Camlann concluded, the usurper, Mordred, pressed forward and reduced Camelot to cinders and ash. It was upon this desecrated ground that he ascended to the throne of Albion and set forth his tyrannical edicts. Over the coming years, the realm was sieged from beast and brigand alike. The commonwealth, once able to live peaceful solitary lives in their townships, struggled to find safe havens and nervously prayed for to see another bright sunrise. Fortunately, life was simple for you. Days would go by as you explored the neighboring forests for food and local game, and occasionally would spend time at the local tavern when a hunting trip seemed fortuitous enough. It was during one such day that you had ventured into the forests on the outskirts of town and discovered a strange metallic fragment bathed in a faint amethyst light. Curious as to its value and qualities, you met with the local blacksmith and had him appraise it for you later that day.With a metallic thung that resonated throughout the hovel, the metal seemed to reverberate against even the faintest of taps from a hammer. It was as if it was warded or enchanted in some way, but neither the smith nor you could tell much from this fragment, but one thing was certain, it was forged from some type of mineral that you had never seen before. From that day onward, the winds began to change around the town. The forest grew more oppressive and the landscape around the outskirts became even more restless. It was as if the land itself responded towards your actions, or more specifically, your discovery.Merely a weeks' time from when you visited the blacksmith, you settled down to rest in the earlier part of the evening only to be forcibly awoken to the sounds of screams. Darting to the nearby window, an orange blaze reflected upon the glass as trails of smoke coated the sky in a thickened obsidian ash.Life had been simple for you...=== Under Construction ===
Short Description: With the defeat of King Arthur and his knights, Mordred ascended to the throne atop the ruins of Camelot. The tyrant subjected Albion to chaos and savagery under his bloody conquest. But a glimmer of hope remains within a fragment of the legendary blade that has the power to change destiny.

Detailed Description: OverviewThe Planetologist is a pixel art, local multiplayer co-op, top-down shooter. Play as a scientist exploring the galaxy aboard your ship, battling a mysterious and deadly infection that threatens to wipe out all life in the universe.SynopsisAs a planetologist or planetary ecologist, your mission involves traveling to various planets, studying their diverse ecosystems and documenting your discoveries. Upon reaching your current destination, you encounter what seems to be some kind of pathogen that can infect all forms of life and somehow spread to other planets light-years away.  You realize that, by scanning this planet with one of your devices, you can trace the planet that infected this one. After some calculations, you estimate that the main source of the infection should be ten planets away. The universe's only hope now is to locate and eradicate this infection at its source.Main Features  3 different game modes (Story, Survival and Extraction)... but maybe more! 10 unlockable worlds with stunning backgrounds and immersive environments. Level design based on each world's unique size, gravity, biome and atmosphere. Procedurally generated world layouts, ensuring a fresh experience on each visit. 12 unlockable characters, each with unique playstyles and abilities. Character leveling system with 17 different skills.  12 unlockable robot companions to add utility, support or raw firepower to your party. 3 unlockable ships for you to buy, upgrade and equip with special power-ups and weapons. Local coop multiplayer up to 12 players... if you find a way to hook up that many controllers! Steam achievements. Based on pixel art by Penusbmic and other awesome artists. Game Modes Story Mode Find the origin of the infection that's consuming civilizations and worlds. Scan infected planets to locate hives, abandoned equipment, bosses and other survivors to join your party. Buy ships and equipment to trace the infection to its very core and eradicate it from the universe. Estimated play time: 14 hours to complete all 4 scan missions in all 10 worlds and a lot more to satisfy your greed for experience and equipment. Survival Endless ModeYour ship failed on you and your only alternative is to get beamed down to the closest planet and survive as long as possible while battling infected critters... just for fun. I mean, you know you're doomed anyway, right?  Estimated play time: Depends a lot on your thirst for experience and brutal carnage.Survival Extraction ModeSame as Survival Endless, except someone might actually bother to rescue you. The only caveat is you need to be at the right place at the right time or else your galactic-uber might rather "take another trip". Estimated play time: 5 hours to complete all worlds with a single character. 60 hours to complete all worlds with all characters. Short Description: The top-down shooter you want to play ;)
About the Game: OverviewThe Planetologist is a pixel art, local multiplayer co-op, top-down shooter. Play as a scientist exploring the galaxy aboard your ship, battling a mysterious and deadly infection that threatens to wipe out all life in the universe.SynopsisAs a planetologist or planetary ecologist, your mission involves traveling to various planets, studying their diverse ecosystems and documenting your discoveries. Upon reaching your current destination, you encounter what seems to be some kind of pathogen that can infect all forms of life and somehow spread to other planets light-years away.  You realize that, by scanning this planet with one of your devices, you can trace the planet that infected this one. After some calculations, you estimate that the main source of the infection should be ten planets away. The universe's only hope now is to locate and eradicate this infection at its source.Main Features  3 different game modes (Story, Survival and Extraction)... but maybe more! 10 unlockable worlds with stunning backgrounds and immersive environments. Level design based on each world's unique size, gravity, biome and atmosphere. Procedurally generated world layouts, ensuring a fresh experience on each visit. 12 unlockable characters, each with unique playstyles and abilities. Character leveling system with 17 different skills.  12 unlockable robot companions to add utility, support or raw firepower to your party. 3 unlockable ships for you to buy, upgrade and equip with special power-ups and weapons. Local coop multiplayer up to 12 players... if you find a way to hook up that many controllers! Steam achievements. Based on pixel art by Penusbmic and other awesome artists. Game Modes Story Mode Find the origin of the infection that's consuming civilizations and worlds. Scan infected planets to locate hives, abandoned equipment, bosses and other survivors to join your party. Buy ships and equipment to trace the infection to its very core and eradicate it from the universe. Estimated play time: 14 hours to complete all 4 scan missions in all 10 worlds and a lot more to satisfy your greed for experience and equipment. Survival Endless ModeYour ship failed on you and your only alternative is to get beamed down to the closest planet and survive as long as possible while battling infected critters... just for fun. I mean, you know you're doomed anyway, right?  Estimated play time: Depends a lot on your thirst for experience and brutal carnage.Survival Extraction ModeSame as Survival Endless, except someone might actually bother to rescue you. The only caveat is you need to be at the right place at the right time or else your galactic-uber might rather "take another trip". Estimated play time: 5 hours to complete all worlds with a single character. 60 hours to complete all worlds with all characters. Detailed Description: Sword fight with killer robots in VR!Watch as limbs fly off from a single cut of your energy blade!You are Blink, a teleporting robot who is the newest “looprunner” gladiator to compete in the Crashloop, a deadly roguelike tournament to the death. Detailed Description: IMPORTANT: The game is far from being finished and is developed by myself as a single guy. Many graphics are just placeholders and more features will be added during the development.Embark on an epic journey through ancient Rome in RES PUBLICA - Citizens of Rome. Begin as a humble plebeian and rise through the ranks to become a respected patrician. In RES PUBLICA, players take on the roles of powerful Roman families, competing to build the greatest city and achieve the most glory and influence. Each player starts with a unique character, representing their family's particular strengths and weaknesses, and an individual home that can be upgraded over time.Players will use action points, gold and spend resources to construct buildings, hire workers, and gather more resources. As players build up their cities together, they will unlock new abilities and gain access to more powerful options. Upgrading your personal home is crucial, as it provides additional benefits and reflects your rising status in Roman society.Players must carefully manage their resources, balancing their desire for more powerful structures with the need to keep their workers fed and their finances stable. They must also keep an eye on their opponents, sabotaging their plans and disrupting their progress.Produce over 50 different goods in a variety of buildings, each with its own unique benefits. Trade with diverse cities, form caravans, and establish lucrative trade routes to grow your influence and wealth in the Roman world. As the game progresses, players will build their own unique version of a Roman city, with districts, buildings, and structures that reflect their strategic vision. Your home will evolve from a simple dwelling to a grand villa, showcasing your success and offering new gameplay advantages. Upgrade various rooms and features to enhance your living space, improve your family's status, and unlock unique bonuses. Customize and expand your domus, turning it into a luxurious haven that reflects your achievements and strategic prowess in ancient Rome.The ultimate goal is to amass the most influence and power, cementing your family's place as one of the most powerful in all of Rome.Experience the thrill of the gladiator games in ancient Rome. As a player, you can visit and host spectacular gladiator battles, placing bets on your favorite fighters and watching the intense action unfold in the arena. Engage with the games through interactive choices, influencing the outcome and enhancing the excitement of the spectacle.Current FeaturesInnovative mix of a board game, classic city-builder and life simulation. Build and design your City, based on a beautiful Hex-Tile Map.Unique 3D Interiors for all buildings.Over 30 Resources to produce and trade.Deep Population System with 4 social classes. Each with its own needs, demands and professions.Manage your workspace and workers.Seasons with different effects on production and your population.Create and manage your own Character. Unlock new Traits and Actions.Innovative Patronus System (your personal gods) to unlock new technologies, professions and more.Build and Upgrade your personal home, assign servants, host events and explore your home in first person.Interactive tutorial that will teach you how to play.Enhance your streaming experience with our planned Twitch integration. Streamers can engage their viewers and followers in real-time by involving them in political elections, special events, and more, creating a dynamic and interactive gameplay experience.Military: In times of war, you can join the legion. Fight in the legion and rise in rank. This is the first step in starting your political career. Roman Politics: Take part in the Cursus Honorum and gain a powerful political office. Gods & Religion: Praise the gods and gain their support.Multiplayer: Challenge other players around the globe. Online & Hotseat!Map Editor: Design your own maps and share them with others.
Short Description: RES PUBLICA - Citizens of Rome, an innovative city builder, life-simulation and roleplay game, invites the player to build his own roman city, manage his character, family and household during the ancient Roman Republic in 150 BC. Ave Caesar! Its up to you to lead the way for your home and family!

Detailed Description: Dive into the thrilling world of cryptocurrencies and blockchain with Money Block, an immersive economic strategy game where you manage a virtual cryptocurrency portfolio. Buy, sell, and mine blocks while navigating an unpredictable and ruthless market. Will you master the blockchain and maximize your profits, or fall victim to the volatility of cryptos?Key Features:Dynamic Market Simulation: Every turn is influenced by random events, price fluctuations, and the actions of other players. Survive bull and bear market cycles while adapting to changing trends.Portfolio Management: Manage up to 6 different cryptocurrencies. Make strategic purchases, sell at the right moment, and diversify your assets to maximize your portfolio’s value.Mining System: Allocate your CPU and energy resources to validate blocks, accumulate rewards, and actively participate in blockchain building.Action and Market Cards: Play cards that can influence market prices, attack your opponents, or protect your investments. Automatically drawn Market cards impact the overall economy, while player Action cards target specific cryptocurrencies.Multiplayer Strategy: Play with 2 to 6 players online, using bluff, cunning, and strategy to outsmart your opponents. Every decision influences the market and affects other players' strategies.A Constantly Evolving World: Face global events that simulate the real-life highs and lows of the cryptocurrency world. Adapt to hacks, regulations, bull runs, and other economic surprises.Money Block immerses you in a captivating experience where every transaction, every validated block, and every decision matters. Join a world where digital finance is at your fingertips and dominate the blockchain.

Detailed Description: Welcome to the Wasteland of Tomorrow!The world as you knew it? Long gone—like a cassette tape that’s been chewed up by a faulty player. In its place lies a vibrant, chaotic civilization where the remnants of life scrape by amid bizarre mutants, jittery robots, and terrible monsters that would give your worst nightmares a run for their money.In this colorful post-apocalyptic playground, you’ll need to assemble a ragtag team of fellow fortune seekers. Scavenge the wreckage of the old world for quirky artifacts, powerful weapons, and maybe even a dog treat or two—because every hero deserves a snack!Focused on a team of characters, you build your team during each run (just like your deck), a chosen ally will bring their own pool of cards into the game as well as their own unique abilities.Dynamic movement and enemy intent system that requires players to juggle incoming damage and positioning their characters to avoid it.Procedural mission system. Each 2-4 event adventure features unique combinations of enemies, modifiers, and rewards. Choose your challenge level and face the consequences.Unlock powerful upgrades through gameplay alone: Expand your collection with booster packs, deck upgrades, artifacts, and consumables - no microtransactions, ever.After each mission through the forbidden zones, spend your hard-earned floppy disks (the currency used in the new world) to snag booster packs, heal or replace fallen teammates, or upgrade your deck with powerful sigils.Sharpen your skills against the bizarre and dangerous creatures lurking in radioactive zones, where treasures await those brave enough to seek them. Claim your loot and build a deck of cards that’ll take you further than anyone has dared to go. Unearth the mysteries of what happened to civilization and carve a path to your ultimate destiny.The future may be bleak, but your adventure is just beginning!Wishlist the game now to get notified when the demo is released and join us on Discord to get early demo access and become a part of the game development journey!

In each run, build your team of mutants, robots, and survivors, with unique cards and powers. Choose missions wisely trading off risk against rewards used to upgrade your deck with booster packs.

Detailed Description: Immerse yourself in The Erebus Accord, a lore-rich pixel art Action RPG set within a vast, underground facility. As chaos unfolds, you must navigate the darkness, contain escaped horrors, and restore order before humanity's deepest secret is revealed.CONTAIN THE HORRORSA containment breach has occurred at the Facility, as a fresh recruit who's been touched by fate, responsibility now rests on your shoulders to seal the escaped horrors and eliminate any entities that could threaten the Accord.FORGE YOUR STRENGTHDefeat aberrations and consume their power to unlock new classes. Conquer the facility at your own pace by blasting through challenges or utilizing tactics and enemy weaknesses against them. Each class will offer unique gameplay and strengths to cater to your style of gameplay.EXPLORE THRESHOLDHelp stranded scientists, reveal classified reports, and crush the rise of dangerous cults. The Facility offers a sprawling, interconnected set of rooms that adjust with every decision you make, reflecting your choices as you unravel its secrets. Lift the lockdown and unlock new areas, gradually expanding the map as you progress.LEARN THEIR STORYAll entities, from security personnel to the most vile of horrors, have a story to tell. Explore interconnected plots and detailed reports, utilize this knowledge to identify enemy weaknesses. Uncover secrets of the Veil and the Accord.CHOOSE YOUR DIFFICULTYWe value player choice, face the Facility at your own pace: Story Mode - For those who enjoy dialogue, exploration, and a smooth experience with little action or punishmentClassical - A traditional hack and slash experience with no focus on tactics or modifiersTactical - The intended experience. Plan your approach, adapt to enemy behaviors, and navigate the Facility's layout to survive

Detailed Description: Cubic Dungeons is a voxel art dungeon crawler set on a mysterious island cut off from the rest of the world by a raging storm. The islanders inhabiting the island live off going down a deep chasm located in a central part of the island and acquiring various items. But going down the chasm comes with a cost: the deeper you go, the more powerful is the curse that makes it increasingly difficult to return to the surface. Some never return…The game’s atmosphere will be heavily inspired by slavic mythology and fantasy worlds, including the works of J.R.R. Tolkien. During the game the players will come across humans, mythological creatures, elves, dwarves and others.The plot will be partially non-linear, no playthrough or replayed level will ever be the same. Worth noting is the fact that the player’s moral choices will have a significant impact on the course and experience of the game. Depending on the choices made, the player will receive one of numerous endings.With this game we aim to deliver a dungeon crawler experience fans of classical hack’n’slash and action RPGs will love, while also introducing new mechanics and systems that aren’t typically found in those genres, to innovate on the genre and give the game an interesting twist.

Detailed Description: EDYN plunges you into a dynamic multiplayer realm where you forge mighty settlements, command vast armies, and clash with rivals in epic PvP warfare. Embark on a grand quest to shape a living world with your strategic brilliance, forging alliances and conquering foes to etch your legacy into EDYN's history. In a land teetering on the brink of chaos, only the sharpest minds will unify the realms and bring order to EDYN.Build, Expand, and Conquer! Your journey begins with one of eight distinct factions, each offers their own unique perspective of the world. Your faction can also determine your allies and rivals. Although considered teammates, the sandbox nature of EDYN means that these bonds are not set in stone. You have the freedom to forge or break alliances whenever you see fit. Should you wish, fallen members of your faction can be revived back into the world of EDYN in order to assist your cause. Though beware, reclaiming a fallen ally’s settlement is no small feat. In an ever-evolving world, your choices define your destiny. Will you unite under a common banner or carve your own path to supremacy?Begin your journey by constructing essential structures to gather vital resources like gold, wood and food for your troops. Transform your humble settlement into a sprawling empire. Delve into deep resource management, balancing production and expenditure to fuel your expansion. Invest wisely in building enhancements, army recruitment, and technological advancements to outpace your rivals. Your economic acumen will be the backbone of your dominance. Assemble an unstoppable force from a diverse selection of units, each with unique strengths and battlefield roles. Whether you prefer overwhelming foes with sheer numbers or deploying elite squads for precision strikes, tailor your military to reflect your unique strategy and ambitions. From your War Room, lead grand campaigns against NPC settlements and rival players. Launch daring raids to seize resources, deploy specialist units to crush enemy defenses, and halt their offensive. Detailed Description: StoryThe quiet Numata Hiroshi is being blackmailed by his classmate, Himehara Yoritake. One day, Himehara orders Numata to steal the exam answers off the teacher's desk, which sets off a chain of events culminating in the two men being among the captives taken by a criminal impersonating a police officer. Their captor is a deranged, cruel man, and if they’re going to survive, they have no choice but to comply with his demands… CharactersThe cast of Masquerade is a diverse group. As well as Himehara and Numata there is Hachiouji, an honor student; Mr Shimeno, a teacher; Oizumi, a local TV reporter who becomes embroiled in the hostage situation, and Takaura, a police officer. Then, of course, there's the captor.Gameplay and FeaturesMasquerade is a visual novel, where your choices determine how the narrative branches and scenes play out until the next choice is required. The game has its original full Japanese voice acting intact, and all text has been translated into English.

Detailed Description: MasterQuest Fantasy is a captivating role-playing experience that takes players back to the golden age of tabletop RPGs from the 70s and 80s.It embraces the nostalgic charm of those classic adventures, inviting you to step into a world where imagination reigns supreme, and the unexpected lurks around every corner.With its procedurally generated world and a style that pays homage to the timeless fantasy of old, MasterQuest Fantasy offers a fresh experience with each and every playthrough.No two gameplay runs are ever alike. One adventure might lead you on a desperate quest to destroy a powerful trinket before the Dark Lord awakens, while another could see you locked in battle against the twelve mysterious Zodiac Knights who guard ancient secrets.One day, you might find yourself lost in a maze of enchanted forests, searching for the legendary Crystal of Shadows, and the next, you could be outwitting a cunning dragon in the depths of a forgotten mountain stronghold.The places you visit and the people you meet are never the same twice — from the mysterious wanderer who asks you to help him track a murderer, to the jolly peasant girl who invites you to play a game of snikzesfwhlingdir, each interaction and encounter is shaped by the unique world generated for you.Be prepared to face perilous traps, deadly beasts, and powerful foes that will test your mettle. Death is not just a possibility — it's inevitable.You will die in countless ways: perhaps valiantly battling a ferocious dragon to protect a village, falling in glorious combat against a horde of undead warriors, or slowly starving after getting lost in the barren wastelands of the Frozen Peaks.Or, maybe your end will be less dignified: slipping on a patch of mud while fleeing a group of goblins, choking on a particularly large bite of pie, or accidentally triggering an ancient mechanism that floods the room with hundreds of rampaging chickens.But with every death, a new story begins, and with it, new opportunities arise.Are you ready to embark on an endless journey, where every new adventure could be your greatest triumph — or your most devastating defeat?In MasterQuest Fantasy, the only certainty is that no two adventures will ever be the same. How far will your imagination take you?

Detailed Description: Artemis VR is your ticket to becoming an astronaut in virtual reality! Step into the shoes of a member of the prestigious Artemis space program and put your skills to the test in the most realistic simulation of modern space travel. Do you have what it takes to lead your mission to success?Experience thrilling moments, from managing day-to-day operations on board to handling critical situations—extinguishing fires, managing decompression, and even caring for sick crew members. Execute precise spacecraft maneuvers, dock at a space station, and embark on an unforgettable spacewalk (EVA). Artemis VR takes simulation to a whole new level with full immersion and realistic spacesuit experiences.Key features of Artemis VR:Dynamic mission scenarios – each playthrough presents new challenges inspired by real-life emergency procedures used in actual space missions.Exploration of unique locations – step inside the Artemis program capsule, visit the International Space Station, or traverse the vastness of open space.Full VR immersion – feel like a real astronaut, with realistic physics, thrilling plot twists, and breathtaking views of space.Scientific accuracy – every detail is designed to faithfully replicate the reality of modern space missions.Prepare yourself for a challenge that will test your skills and take you straight to the heart of a space mission. Can you rise to the occasion?

Accompanied by a soft, eerie ambiance, it might leave you pondering the meaning of your own existence even after it ends.

In Fatebound Kingdoms, the future is yours to shape, but fate is always watching.

Detailed Description: Do you like fast-paced action-packed combat?If so, this game isn't for you. Do you hate constant random encounters?If so, this game isn't for you. Do you enjoy gorgeous 3D cut scenes that last for 20 minutes or more?If so, this game isn't for you. Do you prefer frequent auto-saving so that you never lose any progress?If so, this game isn't for you.Right. Have they all gone? Good. Old Hero is a game that aims to recapture what made so many of the 90s era RPGs so great. And that means leaning into supposedly detrimental gameplay decisions like random encounters and the like. The best way to get an idea of what the game is about is to watch the trailer, but broadly speaking expect a large world map to explore, hundred of 2D enemies to fight, eight quirky characters to add into your party, several towns to explore that have shops to buy things from, and several multi floor dungeons with a big boss waiting at the end. The story begins with Rufus who is about to embark on a coming of age visit to the local ruins with his elder brother and sister, both knights. Getting in the way is Imogen, a girl from the local village who rubs Rufus up the wrong way. Soon enough, adventure strikes and the story continues at a barrelling pace as the world is slowly explored as plot point after plot point comes thick and fast.

Detailed Description: Word Warp is a typing game, set in space. You have to protect your ship from incoming projectiles by typing specific incoming words. And fend off enemy vessels by finding words with the right amount of letters to destroy them and navigate your way home. An entertaining mixture between typing under stress and finding the right word at the right time.Initially, all available words are based of the 20k most common english words. As you progress you may add to this, creating your own little linguistic arsenal.Difficulty is based on your own typing speed and can be adjusted after each run.If your daily occupation does not include enough typing and you enjoy the rattling of your keyboard, this game is for you.

Detailed Description: Papa Louie is off on another adventure, leaving you in charge of his wildly popular pizza parlor!  Customers will arrive to order both seasonal specialties and all-time classics at the Pizzeria.  You'll need to choose from a variety of crusts, sauces, and cheeses, then top each pizza with a mouthwatering selection of ingredients.  But be warned -- Papa's customers are famously picky!  You'll need to carefully place the perfect number of toppings in exactly the right spots.  After baking the pizza, slice it just right and box it up for your hungry customers.  With multiple stations to run, each providing a unique, hands-on experience, the orders will keep you constantly on your toes as you juggle tasks throughout the Pizzeria!Welcome back to Tastyville!  In this deluxe reimagining of Papa's Pizzeria, you'll unlock new ingredients, new customers, and new seasonal flavors as you play.  Even more customers have arrived in Tastyville for Papa Louie's award-winning pizza, so you'll see some fresh faces along with your Pizzeria regulars.  There are also a variety of new features for the pizza parlor, including new Daily Specials, helpful Score Details, a Pizzeria Food Truck, new holiday ingredients, and more!Roy doesn't have to manage the Pizzeria all by himself! Hire a custom worker — or even his sister, Joy! — to handle the phones and take delivery orders. Once the pizza's ready, your Driver will deliver it right to the customer's door! The Driver can also lend a hand in the brand-new Dining Room, where customers can relax and enjoy their hot and fresh pizza in a cozy booth at the Pizzeria.Once you hire a Driver, you can send them to the bustling streets of Downtown Tastyville in your brand-new Pizzeria Food Truck!  Between workdays, unleash your creativity by crafting the wildest and most delicious pizzas imaginable, then serve them straight from the truck to see who stops by for a taste.  You can also mix and match ingredients from different holidays in the Food Truck for truly unique combinations!Hands-on gameplay for topping, baking, and cutting pizzasCustom chefs and delivery driversFood Truck for open-ended free play mode12 separate holidays to unlock, each with more ingredients7 exciting Mini-Games to play after each workdayTons of furniture and clothing to decorate your shop and workersEarn and master 40 unique Special RecipesView Score Details to learn from your mistakesCustomer Coupons to entice customers to return90 colorful Stickers to earn for completing tasksUnlock alternate outfits for every customer151 customers to serve with unique orders99 ingredients to unlock

Detailed Description: FOXYBALLA Boutique Leisure GameFOXYBALL is a fun and easy-to-play game inspired by Football Penalty. Instead of playing against a goalkeeper, the goal is divided into 24 blocks, with a new random configuration for each attempt. To score, players will need a combination of luck, skill, and smart decision-making.We’re not only creators but also players ourselves, and like many, we work hard everyday, striving to achieve our dreams and build our lives. We believe the true value of games is to offer relief and escape from exhaustion and pressures, not to burden players with repetitive, time-wasting tasks.That’s why we created FOXYBALL to be a simple, relaxing experience—quick to learn, easy to play, and perfect for unwinding. It recaptures the charm and joy of the games we grew up with back in the 1990s and early 2000s, where players could jump right in and start having fun.. FOXYBALL is about instant fun and relaxation. The game offers 4 distinct play modes within:- “Starlink” and “Starlight” are ideal for solo play, offering the perfect way to relax while challenging yourself to higher score.- “Teamgeist” mode encourages teamwork, as you and your friends or family join forces to solve tricky challenges together.- “Jackpot” mode offers a competitive and friendly battle where lets players face off in a tactical showdown.FOXYBALL is an entertainment that fits any occasion—from solo play to family day or social events. We recommend the “Starlink” and “Starlight” modes for those looking to unwind or enjoy some solo time such as during a cozy weekend afternoon. If you have a STEAM DECK, these modes are perfect companions for your daily commute or longer journeys.For a more social experience, please do try the 'Teamgeist' and 'Jackpot' modes. They’re perfect for introducing your children to the joys of both football and gaming, bringing fun and laughter to family time, or sharing sweet, playful moments with your mates or loved one.As a small, independent studio of 4 passionate developers, we are proud to present this debut version of FOXYBALL on STEAM. Looking ahead, we are excited to continue our work on future development, including an ONLINE MULTIPLAYER version and a BODY-MOTION version, which we believe will offer the most immersive FOXYBALL experience yet.If our game resonates with you, or if you have any feedback or suggestions, we would be most grateful if you followed us on Twitter/X: @HayenGamesThank you sincerely for your interest and support.

It includes 4 unique modes to fit different occasions: for your leisure time, gaming with your loved one, family day, and party.

The game offers 4 distinct play modes within:- “Starlink” and “Starlight” are ideal for solo play, offering the perfect way to relax while challenging yourself to higher score.- “Teamgeist” mode encourages teamwork, as you and your friends or family join forces to solve tricky challenges together.- “Jackpot” mode offers a competitive and friendly battle where lets players face off in a tactical showdown.FOXYBALL is an entertainment that fits any occasion—from solo play to family day or social events. We recommend the “Starlink” and “Starlight” modes for those looking to unwind or enjoy some solo time such as during a cozy weekend afternoon. If you have a STEAM DECK, these modes are perfect companions for your daily commute or longer journeys.For a more social experience, please do try the 'Teamgeist' and 'Jackpot' modes. They’re perfect for introducing your children to the joys of both football and gaming, bringing fun and laughter to family time, or sharing sweet, playful moments with your mates or loved one.As a small, independent studio of 4 passionate developers, we are proud to present this debut version of FOXYBALL on STEAM. Looking ahead, we are excited to continue our work on future development, including an ONLINE MULTIPLAYER version and a BODY-MOTION version, which we believe will offer the most immersive FOXYBALL experience yet.If our game resonates with you, or if you have any feedback or suggestions, we would be most grateful if you followed us on Twitter/X: @HayenGamesThank you sincerely for your interest and support.

Detailed Description: What does the future hold? The reign of cruel King Illeon has come to an end. Love triumphed over evil, and peaceful times have returned to the land. From the mystical Enchanted Forest to the vibrant circus, each location is rich with detail. Find unique treasures, lore items, and hidden secrets that enhance the immersive experience while expanding the game’s world!💋 Stunning Fantasy World!Journey through beautifully crafted locations teeming with magical creatures, breathtaking scenery, and intricate world-building. From enchanted forests to lively circus tents, the world of Royal Romances will captivate your imagination and immerse you in its rich atmosphere!

Detailed Description: [Game Mode]The game adopts a 3D perspective of free exploration, presenting players with a vast and fantastical adventure world. Players can choose one of several distinctive characters as a starting point, each with unique initial skills and growth paths. The combat system integrates a variety of gorgeous skill effects, making every battle awe inspiring.Faced with numerous challenges and powerful bosses, even if the challenge fails, players will be reborn from the mysterious birthplace, and unlocked equipment, skills, and progress will be preserved. At the birthplace, players can freely match their collected weapons and characters, once again opening the door to their inner demons and embarking on new battles.  ————————————————————————————————————————————Diverse roles with distinct characteristicsThe game offers four charming characters for players to choose from: the charming and colorful fox demon, with its agile skills and enchanting power, becomes a dynamic dancer on the battlefield; Brave warriors, wearing heavy armor and wielding sharp blades, vow to defend justice to the death; The Grim Reaper of the Underworld, wielding the power of life and death, reaps the souls of enemies with a cold and ruthless attitude; There is also a mysterious character waiting for players to unlock and explore. Each character comes with unique initial weapons and exclusive skills, providing players with a completely different gaming experience.Ancient style scene, free explorationThe game scenes blend rich elements of ancient Chinese style, from majestic mountains and rivers to beautiful water towns, from bustling streets to tranquil bamboo forests, every place exudes the charm and mystery of the East. Players can freely explore this vast world and discover hidden treasures and secrets. You can even run lightly on the water surface, feeling the extraordinary freedom and pleasure.【 Rich weapons, versatile combinations 】Up to 60 types of weapons are provided in the game for players to choose from and match. These weapons not only have different appearances, but also possess unique attributes and skills. Continuously upgrade weapons in battle to unleash astonishing power. Rare legendary equipment awaits players to unlock and collect, adding more possibilities to battles.【 Diverse Equipment, Different Effects 】Each character can equip up to 5 weapons at the same time, and each challenge will produce different effects based on the selected weapons. This means that players can flexibly adjust their equipment combinations according to their own combat style and needs to cope with various challenges. Every time you enter a challenge scene, it will be a brand new adventure and experience.【 Diverse difficulty levels, unlimited challenges 】The game offers a variety of difficulty settings ranging from simple to hellish, meeting the challenge needs of different players. Whether you are a novice in the martial arts world or a seasoned warrior, you can find your own challenges and fun here. By constantly challenging themselves, players will achieve immortal accomplishments and glory.Numerous bosses, challenge upgradeThere are over 20 super bosses in the game, who not only possess powerful abilities and unique skills, but also hide profound stories and backgrounds. While eliminating the monsters, players need to constantly monitor the movements and movements of the boss. When your own strength is enough to challenge them, don't hesitate to charge forward! Every battle with the boss will be a contest of wisdom and courage, as well as a test of the player's strength and willpower.———————————————————————————————————————————— [Story Overview]The story is set in a fantasy world 500 years after the legendary Journey to the West. The group of four who once collected scriptures had achieved complete success and returned to the state of extreme happiness, but unfortunately their scriptures were scattered and coveted by evil forces, leading to chaos in the world. Players will take on the role of a chosen hero by fate, embarking on a sacred journey to search for and retrieve the true scriptures, in order to transform the world and restore peace and order.As the true scriptures are recovered one by one, players will undergo a physical and mental transformation, ultimately unlocking and facing the ultimate boss. When the ultimate battle comes to an end, the dawn of the new era will illuminate the earth, and players will become legends remembered by future generations.

Detailed Description: ABOUT THIS GAMEDive into a world of horror where survival is a race against time. In this team-based multiplayer game, you will either play as a survivor desperately seeking freedom or as a relentless slasher hunting down your prey. Every match is a battle of life and death, where ingenuity, strategy, and adrenaline are your most valuable allies.Survivors must cooperate to find jerrycans, power up generators, and activate a radio to call for police assistance. But beware—the slashers are always lurking, and they will not stop until all survivors have been eliminated. Will you be clever enough to escape the clutches of evil, or will you be the predator that brings terror to life?A Dark and Merciless WorldExplore eerie and unsettling environments, where every shadow may conceal danger. As a survivor, your ingenuity and teamwork will be your greatest weapons to outsmart the slashers. Communicate effectively, hide when necessary, and complete your objectives before time runs out.If you play as a slasher, the hunt is your playground. Use your skills to track down your prey and prevent them from reaching their objectives. Every match is a new opportunity to spread terror.A Constantly Evolving GameRegular updates will enrich your experience with new maps, unique survivors and slashers, new weapons, and additional features. Each character, whether a survivor or a slasher, has unique abilities that influence their playstyle. The variety of choices and tactics makes every match intense and unique. Return often to discover new content and sharpen your strategy.Become a LegendWill you be the ultimate survivor who escapes despite all odds, or the legendary slasher whose name alone strikes fear? Complete objectives and unlock unique rewards that testify to your glory. You're about to live unforgettable moments… but will you live to tell the tale?

Detailed Description: Anti-Terrorist Shooting Game: A Thrilling FPS ExperienceStep into the action-packed world of Anti-Terrorist Shooting Game, where you become an elite commando, tasked with defending your city from waves of terrorists. In this intense first-person shooter (FPS), you’ll engage in high-stakes missions to stop terrorism and bring peace to the war-torn streets. Featuring dynamic gameplay, modern weapons, and a variety of game modes, Anti-Terrorist Shooting Game offers an immersive FPS experience that will challenge your skills and strategy.Dive into exhilarating multiplayer battles in our anti terrorist shooting game, where you can join forces with friends or face off against players worldwide. Experience dynamic gameplay with various modes that emphasize strategy, teamwork, and skill as you fight to dominate the battlefield.Key Features:Campaign Mode: Dive into multiple high-intensity shooting missions, each with unique objectives. From urban warfare to covert sniper operations, this mode will test your tactical expertise and combat skills.Survival Mode: Stay alive as long as possible while facing relentless waves of enemies. This mode is all about endurance and precision as you shoot your way through endless attacks.Multiplayer Mode (Online & Offline): Battle alongside or against other players in exciting multiplayer skirmishes. Whether you're playing with friends or competing against strangers, this mode delivers fast-paced, action-packed gameplay with multiple teams vying for dominance.Zombie Mode: Take on hordes of undead enemies in this thrilling zombie shooter mode. Keep your defenses up and mow down zombies before they reach you. How long can you survive?Defuse Mode: Step into the battlefield as you work to defuse bombs planted by terrorists. Neutralize enemies and prevent explosions in this high-stakes mode that blends strategy and skill.Weapons & Arsenal:Choose from a wide selection of modern weapons, including assault rifles, sniper rifles, shotguns, grenades, and more. Upgrade your loadout to better withstand enemy attacks and dominate the battlefield.Gameplay Features:Auto-Shooting: Focus on strategy while the game handles firing for you.Swipe to Aim: Intuitive controls make it easy to target enemies with precision.Grenades & Explosives: Maximize damage with well-timed grenade throws.Armor & Health Management: Upgrade your gear to stay in the fight longer.Tactical Combat: Timing your shots and managing your health will be crucial for survival.

Detailed Description: Nuts About Nuts is a lively and cooperative “stress-free” factory simulation game where teamwork and precision are the keys to success. In this fun and fast-paced experience, players can team up to run a bustling factory floor, selecting specialized tools and using their unique skills to manufacture and deliver increasingly complex parts. As you work together or alone, the goal is to keep the assembly line moving efficiently while ensuring your friends stay in sync. The more parts you successfully create and deliver, the more money you earn, enabling you to progress through your company's journey.·         Create your own manufacturing company·         A variety of machines and equipment to           unlock, buy, and use in your factory·         Automate your production·         Custom layout for your factory·         Personalize your company and           your co-op team·         Character customization system·         Purchase a variety of perks to boost           your speed and progress·         Buy factory buildings to manufacture           different parts that earn you more moneyPerfect for casual and dedicated gamers, Nuts About Nuts combines the challenges of machining and manufacturing with a playful and engaging atmosphere. With its vibrant art style and dynamic gameplay, the factory floor becomes your playground as you master the art of crafting and delivering the perfect product. Whether working with a group of friends or alone, you’ll need coordination, quick thinking, and a solid plan to keep things running smoothly. Get ready to dive into a world of industrial fun and see just how “nuts” you can get in this entertaining cooperative adventure!

Detailed Description: Welcome to Damashi Game.In Damashi Game, players face off in puzzles, social challenges, and obstacle courses, all striving to outwit and outlast each other to claim the ultimate prize. Overview:Step into the world of "Damashi Game," a thrilling multiplayer social deception experience where strategy, psychology, and quick thinking are your greatest weapons. In a game where every move counts and every word could be your last, players are pitted against each other in a series of intense challenges that test not only their skills but also their ability to deceive and outwit their opponents.In "Damashi Game," the only way to win is to survive—and survival requires mastering the art of deception. Whether you're facing off in a high-stakes 1v1 showdown or navigating a treacherous obstacle course with your enemies at your side, every decision you make could mean the difference between life and death.Key Features:Strategic Social Deception: Engage in intense psychological warfare as you bluff, betray, and outmaneuver your opponents. Use your voice and your wits to manipulate others, but be careful—one wrong move could spell your doom.Diverse Game Modes: "Damashi Game" offers a variety of unique and challenging game modes, each with its own twist on the social deception genre.Proximity Voice Chat: Communicate with other players in real-time using proximity-based voice chat. Hear your enemies' plans, coordinate with allies, or bluff your way to victory—but remember, your voice can give away more than you intend.High-Stakes Decision Making: Every game mode is designed to push players to their limits, forcing you to make quick decisions under pressure. Whether you're bluffing your way through a duel or strategizing with a team, "Damashi Game" will keep you on the edge of your seat.Dynamic Visuals and Immersive Environments: Experience the tension and excitement of "Damashi Game" with stunning visuals and atmospheric environments that draw you into each challenge. From the glow of the Trust Wall to the ominous shadows of the Symbol Showdown, every element of the game is designed to heighten the drama and suspense.About the Game:In "Damashi Game," trust is a rare commodity, and deception is the name of the game. Players must navigate a series of carefully crafted challenges, each designed to test their ability to outthink and outmaneuver their opponents. With each round, the stakes grow higher, and the tension mounts, as you inch closer to the ultimate prize—or your inevitable demise.Whether you're playing with friends or competing against strangers, "Damashi Game" promises an unforgettable multiplayer experience that will leave you questioning who you can trust and how far you're willing to go to win.Do you have what it takes to survive the "Damashi Game"? Trust no one, deceive everyone, and make every decision count.

Detailed Description: This is a Story about You!An anti-social Otaku who is a student at Ashikaga Academy, a very traditional private high school in Japan. Suddenly, you awaken in a place called the Spirit Realm and are tasked with saving the world! How? Well, with the help of your fellow classmates and future friends of course! Now all you have to do is join the Horticulture Club and actually meet them!Make Friends and Improve your Abilities!You will have to grow close to the six members of the club and help them to create Otaku Miracles, a medicine that helps boost cognitive functions along with some other effects.  This can be done by spending time with them and increasing your Culture, Charm and Academics in order to socialize effectively. These skills also correlate to your magical abilities in the Spirit Realm! Participating and succeeding in many activities is the key to increasing your abilities and saving the world!What Path shall you Walk?There are many twists and turns and every decision matters! Many different endings are possible depending on the choices you make and who you pursue romantically. Will you save the world? Let the darkness consume you? Pursue love with a special someone? It is entirely up to you!

Detailed Description: "Falling for Yaoguais" is a fantasy visual novel based on Taiwanese yaoguai(supernatural beings) legends. You are drawn into a conflict between humans and yaoguais, navigating through events alongside four yaoguai love interests. Who will you end up with in the end?What if the legendary yaoguais(supernatural beings) were real?And even more shocking... they're all hot guys! You (custom name) apply for a seemingly ordinary job at an amusement park, only to discover it's a trap set by yaoguais to lure humans as food! Worse yet, you must disguise yourself as one of them and secretly investigate the conspiracy behind it all.The revered Sacred White Chiedong Tree Deity, the cold and sharp-tongued Serpent Prince, the fearsome Specter Jin who demands live sacrifices, and the mischievous Mischief Elf who tricks people into the mountains—face amusement park crises with these four as you make over 150 choices, forming bonds that run deep or stay shallow.As the truth unravels, an even bigger plot awaits.——But hey, love comes first, right?The amusement park's manager who offers you a high reward to disguise yourself as a yaoguai and assist in the investigation.In truth, he is a thousand-year-old ancient tree, transformed into a powerful guardian deity through human faith. Though he appears stern, he's actually quite soft-hearted, and you can sense his unintentional kindness.Protecting humans is in Bai Ruomu’s nature, but this pure-hearted guardian slowly begins to realize that his feelings for you might go beyond mere protection...A scientist who occupies the amusement park's infirmary and, upon discovering you're human, views you as a rare test subject.As the descendant of a serpent god and a human woman, he wields great power. Arrogant and sharp-tongued, Mo Daan has a purely scientific mind—yet he's stuck with a love-obsessed father who insists he find a human woman to truly love. To make matters worse, his father gave him a Love Blossom that will only bloom when he meets "the one." What a headache!You notice everyone piling their work on him and can’t help but step in—only to discover he’s not just a supervisor but the amusement park’s most capable employee, handling everything on his own!Specter Jin is an ancient yaoguai with a long history of close ties to humans. In the past, humans would sacrifice lives to him in exchange for his labor.Though gentle by nature, he’s long been aware that you’re human but chooses not to reveal it.Who would have thought that this once fearsome, man-eating Specter Jin would now be so fond of acting cute?Superstar Yan Xingmang isn’t just an amusement park employee—he’s also a yaoguai?!In fact, he’s the notorious trickster, the mischievous Mischief Elf, known for luring people into the mountains.Cheerful and curious about humans, he finds it fascinating that you, a ‘yaoguai,’ are so familiar with human life.He frequently flirts with you, making you wonder—does he say this to every girl?Thrown into the world of yaoguai, you barely escape being eaten and must now disguise yourself as one of them, navigating the complex relationships with other yaoguais.Though scared at first, your strong mental fortitude helps you quickly bond with them, even becoming friends.You're a bit reckless, but never weak—running away is never an option in your choices.The yaoguais don’t understand love, but as you find yourself entangled with four yaoguai love interests, the question is—do you? The choice is yours.A fantasy story based on Taiwanese yaoguai legendsOver 300,000 words with more than 150 choices, offering rich, immersive storytellingCustomizable heroine nameFour unique love interests, all inspired by Taiwanese yaoguaiAt least nine Taiwanese yaoguai supporting charactersFive endings (four exclusive to each love interest, one bad ending)And most importantly, you can romance all four love interests at once—be bold in your pursuit of love!Producer: JuiceWriter: Sixty-SevenCharacter Design/Sprites: Orange GoCG：Meron FlySD：HNLamb StudioTrailer：UGLY

Detailed Description: Breeding Grounds is an old school style dungeon crawler. The goal is to progress through various rooms and eventually defeat the final boss, the source of all monsters. You must be quick however, as the miasma leaking from monsters will cause constant damage to your health. You will be able to play as a few different classes, each with their own set of bonuses and drawbacks. Detailed Description: Parking Attendant Simulator puts you in charge of transforming a rundown parking lot into a thriving business in a dystopian future. In a society divided by class, you’ll cater to the needs of everyday commuters while striving to attract the wealthy elite. Start small by cleaning up trash, repairing broken equipment, and expanding your lot with new facilities to draw in more customers. With enough success, you can even upgrade your parking lot into a major transportation hub by adding mass transit stops.But it’s not all about business growth—this world is as selfish as it is competitive. Manage the chaotic entry and exit of vehicles, preventing collisions and keeping your lot in order. And if things get messy? Well, you have... other ways of handling that. Defend your lot from thieves and vandals, make shady deals, or embrace a life of crime yourself. How you run your parking empire is entirely up to you.Will you rise as a hero for the common folk or join the ranks of the corrupt? The choice is yours in Parking Attendant Simulator!Key FeaturesRestore and run a Parking lot in a busy cityBuild new services such as vending machines, automatic barriers and storage facilitiesManage entry and exit to the Parking lot to prevent accidentsScare off vandals and thieves to maintain your reputationLots of interesting events on top of normal gameplayadd decorations and customizations to your parking lotManage stock levels for servicesCleaning bird poop!

Detailed Description: The Empty Desk is the first chapter in the Detective Bennett: Solved Cases series, a psychological thriller adventure with puzzle-solving and horror elements that immerses the player in a true crime narrative while exploring the effects of a mind trapped in a cycle of repetition and wear. In this first installment, veteran homicide detective Thomas H. Bennett, just one week away from retirement, faces one last puzzling case that could change him forever.The story centers on the mysterious death of business tycoon Arthur Blackthorn and the inexplicable disappearance of his daughter Emily. Everything unfolds within the headquarters of Blackthorn & Co Insurances, a company hiding far more than simple contracts behind its polished walls. What starts as a routine homicide case quickly spirals into a surreal, harrowing experience. As Bennett explores the dark hallways of Blackthorn, he finds himself trapped in a nightmare where time and space warp, pushing him to the brink of sanity.As you delve deeper into the game, reality crumbles before your eyes. The Blackthorn offices become a hostile, ever-shifting limbo where every corner hides disturbing secrets, and each door you open may bring you closer to the truth… or take you further from your own salvation. The title, The Empty Desk, symbolizes much more than a physical absence; it reflects the emotional exhaustion and the sense of emptiness felt by those, like Arthur Blackthorn, trapped in a life of monotony and despair—a mirror of Bennett’s own weariness after years on the force.Key Features:Deep narrative: Follow Detective Bennett’s final mission as he confronts a homicide case that devolves into something far more unsettling and emotionally devastating.Psychological exploration: The game tackles themes of mental health, emotional burnout, and workplace alienation through Bennett’s experiences and the dark mysteries of Blackthorn.Tense atmosphere: Blackthorn & Co's offices are a changing, disorienting environment where reality distorts, and every step reveals new threats and secrets.Challenging puzzles: Use your detective instincts to solve puzzles, uncover hidden clues, and piece together the dark secrets of the company.True crime meets psychological horror: The game blends realistic criminal investigation with elements of psychological horror, challenging your perception and forcing you to face your deepest fears.Start of a saga: The Empty Desk is the first chapter in the Detective Bennett: Solved Cases series, with more missions and mysteries to unravel in future installments.An Immersive Story:The title The Empty Desk is far more than a literal reference. At its core, it symbolizes the empty hearts of those trapped in a monotonous, repetitive work cycle, in an office environment where daily routine can become an invisible prison. As Bennett uncovers the secrets of Blackthorn & Co, he must also face the reality of his own life—a life spent solving other people’s mysteries while ignoring the emotional emptiness consuming him.Will you solve the case before the truth devours you too? This is only the beginning of a saga where each case will challenge you on a psychological, emotional, and narrative level.

Detailed Description: "MAHOROBA CAT" is an exploration and collection game where players travel to take and gather photos of cats. One day, the protagonist, the player, is tasked with visiting various locations to photograph cats for a cat magazine. Players will walk through a voxel-based world in search of cats. Taking cat photos rewards players, allowing them to travel to new areas by train or plane. Each area features landmarks like castles and shrines, giving players a sense of adventure as they search for cats. Rest is also essential during the journey; staying at hotels and staying hydrated is important, and managing your health is a crucial aspect of progressing in the game. Now, set off on a delightful journey to find cats!

Detailed Description: Fengshen Zhuan "is a strategy chess game set against the backdrop of ancient Chinese mythology and legends. The game features Jiang Ziya as the protagonist, and players will play the role of this legendary strategist who combines wisdom and courage, leading his divine soldiers and generals to conquer all directions and ultimately achieve the great cause of becoming a god.Fengshen Zhuan - The Perfect Fusion of Strategy and MythIn the game "Fengshen Zhuan: Battle Chess", you will travel through time and space to return to the era where mythology and reality intertwined. Jiang Ziya, this legendary sage, will lead you into a world full of mystery and challenges.Strategy first, wisdom takes over the world. In the game, you need to use Jiang Ziya's wisdom, carefully plan and strategize. Every decision can change the course of the battle, and every battle tests your strategy and wisdom.With the help of divine generals, each displaying their divine powers to summon numerous mythical generals such as Nezha, Yang Jian, Lei Zhenzi, etc., they each possess unique skills and combat styles. Reasonable combination and unleashing their maximum potential are the key to your victory.Chess battles are played step by step using classic chess gameplay. Players need to carefully layout on the chessboard, utilize the characteristics of terrain and generals, and engage in strategic battles. Every movement needs to be cautious, and every attack needs to be precise.Mythical plot, immersive experience game with rich plot, taking you to deeply understand the story of Fengshen Yanyi. As the game progresses, you will uncover the secrets behind each mythological story and experience epic battles.

Detailed Description: A Dual Ascent is a solo-cooperative adventure game in which you control both characters simultaneously with a single controller. Guide them as they ascend the Mountain, following a story inspired by fairy tales:     "Once upon a time, there was a mountain; a mountain so tall, it touched the sky. It was the Great Mountain of Wonders.      An Old Pilgrim, who came from a land far away, was on his way to the summit.      But a fallen Little Star had the exact same idea, for she thought she might return home, if she reached the top of the Mountain..."This is how the tale of two peculiar characters begins.Come set out on a poetic journey that will challenge your mind and ability! Control the Old Pilgrim and the Little Star at the same time, with one controllerSolve unique and innovative puzzlesDiscover wonderful  environments inspired by fairy tales                         Will you solve the riddles of the Great Mountain of Wonders?                              NB: A Dual Ascent is a graduation game made in one year by a team of 9 students, and the help of talented instructors. Thank you for your consideration regarding potential bugs and performance issues.

Detailed Description: BEAST is a thrilling 3v3 multiplayer hero shooter where each match delivers quick and intense action with powerful Mechas! Choose your favorite character and dive into quick, action-packed games that offer easy, pick-up-and-play fun. BEAST offers a light-hearted, laid-back experience open to anyone, boasting quick matches full of excitement!Experience a dynamic dual gameplay system. Switch seamlessly between your powerful MECHA for brute strength and your agile PET for nimble tactics, each offering unique skills that bring versatility and depth to every match! Seamless transitions and sharp strategy will turn the tide in your favor!Choose from a roster of unique heroes, each with their own special abilities and playstyles. Whether you prefer heavy firepower, quick strikes, or strategic defense, there’s a hero that fits your gameplay and adds a new dimension to every battle!Skill matters most, not your wallet! With no microtransactions, BEAST guarantees a fair and balanced playing field for your progression where your abilities and achievements drive your success. It’s all about your skills, strategy, and teamwork!Keep the excitement alive with nonstop action through multiple game modes, regular events and frequent updates. New challenges, content, and game modes are added regularly, ensuring there's always something fresh to experience in the BEAST arena!

Detailed Description: Before reading, please note that this is a game in ongoing development, and features will be completed and added over time.Robot Farm is a Life-Sim RPG set after a cataclysmic war that has ravaged the planet and caused a mass disappearance of all its inhabitants. When people begin to suddenly reappear all over the world, they are awakened with the "memory" of their lives long-past- wanting only to recover and return to their once peaceful lives before this avalanche of strife befell them.  Being one of many survivors, you see both the fragments of what was, what is, and what can be. Not only this, but you have a gift to decide these pieces of fate: the "Aokobots." Machines that were left dormant during the sleep civilization had fallen into, have now awoken and respond to your words and thoughts. In a world full of mystery and danger, what will you do to make it home once more?■ Explore: Explore a world full or perils and adventure. Rediscover the secrets it has to offer. Delve into dungeons, solve their puzzles, and use your Aokobots to repair and restore it them to enable journeying deeper inside.  ■ Make a home: find a suitable location and begin building up your new home. Live in towns, interact with your neighbors, and bring your friends and crushes along with you on dates/adventures. Give yourself somewhere to come home to when it's time for rest and resupplying.■ Build an autonomous flow of income: with the help of your Aokobots, build and protect automated farms and factories that will not only help you fund your adventures and reconstruction efforts, but also supply the required infrastructure to build crucial items and machines you'll need to explore deeper into the world and reconnect it. ■ Fight alongside your robot companions: ally yourself with Aokobots and other NPCs with our hybrid Turn-based system. Fight in real-time against weaker enemies, and engage in strategic turn based battles against strong foes that require teamwork. Our unique system introduces combos, real-time movement, and using items/traps while fighting in Tactics-based combat - all while taking place on the overworld. Items are the key to victory, so it's important to keep a steady supply coming out of your farms/factories! ■ Experience our story. Walk into our universe:  While the reconstruction of the world is well underway, many feel uneasy not fully understanding what happened all those years ago. What caused everyone to disappear, and why are they reappearing now? Will it happen again? It’s up to you to reconnect the world and answer these questions! Walk into Universe 7, the world of our last project, We Shall Wake, and experience the grand story of a world we’re just beginning to weave....Or perhaps, explore the world of another person’s creation made with our World Editor:■ The World Editor: Dedicated Modding Tools - create your own worlds: The tools used to develop Robot Farm will be made fully available to the players; create your own worlds, your own stories, your own characters, and share them online- all by using our dedicated development and modding tools! Modding assets are saved via "Magic Images," card-like PNG files that store all of your custom data and can be easily traded and shared around the internet.
Short Description: Set after a cataclysmic civil war that caused everyone on the planet to disappear into thin air, you and other survivors awaken to a whole new world. Aid in the reconstruction efforts: build a home, form bonds, create automated farms; then set out to explore, fight, and shape your new destiny!

Detailed Description: This 2D first-person point-and-click adventure with escape the room mechanics is set in a near-future world where a global cataclysm occurred some time ago. This event granted certain powers to some individuals called the Order of the Dark Parallel, allowing them to control aspects such as life and death.  A young family of scientists is studying the impact of this cataclysm on society while investigating a series of mysterious disappearances and murders linked to the Dark Parallel. But for Adamey Bree, everything becomes personal only when opposing forces take his wife's life under inexplicable circumstances.  Help Adamey solve all the riddles and mysteries and find out what really happened to his beloved wife.   What you will find in this point-and-click escape room game.Mystery riddles to solve and hidden objects that you should use to complete the detective story.  Unique setting with a bright protagonist and NPCs.  Unforgettable and touching moments that you can share with the main character.  Unique art style in combination with the relaxing atmosphere and music.  Single-player adventure game with brain teasing puzzles.How to play this point-and-click adventure game.Interact with objects and characters in the environment by touching them.  Find hidden objects, use inventory items on game objects.  Solve brain teasing puzzles, and unwrap the mysteries of this adventure detective story.     Would you dare to know all of the secrets of the Dark Parallel, and stay alive?  Enjoy the adventure in a unique setting and help Adamey get to the truth.

You control Alea, an organic, man-made being created to inhabit the city. And all you want to do is escape…
