Detailed Description: Sirens ring out! Explosions shake the ground and spill your drink!The enemy has reached Alpha-Alpha-1! The galaxy has fallen!The time has come to fight back and defeat the Deadly Alien Rogues!DAR is an arcade-style single-screen shoot-em-up inspired by the classics, with some modern rogue-like twists!Select from multiple characters, journey through over 100 different planets, choose between over 60 different upgrades, more than 10 different weapons, and take on over 20 different bosses!Pick your character, plot a course, upgrade your ship and destroy the enemy!The ultimate goal? Saving the galaxy! Or just getting a really, really high score - your call.Every time you play, you'll encounter a different collection of planets, powers and enemies that might drastically change the way you approach the game!Each character has their own spread of starting abilities that might also influence your decision making - you'll have to make the most of what you find along the way, and defeat the enemy forces!If you're having a hard time, the currency you acquire in each run can be used to influence the appearance rate of certain items, or be used to permanently upgrade characters between runs!On the flipside, if you're having far too easy an experience, why not take some detrimental "upgrades" to boost your score and really show the world how good you think you are?With simple-to-learn controls and the potential for complex scoring and character builds, there's room for everyone to enjoy themselves in their own way!Steam Leaderboards are also supported!Each combination of character and run type has its own unique leaderboard, so you can pick and choose your favourite way to play and compete against other like-minded players for the highest score!Want to play a quick practice run with a fully upgraded character? Go for it!How about an endless run starting with a character at their absolute weakest? Yep, that's fine too!If you're not for direct competition, there's plenty of unique Steam Achievements, too!

Detailed Description: Echoes of the Iron Prison is a 2D platform game. The player guides the prisoner through a series of screens towards the prison exit. To overcome opponents, she will have basic movement with jumps, the option to use stealth, engage in dialogues with good/bad consequences, and, at certain points in the game, engage in direct combat. Along with this, there is interaction with elements of the scenery. On this journey, she will discover more about the prison and about herself. It is possible to lose at certain stealth failures and also by choosing wrong options in dialogues.

Detailed Description: Islets Defense is a turn-based tower defense game focused on resource management, where you build a small and efficient village to support your towers and secure victory. A turn consists of executing one of the four available actions, each with its own unique functionality. The order of the cards plays a key role, with the rightmost card offering a stronger effect. After completing your turn, the chosen card moves to the leftmost position, pushing the others one step forward. Consistent and efficient use of all four cards is key to building a solid defense.  Allocate your towers in strategic positions, sustain them with food, upgrade them with wood and stone, and ensure a strong defense against the slimes. Chests and stage modifiers will offer new strategic opportunities, with unique towers and various upgrades to explore.Each building has different upgrade options for you to choose from. Build the most efficient village by making smart decisions that synergize with your positioning strategy!The mist has covered your entire kingdom! You start the game with an unexplored map, ready to be revealed! Use the exploration action to reach new resources, gain visibility for your attack towers, and discover hidden treasures! Advance through stages, complete challenges, and earn diamonds and feathers to unlock and face different biomes! Islets Defense is the game for those looking for a classic tower defense experience mixed with the chilling vibes of a resource management game, all wrapped up in easy-to-understand mechanics filled with creative possibilities.                                                      30 different building structures, each with their own unique abilities. A 15-stage campaign featuring distinct modifiers, level design, biomes, and challenges. 6 different upgrades available for many buildings. 20 different tiles scattered throughout the stages, each with its own unique and intuitive interactions.10+ hours of playtime!

Detailed Description: Stuck in an underground laboratory without any memories, you witness horrible crimes. Knowing you will be next one day, you start planning your escape. Who can you trust? How can you control the power you feel inside of you? And will you ever fully recover your lost memories along with the truth?-x-Project Nihilum Zero is a narrative-driven Visual Novel set in a futuristic, dystopian world where reality and illusion collide. As brainwashed, kidnapped inmate in an underground laboratory, you will navigate a web of secrets, strange entities, and choices that will give you insight into different points of view of the story.-x-“They whisper in the dark. Do you hear them? The Origin calls to you, following you through floor after floor of the laboratory. You’re not the first to walk these corridors, and you won’t be the last. But maybe, just maybe, you’ll be the one who finally understands. Step into the void, make your choice, or let the choice make you. What will you become? You have nothing left to lose. Except… some fingers, a leg, maybe a kidney or two?-x-Features:STORY: Experience a dark narrative filled with twists, hidden lore, and choices that pull you deeper into a world where nothing is as it seems.VOICE ACTING: Every character's dialogues are voiced by our talented voice actors.MUSIC: The game features original soundtracks. You can unlock and listen to them in the game's music gallery.UPDATES: The game will be updated with new episodes, adding new gameplay to each of the 3 routes.CENSOR MODE: A censor mode can be activated at the beginning, allowing the player to experience censored versions of some scenes.IMAGE GALLERY: Unlock various images throughout the story and view them in the game's gallery.MEMORIES: Discover the past of the characters in snippets by using a certain ability.ABILITIES: Play with 1 of 3 abilities: Hybrid, Shape Shifting or Mind Glimpse. Depending on the ability, you can unlock certain scenes, memories or routes.MAIN CHARACTER: The main character will not be shown in the game. A custom name and pronouns (he/she/they) can be choosen.STORY: Discover what happened to you before your memories were taken from you and chose your new 'familiy'.ROUTES: Play 1 of 3 routes and discover the overall story through different perspectives.AVAILABLE ROUTESTHE LABORATORIES: The organization that kidnapped you. Why on earth would you join and help them? (Because you want to spend time with the smart science people, we know.)They will use you for their benefit, but you can do so as well. What will you encounter in the endless corridors? And will you make it out alive or become one of them?TRUE PARADISE: You want a found family? This is the route you want to play. After all, everyone will show up here for shelter. Some of them are victims, some are former employees of the Labs. And - of course - a few of them are involved in shady business, playing every trick to accomplish their plans.THE BOUNTY HUNTERS: A mysterious organization, found by an individual who is told to be no human at all. Money, hunting, and lies make it hard to believe any of them.Are you a streamer?You can stream this game IF you add a creative aspect (audio commentary, ...). Recording the game and uploading it without adding anything to it, is not allowed. Short Description: Project Nihilum Zero is a narrative-driven Visual Novel. Discover the twisted story from different points of views and make your own choices. Discover 1 or 3 abilities: Mind Glimpse, Shape Shift and Hybrid. Use your ability wisely to see the past, influence the present and shape the future.
About the Game: Stuck in an underground laboratory without any memories, you witness horrible crimes. Knowing you will be next one day, you start planning your escape. Who can you trust? How can you control the power you feel inside of you? And will you ever fully recover your lost memories along with the truth?-x-Project Nihilum Zero is a narrative-driven Visual Novel set in a futuristic, dystopian world where reality and illusion collide. As brainwashed, kidnapped inmate in an underground laboratory, you will navigate a web of secrets, strange entities, and choices that will give you insight into different points of view of the story.-x-“They whisper in the dark. Do you hear them? The Origin calls to you, following you through floor after floor of the laboratory. You’re not the first to walk these corridors, and you won’t be the last. But maybe, just maybe, you’ll be the one who finally understands. Step into the void, make your choice, or let the choice make you. What will you become? You have nothing left to lose. Except… some fingers, a leg, maybe a kidney or two?-x-Features:STORY: Experience a dark narrative filled with twists, hidden lore, and choices that pull you deeper into a world where nothing is as it seems.VOICE ACTING: Every character's dialogues are voiced by our talented voice actors.MUSIC: The game features original soundtracks. You can unlock and listen to them in the game's music gallery.UPDATES: The game will be updated with new episodes, adding new gameplay to each of the 3 routes.CENSOR MODE: A censor mode can be activated at the beginning, allowing the player to experience censored versions of some scenes.IMAGE GALLERY: Unlock various images throughout the story and view them in the game's gallery.MEMORIES: Discover the past of the characters in snippets by using a certain ability.ABILITIES: Play with 1 of 3 abilities: Hybrid, Shape Shifting or Mind Glimpse. Depending on the ability, you can unlock certain scenes, memories or routes.MAIN CHARACTER: The main character will not be shown in the game. A custom name and pronouns (he/she/they) can be choosen.STORY: Discover what happened to you before your memories were taken from you and chose your new 'familiy'.ROUTES: Play 1 of 3 routes and discover the overall story through different perspectives.AVAILABLE ROUTESTHE LABORATORIES: The organization that kidnapped you. Why on earth would you join and help them? (Because you want to spend time with the smart science people, we know.)They will use you for their benefit, but you can do so as well. What will you encounter in the endless corridors? And will you make it out alive or become one of them?TRUE PARADISE: You want a found family? This is the route you want to play. After all, everyone will show up here for shelter. Some of them are victims, some are former employees of the Labs. And - of course - a few of them are involved in shady business, playing every trick to accomplish their plans.THE BOUNTY HUNTERS: A mysterious organization, found by an individual who is told to be no human at all. Money, hunting, and lies make it hard to believe any of them.Are you a streamer?You can stream this game IF you add a creative aspect (audio commentary, ...). Recording the game and uploading it without adding anything to it, is not allowed. We want to promote creative content creators and NOT want our game to be used for clicks and views without putting creative effort into it.

Detailed Description: In Copper Odyssey 2, you will be playing as Celeste, the little sister of Herman the Printmaking Angel. She has gotten a job outside of the print studio and into Nickel City. Her first day will be turning blank canvases into paintings. Go through the museum and do the best job you can. She’ll be able to make some friends along the way. This game uses Press Turn JRPG combat to keep the battles feeling fast and responsive. There are many enemies who are beautiful artworks, they want to take Celeste to the Unicorn’s art studio…but she has a job to do. This game, like the previous Copper Odyssey, is open-ended. You can handle things in any order you want, as long as you respect the craft!

Detailed Description: What if there was an interdimensional war being waged over the very fabric of reality? One where humanity is merely a pawn and an unwitting victim, awaiting absorption by malevolent Exoforms seeking to consume every dimension of the infinite multiverse?What if you were the only one who could stop it?Void Scout is a tense tactical roguelike full of decisions to make, strategies to test, and sci-fi horrors to face in turn-based combat set on procedurally generated space stations where everything is out to kill you. Do you have what it takes to save reality and stand tall against the horrors of the multiverse?Streamlined Tactical Gameplay: Void Scout is built around making decisions based on the situation you encounter. What will win a fight is a cool head and superior tactics, not micro-managing or min-maxing. These can give you an edge, but will never carry the day.High-Stakes Combat: Vision is limited, weapons powerful, and enemies hard-hitting. Every mission can be your last one - or of the variant life you're running. You never know what's lurking behind the next corner or bulkhead. It might be an opportunity - or a death sentence.Dynamic Tension Level: A Director-style system controls the tension level, changing ambiance, introducing dynamic events, and bolstering the enemy presence. Go in fast and hard or slow and cautious - react to the changing circumstances and see the game react to your decisions.Deep Procedural Generation: Every mission is more than just a randomly generated map peppered with enemies. Expect different challenges, different tension changes, and different opportunities. The same applies to replaying missions: What was familiar and straightforward might be anything but!Persistent Progression: The life of a Void Scout is challenging and can end at a moment's notice. But your ability constantly grows with new weapons, upgrades, and equipment. Constantly discover new ways to survive and overcome - and crush enemies that once made you retreat!In and Out in 15 Minutes: Every mission matters. Get in, complete your objectives, get out and make meaningful progress without having to grind your life away. Void Scout is about making decisions, not spending endless amounts of time to unlock the next incremental upgrade.
Short Description: Save reality one mission at a time! A seemingly unimportant Void Scout gets thrown into the middle of an interdimensional war, as the only one who can prevent the Exoforms from consuming reality. Strategize, plan, and execute in a suspenseful tactical roguelike. Save the multiverse and die trying!

Detailed Description: You are an office worker drifting in a big city, and due to your busy job, you no longer have many friends to stay in touch with. After working tirelessly for an unknown number of days, you have a nightmare ----- a very dark, empty, and cold nightmare. In the dream, there is nothing; it feels as if the entire world consists only of you.Then, a mysterious girl appears. She tells you the story of Dream Echo, a story where everyone's dreams are connected together...You wake up, half in disbelief, with a vague memory of this event. From then on, every time you fall asleep, you find yourself in that dream home, and she is there waiting for you, ready for you both to embark on adventures in the world of Dream Echo...Welcome to the Paradise of Concepts! This game is created by passionate POE fans. There are no specific skill upgrades or fixed combinations in the game; all skills are based on fundamental logic, and all concepts are modular blocks that can be combined freely. How you play is entirely up to the player! The game will continue to update concepts in the future until the Paradise of Concepts is fully constructed!In every exploration, upon waking from a dream, you can obtain Memories by recording your dreams. This allows you to solidify certain concepts, enabling them to take shape quickly during your next venture into the Dreams!You can also decorate and refine your Memories in the Home, combining them to strengthen and enhance more powerful Concepts.Even after you leave the game, your character will continue to acquire various Memories from "reality"! Once the game officially launches, you'll even be able to exchange Memories with your Steam friends! (Stay tuned!)You can freely create a class list using the Dream Wish List to craft a build that is uniquely yours, and then share it with other players with just one click. If your Wish List is used by others and receives positive feedback, you can earn additional rewards!You are also welcome to join the official QQ discussion group: 805422834
Short Description: Dream Echo is an RogueLite ARPG game where players can explore the world of Dreams and acquire various Concepts to engage in nearly completely free-form combination battles. Additionally, you can gather Memories upon waking, allowing you to bring some Concepts into your next dream adventure...

Detailed Description: Recharge - Hyperrealistic RC Racing at Its Finest!Experience the thrill of RC car racing like never before in Recharge, a cutting-edge, hyperrealistic racing game inspired by the beloved classic, Re-Volt. Dive into a world where miniature cars pack a powerful punch, racing through meticulously designed environments with incredible detail and realism. Whether you're battling against AI bots or testing your skills with friends, Recharge brings the RC racing experience to a whole new level!Game Modes:Singleplayer: Race against AI opponents on a variety of tracks, each offering unique challenges and obstacles.Multiplayer: Compete with your friends in online races and prove who’s the fastest driver!Co-op Driving: Looking for a more relaxed experience? Team up with a friend to explore maps and enjoy the thrill of driving without the pressure of competition.Realistic Visuals & Sound:Recharge delivers crisp visuals and detailed track environments, immersing you in the RC racing world without over-promising. With a variety of camera angles and authentic sound effects like engine roars and tire skids, the game ensures a satisfying and engaging racing experience.Key Features:A diverse range of track environments, each designed with meticulous detail to challenge your skills and offer fresh experiences.Multiple RC car models, each customizable to your liking with different skins and performance upgrades.Realistic physics engine that replicates the true-to-life handling of RC cars, giving you complete control over every turn, drift, and jump.A seamless multiplayer system for intense racing action with friends or casual co-op driving sessions.Customizable camera perspectives: Race in first-person for an immersive experience or switch to third-person for a broader view of the action.Soundscapes that reflect the intricacies of RC racing, from the hum of motors to the rush of wind as you race through the track.Recharge is not just a racing game; it’s a full-fledged RC car simulation that brings together the best of arcade racing and hyperrealism. Get ready to drift, jump, and race your way to victory on a range of diverse maps, whether you’re playing solo, with friends, or just exploring for fun.

Detailed Description: Get behind the wheel of a planetary rover and travel through ruins lost in the sands to discover what's hidden deep within the sand dunes. Sell your loot to the locals and fulfill their quests to learn about the crazy past of these places. Equip your transportation with advanced equipment to mine more gems and rare animal skins from the most hidden corners and reach the distant hills. But keep an eye on the time: you won't be happy with the fearsome creatures that may come to visit you under the cover of night...Explore the dunes and uncover their secretsStart your life with a clean slate in New Arkham Colony From there you'll travel into the desert, scouring the rubble of ancient buildings for treasures and trapping giant creatures and giant saber-toothed worms, of which there are more than 30. Explore each of the areas invented by Lovecraft, complete quests and travel to neighboring fantasy regions, each with its own unique features, inhabitants and secrets.Mining artifactsSomeone really wants you to dig into the past, but can they be trusted? Madness is contagious.Watch out at nightDanger is everywhere: watch out for huge worms and hiding geese. But the worst is in the darkness that covers the sands as soon as the sun goes down....Game FeaturesUncover the ultimate mystery: at the wheel of a planetary rover, you can travel to lost habitats in the wilderness, each with its own inhabitants, Mi-Go, Tindal, Yog-Sothoth, Nyarlathotep, Elder Ones and others.... Mine: treasure awaits in the sands and debris, and completed quests from the locals will help you acquire many unique skills in your arsenal.Hone your craft: learn new equipment and upgrade your all-terrain vehicle to hunt rare species of monsters and find buried treasures and mysterious artifacts.Earn a living by hunting: by selling your prey to the locals, you can learn what's happening on the planet, improve your rover and travel to even more remote places.Fight back against madness: strengthen your mind and use what you've learned to survive in the terrible desert after sunset.
Short Description: The Sands of Yuggoth is a single-player game where you hunt, mine, explore and uncover the sinister secrets of Yuggoth. Sell your loot, upgrade your rover and scour the desert in search of long-buried secrets. Explore the mysterious planet created by the mad genius of Howard Phillips Lovecraft.

Detailed Description: IntroductionQuinary is a top-down roguelike action shooter game. Players take on the role of the Gynoid robot, customizing their body parts and using visual programming to create their own skills. In randomly generated dungeons, they defeat enemies and bosses. The game's inspiration comes from Dead by Daylight, Pixel Dungeon, Tinkers' Construct, Tetra, and Psi.WorldbuildingOn the day humanity declared the achievement of the technological singularity, the world did not usher in the anticipated prosperity. Instead, due to the rapid technological advancements outpacing moral and legal boundaries, various technologies were abused, ultimately triggering a catastrophic event that devastated the entire universe. Unfathomable phenomena and incredible monsters emerged, plunging humanity into a long dark age. Due to a lack of records, we know very little about this dark period, but one thing is certain: it was an apocalypse. Fortunately, over time, the number of monsters and phenomena decreased, and humanity was not wiped out. The surviving humans, along with the suddenly appearing , entered a new geological era—the Quintery: a barren Earth, a society where humans and robots coexist, and a universe filled with Ooparts, Ooptechs, Oophens, and Oopents.FeaturesCustomize RobotsHigh Freedom for Item Customization, Replace various parts of items, choose the materials of each part, and further modify your parts!Modify Your Robot, Change defensive specialties, movement speed, senses, add more robofunctors, and available patterns!Cellular ProgrammingUnlike most games where skills are fixed, here you can use visual programming to create your own skills!Hardcore Dungeon RoguelikeHealth is difficult to recover, and you must always monitor the robot's power and fuel!In randomly generated dungeons, watch out for traps and enemies until you defeat the boss!Enemies are generally as strong as players! They will actively dodge bullets and detect sounds (hopefully achievable).Slightly stringent sensory limitations, including detectable wavelength ranges, etc., and even olfactory sensors (hopefully achievable).Other FeaturesThe game includes liquid and gas systems! You can throw a battery into water to electrocute all creatures standing in it, or cause an explosion by mixing acids and bases!Complete item descriptions immerse you in the game's world.To-Do ListDestructible mapsRandomly generated mapsSmarter AIMultiplayer supportControllable creaturesRendering, art, and music (half the budget might go into this, the current team is just one person 🥺)More items, parts, patterns, and bossesItems and robot appearances will change based on parts and materialsMore pattern shapes, fault pattern which can't be removed, patternquantity limits...Fancy decorative patterns?Fate of the GameThe game is currently in the Alpha version! Many elements are not implemented yet, and it lacks art and music!The alpha version will continue for a while, during which time the demo version will keep being updated until sufficient funds are secured for beta development. In the future, the game will transition to a paid game. In the current demo version, players can use basic programming, items, and customization to defeat a boss.However, the game still has many bugs, which will be fixed gradually.

Detailed Description: SummaryFind or Be Found is an asymmetric co-op horror game. Go on heists as a pair of burgalrs looking for the most valuable items in haunted houses. Locate the specific item to earn money and progress, but search for to long and unimaginable horrors will awaken.Play as either the hacker or the robber. Only the hacker knows what to steal and where to find it, and only the robber inside the house can grab it. Communication is key.HackerAs the hacker only you know how the item looks like, where it is and when the monster is nearby. You must guide the robber using maps and cameras.Describe the itemCheck your camerasManage resourcesRobberAs the robber, locate your way around in the house, bring back the item that is described and hide when the monster comes. Be fast, discrete and don't make any mistakes.Locate and steal the itemsHide from the monsterCommunicate your locationEarn Money, Upgrade GearIf you survive the heist, use the loot to buy and upgrade your tools and gadgets. Raise the stakes and be prepared for everything.Communication toolsCamerasAnd more..!Only through communication can you and your partner in crime survive the horrors that await you. Visit different haunted houses, steal the cursed items ordered by the mysterious organization, and get out before you are caught. A horrible fate lurks in the shadows, ready to claim the life of anyone foolish enough to enter their domain.The game is still in development and certain aspects may change from what can be seen and are described. Join our discord community to follow the development, find fellow burglars to play with and share your ideas for the game!

Detailed Description: Apocalypse Express is an action management Roguelike in which the player conducts, upgrades and repairs different parts of the train through endless waves of enemies in a post-apocalyptic setting. Departing the darkness of their lifelong shelter, the player decides to embark on a journey through the wasteland looking to fulfill the dream of seeing the outside world with their own eyes, charting out a map around the few remaining memories of the past world. Manage the ChaosBe prepared for some nail-biting tension as you try to keep your train running while balancing putting out fires, collecting resources and dispatching enemies. You won't always be able to take care of every part of the Train so be ready to think fast and smart as things will not go as planned. ModulesModules are the foundation of your Build. Fill up your Wagons with various modules each giving you unique abilities. There are Modules for every type of Wastelander. Go full offense by building up an arsenal of cannons, rocket launchers and turrets, obliterating everything in your path. Take the more defensive approach and create an indestructible machine built around disabling enemies, deflecting shots and extinguishing fires, keeping your train healthy and running even through the harshest conditions. Or experiment with other combinations, perhaps go with a speedy train that gets you to your destination faster or even create a completely autonomous system that does all the work for you.  Your slots are limited, so choose wisely. Upgrades Once you've assembled your perfect combination of modules it's time to make them shine. Each module can be upgraded in dozens of interesting ways, either by making them more powerful or introducing completely new abilities. RelicsRelics are the final piece of the puzzle, you can only have a few of them but relics often bring powerful and impactful effects that can be the backbone of some amazing builds! Mix and match them to find the best combination to create the perfect Train.

Detailed Description: JAMs is a clicker game with Steam items themed around art and music, served in jars.Initially, the scope of the game will be a quite simple clicker game with items but will evolve over time to become something special.  The game is free to play so everyone will be able to get drops, but with the Extra Drops DLC you will get a few more, it will be a fair distribution and there will be a few special items only available through the item shop.The schedule of items being removed from the drop pool will be a reliable thing and rotate quite frequently, so you will need to idle the game all the time in order to get all the drops.  The game is art-and-music themed, so if you are an artist (or just love it!) be sure to join the JAMs Discord Server and follow along with the project as we grow!

Detailed Description: YEAH OKAYThe hero needs the coherence cores. You're just a silly little dump fish NPC who has been given the opportunity of a lifetime to play a supporting role in the epic of PISCIS x MACHINA: 4.44 you (are) fish.They even dedicated the subtitle to you!That's you,you (you) are fish! Fish you!General Game OverviewPiscis x Machina is a third person fishing adventure game. Play as a sidekick npc fish and hookshot your way across the island to stop the moon from crashing into the island. Talk and trade with the villagers of the trash island to find COHERENCE CORES, the only fuel strong enough to save the world.Detailed Features and ContentTo cast with the fishing rod, point your cursor/rod at a target, click to cast, and if your rod has enough range, the hook will attach to the target.To catch a fish, hook the fish with the cast mechanic, and rotate the mouse in a circle to reel the fish towards you.Walk up to characters on the island and press the interact button to talk to them. Each character wants a specific item you. It’s upon you to find the item on the island and give it to them in order to trade up to the next item in the quest. Everybody wants something!Gather collectables for trading using the same hook and reel mechanics!To grapple using the fishing rod, use the target and hook mechanics just like fishing and use the reel to pull yourself to the grapple point!Trade with characters to upgrade your fishing rod. Each upgrade will extend the rod’s range and will help you reach places that are harder to get to.Your character will automatically pick up a coherence core when you touch it. The power of the coherence core is so strong that it will scramble your atoms while carrying it. Don’t worry though! It’s perfectly safe and you won’t suffer any damage.You win the game by collecting all five coherence cores and delivering them to the hero of the story.General Overview of Mature ContentSome of the non-playable characters’ dialog contain profane language.There is no sexual content except maybe the moon has an exposed butt if you consider that sexual. This game does not have any explicit references to drugs.Piscis x Machina is a non-violent game with no depictions of violence to human or humanoid characters. However, there is the threat of imminent doom but you can prevent all of that by winning the game!

Detailed Description:
This is a simple and easy-to-use key assistance tool,

It supports customizing keyboard keys as well as the left and right buttons of the mouse. It supports setting intervals and enabling random intervals. By default, it works in multi-threading mode, which is a different tool from peripheral macros.

All keys are triggered according to the delay interval set by the user, without prioritizing the order. Therefore, it does not support sequential execution, and multiple keys will not wait for each other. This is a completely different operating method from traditional peripheral macros.

This tool cannot 100% support all applications under default conditions. If you encounter special programs that cannot run, It is recommended to use a virtual machine, start this tool on the physical machine, and then serve the virtual machine, activating the virtual machine window. This method can bypass all detection mechanisms 100%, because applications in the virtual machine do not have the right to access background programs on the physical machine. This method may have unexpected effects when used with a synchronizer~

Detailed Description: Caduceus Quest is a single-player, role-playing game in which you engage with the scientific method to solve a medical case that has affected the community. You play as Simone: a Black college student who is home for the summer.Simone's hometown is in the grip of a mysterious new illness which is spreading — and even seems to be impacting her grandmother. Simone takes on additional responsibilities in the quest to identify the mysterious illness and contain it. As Simone begins to grasp the scope and nature of the threat, she meets new expert companions that represent a wide variety of STEM and health professionals from diverse backgrounds. Over the course of playing, each of the STEM and health professionals Simone encounters provides the player with specific and accurate information about the aptitudes, education, and professional competencies that various STEM and health careers require. The game takes place in a variety of locations, including the hospital, town hall, and local park.Multiple mini-games are embedded throughout the experience, allowing the player to practice science skills including science communication and keyword definitions. The primary mini-game is a turn-based card game in which your opponents' characteristics suggest optimal strategies. A secondary mini-game is a search-based challenge in which moving your cursor unlocks scientific terms.Over the course of gameplay, Simone realizes that the mysterious illness is systemic in nature. She must complete the quest by using the scientific skills she has learned to engage with civic leadership (e.g. mayor and policymakers) and improve the conditions by taking civic action.Caduceus Quest was evaluated in a scientific trial conducted by researchers at the University of Chicago to evaluate its effects on young people. Playing Caduceus Quest was shown to increase STEM knowledge, scientific process inventory, self-efficacy and interest in learning and doing science, scientific career interest, and civic engagement. We hope you also enjoy Caduceus Quest!

Detailed Description: Build your own deck of weapons and outsmart the enemy in turn-based, one-on-one battles. Become the leader of three fighters, create a strategy and shoot! Enjoy epic landscape-destroying hits. Collect and upgrade weapon cards. Win battles and move to new arenas to unlock powerful new cards in your collection! Get chests from which you can get rare and legendary weapons and fighters! Climb the rankings in online battles or challenge a friend!You have many options for how to destroy your enemies, and the arena changes from explosions. Create your own team of three unique fighters and choose the weapon you want to fight with. Weapons differ in their capabilities and mechanics, which makes the game even more fun. You can jump up and shoot three times in the air at once thanks to time dilation! All fighters have weaknesses and defenses to certain types of damage. Use the fighter's mana, spline, or spend a lot of mana on one powerful shot on the group or make several cheap shots but on the enemy's weaknesses?  The game combines elements of arcade, action strategy, and shooting games. You can organize a battle round with your friends online or play with a virtual opponent. You have a whole arsenal of weapons at your disposal, and it's time to use them. Have fun and enjoy the process!WHAT'S IN STORE FOR YOU?- Multiplayer and online games with friends: you can play with your friends, as well as against a virtual opponent. Fight and show everyone who's the best shot!- Tactics: even online shooters can't do without strategy. Think of a battle plan! You can implement your most interesting plan and combine melee and ranged weapons, or simply unleash an armageddon on everyone;- Locations: the coolest multiplayer games cannot do without a large-scale world. There are many different maps in the Cannon Guys universe, play in a pirate bay, frozen lands, or near a volcano;- Characters: our online game involves many heroes with different abilities. We have prepared more than 30 fighters for you to choose from. Each of the fighters has its own character, weaknesses and defenses. Some of them take more damage from fire and some take less damage from explosions, try to create a universal team for you and conquer the rating with it.- Progress: level up your character by sending him to the battle royale, level up your weapons and become an increasingly dangerous opponent, unleash the potential of your weapons to the maximum level. All for a fun multiplayer game!- Fun! Funny cartoon characters from the Cannon Guys universe will give you a lot of emotions. It's especially nice when the strategy works and after accurate aiming the projectile hits the target, giving you a victory.

Detailed Description:
Where a noble and a sailor cross paths begins a world-spanning adventure of loss and gain, greed and charity, and the eventual fate of the world itself.

Bereaved: Soldiers of Fate is a occasionally wacky, occasionally deadly serious RPG in the world of Hargul, where you control various misfits and scoundrels in an attempt to help people, deal with their own personal demons, and avoid dying a painful death to a menagerie of monsters. From vast forests to dry deserts to desolate fields of ice, engage foes in a battle-system where teamwork between your party members is key. Learn enemy patterns, support each other, and manage your strengths, and you just might make it another day. And when you're not busy fighting, you can explore a wide world, where each nook and cranny contains an interesting personality to chat with.

Detailed Description: The Last Light is a deeply emotional, story-driven exploration game where you relive a man’s life as he reflects on love, loss, and the gradual fading of his eyesight. Guided by the love of his life, Emily, you navigate key stages of his journey, filled with joy, sorrow, and quiet reflection.Story:The game begins with the protagonist’s vibrant youth, where Emily serves as his guiding light, helping him uncover cherished memories from their time together. As you move through his life, his eyesight gradually deteriorates, shaping the world and the gameplay itself.Colors begin to fade, and the environment becomes more challenging to navigate. Yet, Emily remains a beacon of hope. When she is near, the world regains its vibrancy, symbolizing the power of love to illuminate even the darkest times.From childhood dreams to growing old together, The Last Light is a poignant exploration of life’s most meaningful moments and the bonds that help us through life's challenges.Gameplay:As a player, you step into the shoes of the protagonist, reflecting on his past. Early levels focus on beautifully crafted memories from childhood, where Emily guides you to uncover hidden recollections—represented as ghostly versions of yourself. Approaching these memories will trigger the protagonist’s inner thoughts, immersing you in his story.As his eyesight deteriorates, the gameplay changes. Blurriness, fading colors, and encroaching fog obscure your path, making navigation more challenging. Emily’s presence becomes essential in these moments, restoring color and clarity to the world, allowing you to move forward.The game offers a blend of exploration, narrative discovery, and puzzle-solving, where your emotional connection with Emily and her proximity directly affect how you perceive the world around you. As sight fades, emotions and memories become your strongest guides.Features:Story-Driven Exploration: Relive a man’s life through key moments as he reflects on love, loss, and the passage of time.Dynamic Visual Changes: Experience the world as the protagonist’s vision fades, with blurriness, fading colors, and fog altering the environment.Emotional Gameplay: Emily, the protagonist’s love, serves as both an emotional and visual anchor, restoring clarity to the world as your connection deepens.Narrative Memories: Uncover hidden memories that bring new layers to the protagonist's story, revealing his thoughts and feelings about past events.Beautifully Crafted Environments: Explore visually stunning levels that shift with the protagonist’s changing perception and emotional state.The Last Light offers a touching narrative experience that intertwines love, memory, and the passage of time. It’s a heartfelt exploration of how the bonds we form shape the way we see the world.

Detailed Description: Within her own garden, amidst soil and roots, there exists an abundant and nearly unexplored kingdom, full of secrets and challenges, where small lives can change an entire world.Play as Rafaela - After falling from her window while trying to catch a butterfly, and mysteriously waking up tiny in her enormous garden, Rafaela must discover how to help her new insect companions and find a way to return to her normal size.Uncover the mysteries of the evil plaguing the Lull Shire and discover the tragic fate of the Village of the Sun. Learn how a single evil can abruptly end many lives, and how these seemingly insignificant lives can be essential to the well-being of an entire ecosystem.Jardim das Borboletas is a 2D Metroidvania-style platformer adventure that presents an interconnected, magical, and vibrant world inspired by nature. You will explore vast environments, solve puzzles, and face mystical creatures as you fight to restore balance to a threatened enchanted garden.MAIN FEATURESExplore Rafaela's Garden Non-linearly - Walk along paths, logs, and branches, facing enemies, traps, and secret passages.Dynamic Combat - Use your pin and slingshot to battle crawling, hopping, slimy, and multi-limbed enemies.Epic Bosses - Progress by defeating challenging bosses, each with unique moves. They are obstacles between you and your goal—earn your right to victory.Uncover the Garden's Mysteries - Explore and understand the story of this world, so common to our eyes, from a tiny perspective. Why are these insects attacking? Where are the Monarch Butterflies? Who is the Hooded One? Play to discover these and many other intriguing mysteries.Artistic Style - Every scene, character, and enemy is carefully drawn in pixel art, creating a visually stunning and detailed environment that captivates and immerses the player.Soundtrack - The original soundtrack, specially composed for the game, complements the immersive experience, providing moments of tension, tranquility, and reflection that align with the narrative.Charismatic and Captivating Characters - Meet a variety of unique characters that influence the story and help Rafaela in her mission, with deep dialogues and interaction options.Puzzles - Solve clever puzzles, using new abilities to progress, unlock secrets, and restore balance in the garden.Storytelling Items - Collect objects and relics with revealing descriptions, offering insights into the history of this universe. Each item brings fragments of the past, helping to understand the characters' motivations and the garden’s mysteries, which you can use to write the future.

Detailed Description:
Challenge a game with a rather surreal worldview in which the player becomes a mosquito and sucks girls blood!
Mosquito simulator is a prank game in the type of simulation and survival.
You controls a mosquito named "Mister Mosquito" who has taken up residency in the house of the girl, life-sized humans that serve as the protagonist's food source in the game. The goal of the game is to stock up on blood through the summer so that the mosquito will survive the winter ahead. You are tasked with sucking blood from specific body parts of the girls without being noticed.
The challenge in bloodsucking is that each girl has a "stress meter". You must make sure that the girl stays unaware. Sucking too fast or too slow will increase the girl's stress level. If Mister Mosquito is swatted while sucking blood, instant death occurs. If your are noticed by the girl while flying around, Battle Mode begins, played out like a boss battle. The girl tries to attack Mister Mosquito through various means. To calm her, the player must hit a number of pressure points, relieving them of tension. Once they are relaxed enough, they return to their business.

Detailed Description: Step into a world of romance and flowers in this refreshingly mature otome that charts the lives of four couples, centered around a local flower shop.   ‘Him, the Smile & bloom’ is a unique exploration of the flourishing relationship between two adults and the highs and lows of their budding romance in a modern world.  From the initial spark of attraction to the struggles of maintaining a relationship and navigating life’s choppy waters - Him, the Smile & bloom, deftly weaves heart-warming - and heart-breaking - narrative threads for a genuinely distinct and memorable otome experience! Him, the Smile & Bloom charts four whirlwind romances - from the tender love of youth, to thorny, tumultuous and steamy. There are four distinct love matches to explore. Rather than one protagonist with a selection of love interests, Him, the Smile & Bloom instead focuses on the relationship between four couples and love interests - Wataru, Ginnosuke, Hokuto, and Tenya.Each couple has three endings to explore. However! Rather than traditional ‘good’ or ‘bad’ endings, each of the couple’s potential futures are poignant and offer something worthwhile to enjoy, regardless of the romantic (or not!) outcome.  By focusing on the growing relationship between four couples. Him, the Smile & bloom brings a unique maturity to the exploration of love and the lives of these couples.Wonderful character artwork and vibrant and detailed game world, combined with expressive voice work to really enhance the tenderness and emotion of each story. Completing the ‘Glow’ or ‘best’ ending to each couples’ story unlocks additional side stories to enjoy - bringing further life to these unforgettable characters.

Detailed Description: Platformer RPG about Felix the goblin who posses a demonic power of reincarnation! With it he must save his kind from eradication!Multiple story endingsCustomize gear / equipmentWorld map level selectionOptional rogue lite settings if you are up for the challenge!GameplayThe gameplay is inspired by early game Terraria and Downwell but with a story. You have multiple weapon options and a demonic arm that shoots fire balls. Levels are generated caverns in which you destroy dirt blocks to choose your path through the level. They have goals / achievements for replayability, similar to Yoshi's Island. For example finding 3 hidden gems. The controls give you twin stick shooter level of freedom with 360 dagree aiming. One of the coolest features is the death mechanic. Death is how you get access to the skill tree upgrades. This makes it less frustrating to die and gives you a fun reason to try again. StoryDesperate to save himself and his dying son, the king dispatches his holy army to collect goblin blood and mine for precious mana crystals that keep them alive. Felix, a goblin, makes a desperate pact with the demon Blood Root. Offering his body as a sacrifice, Felix gains immense power and the gift of reincarnation. His one hope lies in using this new strength to protect his remaining loved ones from the cruel fate that befell his brother at the hands of the king and his knights. Felix will keep fighting, even if it means dying over and over again.In this game dying is ok 👍(you reincarnate!)

Detailed Description: Tensor 1 is a first person shooter, a hybrid of the Greatest Generation shooter and Generation-X shooter sub-genres. The object of the game is to get from the beginning of the level to the end of the level, getting past all obstacles in the way, whether they be an environmental puzzle or enemy. It features two main game modes (Campaign, Survival), and a few fun extras.Campaign. Explore a series of levels that tell a story. Encounter up to 9 enemy types. Collect up to 4 weapons along the way, plus some fun environmental tools that can double as a weapon in a pinch (pick up and throw chairs at them!). Currently two story campaigns are available:Campaign A: 4 Levels, 15-60 minutes of gameplay, depending on secret hunting.Campaign B: 16 levels, 2-4 hours of gameplay, depending on secret hunting.Survival. Get past waves of enemies to try to clear as many levels in one run as possible. Collect tokens from defeated enemies that can be traded for supplies and upgrades in order to keep going.Randomized selection from a pool of 40 inventory and upgrade options, including 6 unique weapons, in order to survive an endless gauntlet of a randomized sequence of levels from a pool of 5 maps, brimming with a randomized selection of up to 6 enemy types.Extras. For Advanced Users seeking truly endless replay value, check out the Level Editor and build your own levels!
Short Description: Explore a strange facility of hostile robots while a friendly(?) robot(?) gives unhelpful suggestions.

Detailed Description: Welcome to 【Feminization Device】! As a warrior princess affiliated with the association, you patrol the city day and night, defeating demonic creatures that are lurking or attacking.Characters are divided into three types: melee, shooter, and special abilities. Each character has different charged attacks; some can set traps or barriers, while others can unleash high-damage long-range attacks.The current area status is displayed in the top-right mini-map. The smartphone interface can only be opened in the green zone. The yellow number above the smartphone button represents money, and the orange number below represents fame. Inside the smartphone, you can change outfits and characters, open the warehouse, use the shop, apply for teammates, and check other mission information.Entering the map screen, players can move from the current area to adjacent areas. The right column of buttons represents options for adjacent areas, and the enemy situation in each area is also indicated by color. The left buttons allow you to re-enter the original area. Pressing "City" displays the entire map. Green Zone: A safe area confirmed to be free of enemies. White Zone: An unknown area where demonic creatures are lurking, requiring cleanup. Yellow Zone: A conflict area controlled by gangs or invaded by demonic creatures, possibly with security forces depending on the location. Red Zone: Completely dominated by demonic creatures, with tentacle monsters continuing to invade adjacent areas.The goal of the Battle Maiden Association is to completely eradicate all demonic creatures in the city. The game is won when all areas are green zones. Conversely, the game is lost when all areas become red zones.Players need to eliminate all potential demonic creatures in this area.Demonic creatures lurking in the area appear no different from ordinary citizens, but once attacked, they immediately reveal their true form and begin attacking the player.Be careful not to accidentally harm ordinary citizens, as this may result in police intervention. If a player attacks civilians or police in the green zone, their fame will decrease.

Detailed Description: - Welcome to the Planet NESS-444 -  The Planet NESS-444 is a vast world full of Adventure, enemies to face or to have as  allies in battle, valuable resources to gather, mysteries and secrets to unveil.Climb the world's highest peaks to discover breathtaking views or wander into the depths of the planet to reveal ruins of ancient lost civilizations.Unique biomes scattered across the land waiting for you to explore them, until you are able to discover the truth...      - Nessky - The Nessky are the strange creatures that populate the planet Ness-444.During your adventure you will encounter a wide diversity of creatures, separated into four categories:-A minority dwell in shelters, offering you safe places to take refuge and prepare for the difficulties you will encounter.-The Nessky living in the wild were once friendly...but nowcorrupted and blinded by darkness you will be seen as a threat....-Some examples of the strongest species have fallen under the influence of natural gems and have developed powers extremely hard to counter.-Rare species from an adverse past will manifest as calamities, so do not be unprepared.    - Combat -Take on powerful enemies using a wide selection of melee weapons : (For now there are 20)-Swords (5)-Swords and Shields (6)-Greatswords (4)-Maces (3)-Giant Maces (2)Use your unnatural powers to cast devastating elemental spells : (For Now There Are 15)-Sphere of TimeFlame (3) -Meteorites of Fire (3)-Discharge of Volts (3)-Ice Runes (3)-Water Tornadoes (3)Gain experience by winning ferocious battles and level up to get new spells, crafting recipes and skill points that will help increase your stats :+ Life (HP)+ Endurance (Stamina)+ Wisdom (Mana)+ Strength (Melee Damage)+ Agility (Speed/Attack Speed)+ Intelligence (Spell Damage)+ Crit Chance (% critical hit)Defeat all the Nessky to discover new materials, weapons and equipment. Find and defeat bosses that carry natural gems to restore the balance of biomes.- Ghiandinis Guild -Visit the guild of Ghiandinis located in each of the nessky shelters. -Exchange various types of rare acorns found by defeating special nessky, completing quests and exploring secret locations.-Collect all the nessky relics crafted by a mysterious sculptor and hidden across the map and trade them  for special rewards.-Receive high-level special quests to obtain unique rewards and the possibility to visit inaccessible places.- Crafting -Strengthen yourself by forging powerful equipment and accessories that will help you in your adventure.Craft Devastating weapons such as swords and shields, broadswords, and giant maces.Craft and Find special equipments that can help you reach difficult locations like Highwind Castle or deadly areas like the lands of Toxmoria.By leveling up you will gain spells , skill points and new creations recipes for essential items such as potions, food and drink :-potions for life, stamina and mana speed and jump boosts. -foods of increased attack, critical hit and damage-drinks of defense, elemental shields and resistance from Heat/Cold.
Short Description: 3D Action Open World RPG set on the alien planet Ness-444. Explore this world on the brink of ruin with your inseparable companion Lupio. Fight or tame countless nessky, fantastic creatures now blinded by darkness. Survive to learn the truth of this world and find out where other like you have gone.

Game Name: 末日来袭-美漫风.策略.卡牌.游戏
Detailed Description: 「病毒爆发，幸存者联盟成立」不久的未来，一种未知的病毒迅速传播，将无数人变成了不死之物，丧尸横行于街头巷尾。末日降临得如此迅猛，人们无法及时做出反应。社会秩序迅速崩溃，陷入了混乱和恐慌。道斯也失去了亲人。在最初的混乱中，他被迫逃离家园，四处寻找避难所。城市已成了丧尸的领地，每一次行动都与死亡擦肩而过。偶然的机会中，遇到了其他幸存者。这个小团体成为了他的新家。大家汇聚在一起，共同面对着无尽的噩梦。团队里有军人、医生、技术专家，每个人都有着不同的技能，却共同追求生存的目标。「守护者，联合行动」夜幕降临，丧尸潮涌来，带着死亡的气息。团队必须联手合作，建立防线，消灭丧尸，争取每一分生存的机会。每个成员都肩负着特定的责任，有的负责巡逻，有的负责资源采集，有的负责研究丧尸的特性，以制定更有效的战略。资源稀缺，使得每一次选择都成为考验。是将有限的药品用于伤者，还是用于研制新的生存工具？是选择拯救陷入困境的幸存者，还是迅速撤离以保全团队？这些决策牵动着每个成员的心弦，也塑造着团队的命运。「制造工具，对抗丧尸进化」丧尸不断进化，幸存者成立实验室。在这里利用丧尸样本进行实验。有的工程师负责研究丧尸的生理特征；有的基于此制造新的武器，以提高消灭丧尸的效率。然而丧尸也在不断变异，使得每一天都是新的挑战。有的丧尸速度更快，有的具备更强的攻击力，有的甚至拥有更高的智慧。团队必须时刻保持警惕，不断适应敌人的变化。黎明来临之际，幸存者们用工具与智慧来对抗丧尸潮。随着夜幕降临，新的丧尸形态将浮现，而幸存者必须不断创新，制作更多武器，以便寻找生存的一线曙光。【特色一】屏住呼吸，巧妙破局踱步昏暗迷雾，需要运用身边工具化解危机，有限视野将挑战幸存者抗压心理，在诡秘的氛围中切记保持理智，找到破局生路！【特色二】灵活配队，出奇制胜面对40+恐怖怪物，幸存者需要活用营地招募的伙伴，灵活配队，出奇制胜！【特色三】交叉火力，搭建防线恐慌蔓延，怪物不断变异进化。在末日中结识其他幸存者，编织火力网，搭建希望防线，携手守卫最后的人类家园。
Short Description: 随着一阵警报声响起，痛苦的尖叫声如同丧钟被敲响，致命的病毒把城市变成了死城。你的敌人不仅仅有丧尸，还有为了生存的掠夺者......

Detailed Description: Play as physically and mentally exhausted junior student Rin, and experience the gradual process of a middle schooler being driven insane by her family, suffering from bipolar disorder. You can choose to believe your parents over and over again, or you can choose to be wary of them from the start.When reality and illusion begin to intertwine, can you really guarantee that you won't be trapped in a dream?The player needs to keep clicking to continue the story and choose at certain points to experience different plots.Different options lead to different plots, but the ending is doomed because it's a memory, not the future.“I guessed I really didn't deserve it. Because I didn't do my part. I didn't deserve my parents, my teachers, my classmates, my friends. I didn't deserve anything in this world. It was not surprising. I was born with nothing anyway.”

Detailed Description: 化身飞升者，从高维度接入超次元，审视由你的数个前世构成的景观宇宙。藉由一台移动终端展开漫游，从90s的网络空间到大西洋的马尾藻海；邂逅形形色色的生命——宇宙人、机械修道士，以及地球的最后一只恐龙。在一切的尽头，宇宙、自我和生命的终极答案，将为你解开面纱。这是一场没有压力的奇妙虚拟漫步。游戏无死亡及失败条件，所有的结局动画后，作为飞升者的玩家能够马上返回更早的时间线。当一切落幕，无事可做时，你可以选择回到网络控制台，与你的好友Rain一同虚度时光。

Detailed Description: Stock Market Tycoon: Challenge is the ultimate multiplayer stock market investment game where you can put your trading skills to the test, competing with players from around the world, to outperform your competitors and become an investment tycoon! The game provides a realistic and dynamic stock trading experience in a simulated fast-paced economy. Manage your portfolio, either searching for the best dividend returns or making short term gains from momentum trading. Each "season" lasts one month, with dividend returns daily.Key Features:Real-Time Stock Market Simulation: Trade live stocks in a simulated economy and manage your portfolio in a real-time simulated stock exchange. Buy, sell, and hold shares to maximise your profit and outperform other players.Multiplayer Competition: Challenge friends or compete with thousands of players globally in a battle for returns. Every percentage gain will count against your competitors. Rise up the leaderboard and showcase your skills, proving you are the ultimate Stock Market Investor.Seasonal Competition: Each season lasts one month (allowing for 28-31 "years" of dividends). Competition will be fierce as investors scramble to maximise portfolio returns.Leaderboards, Rankings and Ratings: All active players are ranked in the season will be ranked, and an overall investment rating will be calculated from your overall performance across many seasons.Awards: Players earn awards for achieving trading profit milestones, as well as ranking well at the end of a season. Accumulate and show off your awards.In-Game Market Events, News & Recommendations: Market news provides players with timely information on changes and performance of the overall economy, individual sectors or stocks. Keep up to date, and make timely portfolio decisions.Portfolio Management: Trade for the long term, seeking high dividend yields, or trade more frequently, chasing the short-term trading gains. There are multiple paths to success; be first, be smarter, or be sneaky.Create Investment Firms: Create and investment firm and join with your friends. Play competitively or cooperatively to ensure your firm ranks among the highest. There are no rules here against working together to manipulate the market. (Not saying you should, but not saying you shouldn't...)Why play Stock Market Tycoon: Challenge?Are you fascinated by the world of stocks and investments? Do you think you have what it takes to dominate the stock market and outperform the competition? Do you just love the challenge and enjoy seeing your value increase? Whether you are working toward your own goals, or fighting over the leaderboards, Stock Market Tycoon: Challenge gives you the perfect platform to test your trading abilities in a fast-paced, competitive environment. The game combines entertainment and education, making it ideal for players who want to improve their financial literacy while having fun.

Detailed Description: Space Atlas: The Solar System is an interactive educational app that takes you on a journey through the wonders of our universe. This app is designed to educate and inspire users of all ages by providing detailed and engaging content about the cosmos.Multi-Chapter Education ProjectSpace Atlas: The Solar System is the first chapter of a multi-chapter education project. This chapter focuses on the wonders of our Solar System, including its planets, moons, and other celestial bodies. Future chapters will expand to cover Galaxies, Stars, Exoplanets, Cosmology, and more. Stay tuned for more!Discover The PlanetsAccess detailed information about each planet's atmosphere, surface, and key features. Use interactive tools to learn more about what makes each planet unique, from Saturn's rings to Mars' canyons.Play GamesDive into engaging mini-games where you’ll pilot your spacecraft, landing on the moon and other celestial bodies. These fun and interactive challenges deepen your understanding of space missions and the complexities of landing on different terrains. Explore the cosmos and enjoy a hands-on learning adventure like never before!Test Your KnowledgeTest your knowledge with Space Atlas: The Solar System quizzes! Challenge yourself with questions about the planets and other celestial bodies in our solar system. Compete with others and climb the leaderboards to see who knows the most about the cosmos. Detailed Description: This is a shooting game where you blow away a futon with a rocket launcher.The player set out on a journey with his partner Rocket Launcher to clean the Futon.The goal is a cleaning spot 1km away. You can compete with players from all over the world to see how far the futon flies.

Detailed Description: Bonnie Blob in ShapevilleAn Adorable Interactive Storybook Adventure for Kids!   Welcome to Shapeville, a colorful world filled with friendly shapes and endless fun! Meet Bonnie Blob, a bubbly little hero with a curious mind and a heart full of adventure. Along with her best friend Tiffany Triangle, Bonnie explores the whimsical corners of Shapeville, where every click brings something delightful to life!📖Four Playful AdventuresThis charming storybook game includes four interactive books, each with its own heartwarming tale:   - Bonnie’s Day Trip: Join Bonnie and her Mum on their day trip to see Tiffany Triangle!- Bonnie’s Day at the Beach: Enjoy a sunny day full of sandcastles, meeting aquatic creatures, and beachy surprises!- Bonnie’s Birthday: Help Bonnie celebrate her special day with friends, presents, and cake. - The Quest for the Missing Puzzle Piece: Go on an adventure to find a lost puzzle piece with Bonnie and Tiffany’s help!   🎮 How to PlayDesigned for kids ages 2 and up, the gameplay is simple and intuitive—just click on objects in each scene and watch them come to life with fun animations and cheerful sounds! There’s no pressure, no time limits, and no wrong way to play—perfect for little ones just learning how to interact with digital experiences. 🌈 Key Feature- Engaging animations that bring the story and characters to life. - Kid-friendly controls: just click and enjoy! - Charming art and music that create a cozy, playful atmosphere.   - Ideal for parents and young children to enjoy together.   - Encourages exploration and curiosity through interactive scenes.   Give your little one a magical journey with Bonnie Blob and her friends! Whether it’s a beach day or a birthday party, there’s always something new to discover in Shapeville.Bonnie Blob and Shapeville is a gentle, joyful experience that celebrates friendship, exploration, and fun - the perfect first adventure for your young gamer!

Unfortunately for you, the security of the bank is top notch, and the vault unbreakable. Being only equipped with your wits, skills, and a bag full of criminal gadgets, you must make full use of your brain power to overcome the challenges that await you. Solve Puzzles From deductive reasoning to security devices of all kind, you will face a wide variety of puzzles that will test your logical thinking skills, as you try to finish your job. Explore and Discover You will get to explore a extravagant bank as you take on its many challenges. There will be plenty of hidden collectibles for you to find as you try to pull off the heist. Work Together Play solo or work together with friends, in up to 5-player multiplayer. So, pick up a friend or four, and go heisting together!

Detailed Description: JellyStar is a cute hand drawn 2D platformer designed for all ages. Playing the game feels like you are controlling a cartoon in which you are the director.Set on the island of Screaming Tortoise, JellyStar allows you to choose from one of 12 cute characters each based on a different vegetable. Travel the beautiful autumnal lands of Quartz moving north to the lush green plains of Onyx and then to the extreme northern icy lands of Opal. To the west lies Ruby, a baking hot desert like island filled with pyramids and temples.With over 50 levels JellyStar is an epic adventure with multiple types of action such as: platforming, plane flying, caving, mine carting and even betting, trading and management. Collect moon potions which allow your character to grow in size and speed, until they almost won’t fit on the screen! Expect huge chunky beautiful hand drawn enemies and worlds backed by amazing classical music in chip tune style. This is one cartoon adventure the whole family can enjoy together.With 2 player local coop you and a friend can sit back and enjoy a night of wonder as you feast your eyes and ears on hand crafted levels set over many different biomes. By collecting gems, coins and golden statues you can become a trader in one of the 4 big cities, sell high, buy low to amass your fortune and even purchase the restaurant of your dreams. Hire a team and manage the profit by tweaking the menu and layout of your establishment.With a distinct 80s platformer feel reminiscent of the Mario games, this is one cartoon extravaganza not to be missed. Thousands of hours have been painstakingly spent hand drawing genuinely adorable 2D art as well as developing interesting game mechanics, power-ups and oodles of secrets. Replay each level to improve your score and time, even competing against your own ghost character.JellyStar always feels alive with its cast of over 50 characters and enemies who each have their own home town and can travel freely between any level they please. Collect the 50 chunks of the JellyStar to rebuild it and bring peace and happiness back to the land.Beware of the crazy chef “Singing Hinny” who is hell bent on capturing you to make you an ingredient of his perpetual stew! Other enemies include fellow JellyStar hunters who will try to take your archeological finds from you, these include the legendary clown “Grimaldi”, beautiful alien princess “Jane” and even the venerable Bede, a priest with a lust for power.Your special abilities include becoming a huge bullet which can tear through levels in no time.

Detailed Description: Killer Depths is a submarine horror game. Study the monsters that lurk below and adjust the settings on your vessel according to what you think is currently stalking you. FEATURES Over a dozen different creatures haunt the waters. Many can not be seen or heard, requiring more intuitive investigation.The brightness, noise and the speed of the vessel will attract or scare off monsters.Monster attacks can cause flooding, power outages and explosions. Use tools to keep the vessel from imploding.Vigilant divers may uncover encrypted messages revealing details about the world and their employer.What you see and hear may not be real.GAMEPLAYYou are the lone crew member of a submarine tasked with retrieving cargo that has landed on the ocean floor.  Each day you will be given an updated bestiary of potential threats in the water and all known information on how to avoid them. Keep the lights on and windows open to spot predators swimming around; then again, you may need to turn the lights off and keep the windows closed to pass by creatures that relay on sight.The submarine's CO2 Scrubber is the only thing providing you with breathable air, but you may need to shut it down to lower your noise levels, just don't forget to turn it back on. Photography, Thermal Vision, a Radio Headset and Sonar are some of the many tools scattered around the submarine you will use to detect what might be out there.Anger a monster and it will attack, causing heavy damage, system malfunctions, fires, water leaks and other issues you will need to fix, all while figuring out what could have attacked you. Retrieve the target without crashing into the sea floor, and try not to die on your way back to the surface.
Short Description: Pilot a submarine in a horrific, deep sea expedition. Study the monsters the lurk below and look for their signs. Adjust your speed, noise and light levels to scare off, or hide from whatever you think is out there. Poor judgment will lead to a watery grave.

Game Name: Some Jello and a Hard Place
Detailed Description: Overview:Some Jello and a Hard Place is about getting your Jello cube to the top of an obstacle course style map. The catch? While on paper this act seems simple, actually attempting to carry out these actions can prove to be... really excruciatingly difficult. As you ascend, the fear of falling grows more prevalent. The lava that burns all of your progress becomes more noticeable too. But will you give up? Will you let this game best you? You can only find out for $3.Controls:Two Jump buttons, Left and Right. The 4 control system will work on all re-programmable button pads, Xbox One Controllers (PS Controllers not tested yet), and Keyboards. The controls are simple to pick up, easy to master, and have just the right amount of jank. Since the controls are so simple: they are easily accessible to anyone with mobility disabilities.Levels:Each level start off simple enough, but doesn't stay that way. Every level gets exponentially harder as you ascend. With every jump, hazards seem to close in and keep you anxious. With no checkpoints, you are always one mistake from losing everything. Just because you found a landing patch, doesn't mean you're safe.

Detailed Description: Shadow Alchemist is an isometric pixel art game that blends puzzle-solving and reality-bending alchemy. Awaken in the depths of a shadowy dungeon, you'll embark on a journey of self-discovery and transformation that challenges your perception of reality itself.Key Features:Alchemical Abilities: Master the art of self-transmutation, unlocking powers that allow you to become invincible, shrink to minuscule sizes, and even create duplicate of yourself.Mind-Bending Puzzles: Navigate through increasingly complex environmental challenges that require creative use of your alchemical abilities.Light Combat: Engage in occasional skirmishes with wandering enemies, or use your wit and timing to avoid confrontation altogether.Recursive Mystery: Experience a narrative that evolves with each "escape," as subtle changes in the dungeon and your own memories hint at a greater truth.As you delve deeper into the dungeon's secrets, you'll uncover startling truths about your own nature and the reality that surrounds you. Can you master the alchemical abilites, overcome the challenges, and ultimately unravel the mystery of your past?

Detailed Description: "201 - The Bad Number" is an interactive science fiction game-book set in a post-apocalyptic Mars. In a world where only 200 people remain, each new inhabitant may hasten the end of civilization. You step into this harsh reality and confront a pivotal event—the emergence of the "bad number." Now players must make choices that will impact the future of humanity and the fate of the colony.Key Features:A branching narrative where every action influences the course of events.Immersion in an unusual dystopian world of Mars, where each decision will resonate throughout the entire history of humanity.A deep storyline with philosophical themes about time, the multiverse, and fate.Simple controls for engaging storytelling and complex decision-making.Note: The translation of the game was done using a neural network, so there may be errors.

Detailed Description: Welcome to the Middle World - a purgatory dimension where people's souls go to after they die. In the Middle World people have to complete tasks to atone for their wrongdoings or settle any unfinished matters and emotional traumas before their final destination can be decided.As a newly arrived, Julius has to seek forgiveness of those whose lives he ruined in life. But with no memories of his Earth life, the task wouldn't be easy. He has to make friends and connections and find out more about this world - a world that exists in a permanent twilight time of the day, has a futuristic cyberpunk flare, and where it is impossible to die, while pain and suffering are all as real as they can be.While uncovering our past and facing its challenges, we also must face the ever-unpredictable politics and dangers of the Middle World, with different groups contending for power and influence, covert alliances and secret deals, and parasitic creatures that feed on people's suffering. And perhaps in the midst of this chaos we can build a meaningful connection with someone, whose fate will intertwine with our own and seal our final path.General Features:A visual novel with choices to make on how to act or what to say, which impacts our standing with others, as well as some of the future events and endings.Relationship and trust building with different individuals and even a faction. From these, there are three different romantic interests to build a deeper connection with.Three attributes: Virtue, Callosity, and Defiance. How we act will cause different attributes to increase, which in turn can unlock some dialogue options and even entire game endings.Uncover the mystery of Julius' past and what brought him to this world to seek forgiveness.16 different endings that depend on our decisions and the relationships we've built.Fully-rendered 3D images of characters and events as they unfold in each scene.

Detailed Description: 《最强猎手》一款二次元暗黑风格的回合制角色扮演卡牌游戏，在这个游戏里面玩家可以收集不同稀有度和强度的角色卡牌，组合成小队挑战不同的副本，获取材料对角色进行培养，提升等级和能力强化。《最强猎手》游戏亮点:1.独特的画风:游戏采用了黑暗饥荒系的美术风格，为玩家带来了独特的视觉体验。2.一键挂机:游戏内置一键挂机功能，让玩家即使离线也能继续升级，轻松成英雄。3.数百个英雄:游戏中聚集了100多个各具特色的英雄供玩家收集和开发，满足了爱好者的收集欲望。4.策略搭配:玩家可以根据英雄的特点自由搭配阵容，进行多种策略组合。5.暗黑风格：《最强猎手》是一款以暗黑风格为主题的角色养成冒险闯关游戏{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/5e23b03b-6dff-46bc-981c-fe02c0c47411.jpg最强猎手最强阵容：一、阵容推荐： 1. 巴卡尔、阿撒兹勒、卢克力、梅普璐、露可娜娜（主C巴卡尔）2. 杰克、巴卡尔、阿撒兹勒、梅普璐、露可娜娜（双C） 3. 杰克、梅普璐、卢克力、露可娜娜、莉莉丝4. 赫敏琳、塔莎娜、卢克力、露可娜娜、梅普璐（主C赫敏琳，副C塔莎娜）二、资源优先级1、魂玉、星牌、装备、觉醒、魔法石、圣器（有活动的情况下，缺什么换什么） ；2、优先把本体升到13-15星；3、 众神先升星到13以上，可以白嫖很多资源。 三、前期攻略： 1、前期优先把加速特权开了，等级前期千万不要落下，否则后面很多功能没办法跟上，开启不了；2、众神是4个英雄和50个碎片合成的，不要200碎片合，不要200碎片合成！！！切记！切记！五、魔宠推荐：究极暴龙兽-彩虹星猫-时空战熊-恶魔史莱姆 六、狗粮攻略：1、碎片合成、招募都是狗粮的来源主要获取通道，基本上三系都是狗粮，随便吃2、众神狗粮问题：众神需要吃光暗系10星狗粮 不够怎么办呢 可以先把一个暗系英雄上到15星 然后回退你就会得到很多暗系9星 10星的狗粮 光系也是如此操作 【用3系的狗粮给光暗升星 然后用光暗的回退狗粮给众神升星】 最强猎手游戏特点:1.佛系:不需要花太多时间在线游戏，通过挂机机制就可以轻松成型。2.丰富的道具和装备:游戏提供了大量的道具和装备供玩家收集和使用，增强英雄的能力。3.创意画面:充满想象力的创意画面设计，让游戏世界更加生动有趣。4.异世界冒险:玩家可以带领英雄们踏上神秘的异世界冒险之旅，完成各种任务和挑战。5.角色养成：玩家可以收集和养成各种英雄角色，激活角色羁绊，提升战斗力。最强猎手游戏优势:1.无付费墙无付费墙:即使是非付费玩家也能享受到优质的游戏体验，不会因为没有付费而落后。2.极致游戏体验:无论是画质还是游戏性，都力求给玩家极致的享受。3.各种英雄组合:上百种英雄组合，让玩家可以根据自己的喜好和策略来搭配。4.定期更新:游戏将定期更新，以保持游戏的新鲜和动态。5.策略对抗：游戏强调策略性，玩家需要根据敌人的特点来搭配英雄和装备{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/89135c72-f9f5-4113-8717-4a12454abc30.jpg

Detailed Description: On August 15, 1945, Japan announced unconditional surrender!About the GameGame BackgroundNew Battle of Shanghai Beach is a shooting gameIn the game, you need to complete a series of unlikely tasks alone on Shanghai Beach! Carry out missions along the locations in the game such as HSBC Bank, pier, racecourse, Jardine Matheson&Co., Union Church Suzhou River/Baidu Bridge, Broadway, Japanese Concession Embassy, and Hongkou Grand Theatre! After breaking through layers of blockades, enter the enemy headquarters and clear the last big boss to complete the mission. During the clearance period, you must first confront enemy soldiers and ninjas of all sizes Wait for the NPC and engage in a series of life and death battles. In short, after using some weapons to kill many enemies, you can then kill the biggest boss to complete the mission!brief overview【Attention】The game is played in full screen mode with a default resolution of 800x600, and the resolution cannot be adjusted. When the game is played in window mode, if you switch to full screen mode, the game resolution will automatically be based on your desktop resolution, and the game clarity will also be better than the default full screen mode【 Comrades Alliance 】 Button Function DescriptionIn the game interface, clicking on the Comrade Alliance option will quickly switch to the desktop. If the game runs in default full screen mode (800x600) resolution, then when you click on Comrade Alliance to switch to the desktop, you will see that the desktop also changes to 800x600 resolution. This is normal. If you click on Comrade Alliance while running in windowed mode and switch to the desktop, it will be the desktop resolution you originally setInstructions for in-game buttonsYou can control shooting with the left mouse button in the game! Replace magazine              Press the R key to pause the game                                                                                                Press the P key For other detailed instructions                                                                              please refer to the game guide, which can be opened in the game startup option!

Detailed Description: Soar through the sections of a giant spaceship, hurling grenades and bombs at enemies. A head-on attack won’t always work, so maneuver and choose your path wisely. Change the level’s geometry to open new routes and gain an advantage. And just enjoy the shooting and flying!
