Detailed Description: Explore the post-apocalyptic landscape of Westervoort, Loo and Arnhem through the eyes of a survivor.Navigate, uncover, and puzzle your way to the conclusion.Echoes of Asjud is a Short Story / Busy Life Game, a visual novel that tells the tale of an ordinary boy in a potential near future, where artificial intelligence has taken control.This is a game you can complete in just a few hours, allowing you to relax as you progress through the story, meet characters, and perhaps form your own vision of what you expect from the (near?) future.Having grown up in the 80's with games on a 286 (and on) computer, it has always been hard to let go of the love for the artform that is a game. When hitting 40, after doing a couple of game jams, it was time to make a small story game from scratch to finish, right here on Steam.I've never told stories, but to my son. So the game is an experiment, trying to learn how to publish a game and how to tell a story. And after working in IT for over 20 years, it's a great means to share thoughts on a possible future with or without A.I.So THANK YOU for trying this game and / or checking out this Steam page. It means a lot to me!Even though this is an experimental game, I will publish updates and keep the game updated as well as fix bugs wherever needed.The main GOAL is to start off with a second hand store shop owner game after this.More news / updates on that propably during the start of 2025 (already!). So keep posted! :)

Try to survive until the timer runs out, and don't get tricked by the creature.

Detailed Description: TorchR Runners: Demastered is a retro, co-op puzzle platformer that tests your wit, sanity, and teamwork. In a world shrouded in darkness, you and your fellow players carry torches that slowly extinguish. As your light fades, so does your sanity. Teamwork is crucial to overcome the puzzles ahead, and if your torches or sanity deplete, the game is lost.While the controls are simple and intuitive, mastering the puzzles requires clever cooperation and quick thinking. The deeper you go, the more challenging the levels become, making finishing the game an almost impossible? feat.In this eerie, ever-changing world, each level is a new challenge, from short and intense sprints to longer, multi-part stages with safe zones. The faster you complete levels, the more coins you earn – but beware, your coins drain over time. Use your hard-earned coins to buy extra sanity or lives at scattered shops, but don’t linger too long – time and resources are limited!The heart of the experience is cooperation. Designed for two-player puzzles, but open to any number of participants, the game’s shared pool of lives means everyone must work together to survive. Each failure takes a toll on the group – and the sadistic narrator, "The Torcherer," is more than happy to mock your every misstep. Laughing at your failures, showing off death photos, and reminding you just how fragile teamwork can be, he’s there to make sure you don’t forget your mistakes.Can you and your team survive the torch, the dark, and the unrelenting taunts of the Torcherer?Key FeaturesCo-op Puzzle Platformer – Every puzzle is designed for two players, though any number can join in. Collaboration is key to success!Simple Controls, Challenging Gameplay – Easy to pick up with simple controls, but mastering the puzzles will test even the most skilled players. Shared Lives & Sanity – All players share the same pool of lives and sanity, meaning each death or misstep affects the entire team.Race Against Time – Your coins drain with every second, pushing you to solve puzzles quickly to save more for shops along the way.Dynamic Narrator – The “Torcherer” mocks your every move, capturing your most embarrassing deaths and throwing them back in your face.Retro Visuals – Featuring sharp pixel textures and low-poly 3D models, the visuals pay homage to classic platformers while embracing a dark and eerie tone.Jump Scares & Tension – Face monsters and eerie surprises as you race to keep your sanity, with heart-pounding jump scares thrown into the mix.
Short Description: Carry your flickering torch through perilous puzzles in this retro-inspired cooperative platformer. Work together to keep your sanity intact, beat mind-bending challenges, and survive the misanthropic taunts of the "Torcherer" – all while racing against time before your light runs out!

Detailed Description: TURN-BASED STRATEGY OF THE NEW GENERATIONIn this game, strategic decisions are more important than reflexes. You will find exciting single and multiplayer modes, as well as earning levels and rewards. Play in strategic standard mode, quick mode, and also in pairs mode with a friend. The main goal of the game is to stay alive longer than your opponent. A huge list of creatures, heroes, artifacts, skills and abilities will help the player enjoy the game as if he were playing it for the first time, while he is familiar with the basic mechanics and principles of the game.STRATEGY IS THE WAY TO VICTORY: Eight players enter the game space, and each player has a chessboard-like board (version of it) on which they can place their units. All actions will take place on this field.Before the start of each battle, players will be presented with one + one for each subsequent round increase in creatures from a certain faction.Units can then be dragged from the hero’s pocket onto the battlefield, after which the battle itself will begin. At least 70% of the total units in the player’s pocket must be located on the battlefield. Units that survive the battle will be available in the next battle.At the end of each round you will receive some items. At certain intervals in the match, more valuable items will be available to you.At the end of each round you will receive money depending on how well you performed. You will use gold to increase unit growth. At the end of each round, you will receive experience regardless of how well you performed, after which you will be able to choose one of the hero upgrades. EXP increases your character's level, which increases the number of units you can place on the battlefield, as well as the ability to increase the growth of more expensive units in the store.Since players are beaten in separate rounds, they will slowly fall out of the running. This is a smart approach to composition and saving of your team to increase your chances of being the last man standing.Essentially, your goal is to create a strong hero, form an army suitable for him and overcome the conflict by winning rounds and spending your gold and experience wisely. FRACTIONS: Before you start the main game, you will be given the opportunity to choose one of three playable races. The set of these races is provided to the player randomly, since 4 playable races will be available in the game (44 playable fractions at a later stage of development). The  player will also have access to a second one-time random chance to choose a fraction.HEROES: After choosing a fraction, you will be given the opportunity to choose one of three fraction heroes. As before, a set of these heroes is provided to the player randomly, since the game will have 12 playable heroes for each race (20 heroes at a more advanced stage of development, which will make it possible to increase their number to 800). The player will also have access to a second one-time random chance to choose a hero.Each hero and unit has unique active or passive abilities, which allows you to have a huge number of combinations to create your own game strategy. By improving certain abilities of the hero, it makes sense to hire certain units into the army.Your character’s level determines how many units you can place on the battlefield. Don't neglect this! There is a serious advantage that can be gained by having one extra troop on the battlefield than your opponents.If you place your units correctly, success awaits you! Try to place units correctly, so that those with a lot of HP and close combat stand closer to the enemy, and those who are weaker in HP and have long-range combat are behind.ARTIFACTS: After choosing a hero, you will be given the opportunity to choose one of three items. As in previous cases, a set of these items is provided to the player randomly, since about 250 will be available in the game (up to 400 at more advanced stages of development). The player will also have access to a repeated one-time random selection of an item.after each battle you will receive at least one item to choose from.Once you have made your choice, the item will appear in your inventory. You can then select and drag onto the hero the item that you think will provide the greatest benefit.When you equip items, think about how it will benefit the hero or specific unit. Also, do not forget about items that do not affect the hero and units on the battlefield, but improve your economy. Choose wisely.Duel 2x2:“Duel 2×2” differs from the regular mode in that you and your friend are asked to choose a faction and a hero, and the battle takes place between four heroes at once on the same battlefield.“Duel 2x2” is a more complex mod of the same game, which requires understanding and developing of common strategy with your ally.BATTLE PASSWith the launch of Season 1, the game will feature a Battle Pass with a huge number of rewards. Play, complete tasks to increase the pass level and earn rewards: new courses, skins, profile changes, costumes and other cosmetic in-game items. Many of these rewards are free, just play the game. And if you want more rewards and content, you can purchase a single Battle Pass for all platforms. The paid Battle Pass is not required to play and does not provide any in-game advantages.CROSS-PLATFORM PLAY Play on any device and battle players from all over the world with cross-platform play. In a hurry? Start a game on your computer and continue it on your smartphone (or vice versa). Your game profile is synced across all devices, so your progress is saved wherever you play.RANKED MATCHMAKING Everyone starts at the bottom, but by fighting other heroes you will rise through the ranks and prove yourself worthy of the Ramesh reward.OFFLINE PLAY Sophisticated AI lets you hone your skills even when you're offline. Or, if you want, just pause the game.SEASONAL UPDATE Each season we will increase the number of factions, heroes, items, abilities and skills to satisfy the most sophisticated players. The game world never stops evolving!

You will fly a US fighter to experience a series of campaign maps, in the campaign, shoot down enemy fighters can get some random rewards, including ammunition, fuel, repair kits, honor points. Among them, honor points can be used in the "hangar" to buy new fighters or upgrade machine guns and cannons. Detailed Description: DescriptionHow were the pyramids really built? What was the connection between the ancient Egyptians and alien beings? Is the legend of Amenti real? To find the answers, you must enter the newly discovered tomb of Rudamon, a terrifying site buried 50 meters underground. No one has dared to explore its endless, dark corridors—until now. According to legend, entering this tomb disturbs the pharaoh’s spirit and his royal family, with disastrous consequences.In Amenti, you play as a historian and photographer, willing to risk it all to uncover the truth about Amenti and the ancient Egyptians' supposed connection with extraterrestrials.Gameplay Amenti is a horror game that takes you deep into the dark secrets of ancient Egypt. You’ll explore your surroundings like a true historian, investigating mysterious artifacts and discovering hidden truths. The game features a photography mechanic, where you capture images of various subjects. At first, you might only notice frightening details in your photos, but as you progress, the horror will reveal itself in real time.Realistic graphics and high-quality 3D sound fully immerse you in the eerie atmosphere of a 5,000-year-old mysterious structure.

Detailed Description: A casual roguelite game featuring a rich variety of classes, a vast array of equipment, and different types of enemies. After defeating a certain number of enemies, your class will randomly switch, with each class having multiple variants, each offering unique skills. You can fight solo, or invite friends to join your game or team up with other players online. Experience different classes, explore numerous skills, uncover hidden content, and find the equipment that best suits your playstyle. Defeat the final boss and enjoy the thrill of cooperative gameplay as you and your team conquer the game together!------------------------------Class------------------------------The game offers a wide variety of classes to play, with each class having 15 different variants, and each variant's skills come with different enhancements.------------------------------Controls------------------------------The controls are simple, using only up, down, left, and right movements, with the character's direction following the mouse. Each game lasts 30 minutes, providing a fast-paced and tightly structured experience.------------------------------Online Play------------------------------You can fight alone or team up with friends, or join other players' rooms to battle together. As long as one player remains alive, everyone can revive infinitely!------------------------------Gameplay------------------------------Defeating enemies earns you gold, which can be used to purchase equipment in the shop. Equipment can be strengthened through crafting.

Detailed Description: Step into the haunting world of "Phantom Asylum", a gripping VR psychological horror game that will test both your courage and your sanity. Explore the dark, abandoned halls of a long-forgotten mental institution, where ghostly presences and disturbing visions blur the line between reality and madness.In "Phantom Asylum", it’s not just the lurking phantoms you need to fear, but also your own mind. With every turn, your perception of reality grows more unstable. Will you be able to keep your sanity intact, or will you fall victim to the illusions that stalk you? The only way out is to solve the asylum’s twisted mysteries and confront the horrors waiting for you in the shadows.Atmospheric Horror: Immerse yourself in the chilling environment of a haunted mental asylum where every shadow hides a secret.Mind-Bending Gameplay: Face psychological challenges as reality distorts and your mind is pushed to its limits.Immersive VR Experience: Feel every moment of fear and tension in this fully realized virtual reality horror adventure.Puzzles and Secrets: Uncover the dark past of the asylum by solving puzzles and uncovering hidden clues.Surviving this asylum isn’t just about bravery; it’s about keeping your mind intact. Will you escape, or will you be consumed by the madness within "Phantom Asylum"?

Detailed Description: In the park of lights and cheer,Big Jinx the clown was loved so dear.But envy’s shadows crept so near,He was murdered filled with despair.Returning from midnight’s sphere,his bloody hammer turned joy into fear.Grandma told me,what was hidden behind smiles,were tears.What is the game about:Today is your first day working at this amusement park. You have only one job: to work the night shift. Detailed Description: 故事背景在这个被称为魔大陆的土地上，一个混沌动荡的年代里，四位传奇英雄挺身而出，力抗邪神，将世界从黑暗的深渊中拯救出来。然而，和平并未长久。十多年后，圣卡隆帝国与伯卡德王国因国界之上的稀有金属资源爆发了激烈的战争，战火再度燃起。曾经守护世界的四位英雄神秘失踪，盖亚教派与弥约教的暴力冲突、神秘的盗贼团也趁机四处作乱，战场上还有神出鬼没且无情冷酷的魔剑士...这一切似乎都在预示着更大的事件将会发生。纷争背后，是未知的力量在操控着一切，还是新的英雄即将崛起？在这混乱的时代，命运的齿轮已开始转动...游戏玩法这是一款经典的类火纹战棋游戏，以回合制进行游戏。通过 AP 系统可让角色在一次战斗中可进行多次攻击，战斗不再是单纯可有可无的动画。共有 21 位的可控角色，每名角色都有其精美的立绘以及战斗风格。145 件武器和道具，特殊武器还拥有各种各样的特性，充分利用才能发挥出武器最大的价值。29 种角色职业，每个职业都有自己优劣势，高级职业还拥有自己的特色技能。26 种角色技能，通过职业和技能让每个角色都与众不同。

Detailed Description: Dark Manor is a single-player, first-person horror game. Explore the manor and collect the amulets that will allow you to escape this cursed place. Different types of monsters and creatures inhabit this old, dilapidated mansion, and you'll need to avoid them to successfully make your escape.EXPLORE, LEARN, WINYour first journey in the manor will start as an exploration. Then, death after death, you will learn how to avoid your enemies and discover their weaknesses. Sooner or later, the manor will turn into a race against time and death, and it is up to you to master it.CUSTOMIZE YOUR PLAYSTYLEIn for a quick game? Or maybe you want to take your time? Choose the number of amulets you will need to retrieve to find your way out.Play with your controller or keyboard (Azerty and Qwerty ready).Choose the difficulty that suits you best: While the main monster will always haunt your steps, you can activate or deactivate other monsters if they bother you. Especially if you're arachnophobic, don’t worry! You can remove spiders from the game via the main menu !VARIOUS MONSTERSEvery monster has a different way of finding you. While some will rely only on their sight, others will be sensitive to light, sound, or the speed of your movements. So be careful—if you break something loudly or run around too much, you might just wake something up !TRY SOMETHING DIFFERENTWhether you own a powerful or basic computer, you can enjoy Dark Manor’s optimized map. Set the settings to "Low" and unlock a whole new hidden level !Now it's up to you, but be careful... the manor has its own rules.Good luck!

Detailed Description: Traverse Colour Space is a maze game where as the player you navigate though a level collecting paint to increase your score as you move. The path taken though the level can make a large difference to the end score.A Hamiltonian Path is a path though a complexly connected set of nodes where each node is visited once and only once. Traverse Colour Space follows a similar logic usually known as a path of best fit (but that's not as catchy).  As you move you will paint visited tiles however, painted tiles cannot be revisited so you will need to plan your way carefully.Collect paint from around the levels to increase your 3 colour values each time you move you gain points based on these 3 values. However to maximise points you will need to make use of the colour bonus zones in each map that grant additional points for being painted the correct colour.
Short Description: Traverse Colour Space is a maze game where the player is also building walls as they move. Similar to a Hamiltonian Path the player must find the best path of best fit though each level to maximise their points. As the player collects paint they gain more points as they move about.

Detailed Description: Welcome to Vietnam, son!Step into the shoes of a MACV-SOG specialist during the Second Indochina War in a turn-based, tactical, old-school 2D roguelite!Every mission is a brutal new challenge! Each raid demands adaptability and cunning, as you’ll need to develop your character from scratch every time, building an invincible tactic. Use every tool at your disposal to complete your objectives: blend in with the surroundings, establish contacts with locals, explore the dangerous world while hiding in the shadows of the jungle, or wreak havoc, crushing enemies along your path with every available means! Remember, the ultimate goal is to survive and make it back to base, because death wipes out all progress made during the raid!Crush enemies in the “signature style” of the U.S. Army in VietnamMake full use of all the resources the U.S. military has to offer! Air cavalry support, artillery and blazing napalm will not let you or the damn Charlies get bored! Your arsenal includes: a standard loadout of a military specialist, as well as napalm, of course, artillery, C4, combat grenades, tripwires, various types of weapons, and more!Explore the hostile jungleThe Vietnamese jungle is filled with dangers and mysteries. A helicopter will drop you into a procedurally generated map covered in dense foliage, where each step could be your last. Carefully survey every section of the terrain—you never know what's ahead: a treacherous trap, an enemy lying in ambush, or a wild animal ready to attack. Missions will require reconnaissance and exploration, so be prepared for a thorough examination of this unpredictable world.Prepare your soldier and collect trophiesCarefully review your mission objectives, weigh your options, and consider: should you bring more rations to avoid starving, or a charge of C4 for devastating sabotage? Skillfully allocate ability points and choose perks that will help you achieve your operation’s goals most effectively. This will allow you to experiment with different playstyles for each sortie. Sneak through the night, sabotaging enemy communications, or charge into open combat, mowing down everything in your path. It’s up to you to choose the path to become a legendary special forces veteran!Come back alive, the jungle doesn’t forgive mistakes!If you successfully complete the operation and evacuate alive, you’ll earn well-deserved rewards: medals and new perks that open up more strategies for future missions. Rest at a cozy fire base, chat with your fellow soldiers, and head back into the cursed jungle, because this war will never end otherwise! Come back alive, son, no matter what...Key Features:High replayability that provides a unique experience in every sortieWide range of actions and equipment for completing tasksDynamic system of progression and rewards, allowing you to develop your character in your own styleLiving, reactive world that responds to your every action
Short Description: Head to Vietnam as a lone SOG operative. Gear up, upgrade your skills, and explore the danger-filled jungles. Complete the missions assigned by your country and eliminate enemies using napalm and artillery in a brutal, tactical, turn-based 2D roguelite that does not forgive mistakes!

Detailed Description: Ysobel est une orpailleuse qui a la fâcheuse manie d'accumuler tous les déchets qu'elle trouve dans la rivière à côté de son camp. Mais sa vie de solitude va basculer le jour où elle pêche un étrange poisson parlant...Le voyage sur placeDans All That Glitters, vous explorez le monde depuis votre rivière, en y orpaillant les objets qui s'y échouent. Pour mettre fin à la menace une bonne fois pour toute, il vous faudra des pépites. Le seul moyen d'avancer, c'est d'accepter la folie du monde et d'en faire la sienne. Danger de mort, mais potentiel infini.

Detailed Description: Bluebie VS the Army of Cyborgs is a Cartoony 3D platformer that will take you to the fictive world of planet  Rebaga. The planet look pretty much like earth and the culture there is pretty similar to ours. One day, Cybex, a self made Cyborg, decided to invade the planet and turn its inhabitants into his servants.Of course, Bluebie, a farmer, is not willing to see his planet enslaved by the army of Cybex and decided to fight back and free the prisoners Cybex took.  In his quest, Bluebie will travel through mines,  mountains, desert and different other places where the cyborgs settled and launched their operation. He will fight the generals of Dr Cybex to free as much prisoners as he can while developing and purchasing new skills thanks to his colorful closet plenty of different outfits.Fight EnemiesA stick, a spear, a boomerang, a slingshot, a crossbow and a pigeon launcher. Which weapon to use to fight your enemies. Every weapon will have its own range and damage level. One is sometimes enough, two or more could be a necessity.Release The  PrisonersThe army of Cybex has taken many people. The cages might be hidden allover the places. Try to free them all to get the biggest achievement of the game, an achievement to rule them all, The Freeyorator !!!Change Your OutfitYou can choose your outfit in the main menu or within the game, all you need to do is to access a fitting room and choose the best fit of the moment !Execute MissionsEvery level will come with its own riddles, challenges and missions. Execute these missions to move forward. Enjoy Your RidesWhether it is to avoid enemies, moving faster or for fun , you will be able to ride animals.There is also an aircraft level where you will have to fight enemy aircrafts and air defenses within a timeframe. A race against time, a race against the enemy.   Get New SkillsYour experience points are collected by killing enemies. To unlock new skills, you will have to kill whatever enemy you find and collect diamonds to  get the biggest ones so... you know what you got to do when you got to do it... Weapon Shops To Refill You're short of projectiles or you want to acquire new skills, no problem, we got you! Every level will have at least two weapon shops to buy projectiles for your weapons, or to acquire new skills, thanks to the diamonds you collected previously. Just collect as much as you can, some items might be expensive.
Short Description: A fun 3D Platformer where you will fight Cyborgs using different weapons and skills you will acquire. The game will take you to different places where you will have to find and release hidden prisoners and defeat Cybex. Will you save them all ?

Detailed Description: In Kitsune's Paths, you will step into the role of Zenko:A fox guardian of the forests, responsible for protecting the portal that guides benevolent spirits to the next spiritual plane. Use your magical powers, speed, and wits to activate the turrets you'll find along the way, preventing demons from crossing the portals, and gradually becoming the legendary nine-tailed fox.In this Tower Defense, you are the protagonist. Explore the maps, strategically lighting up turrets according to the type of enemy you’re facing.Unlock new skills and level up your character. The full game will include a skill tree to upgrade the spells of your choice.Complete challenging levels to discover new worlds and help more benevolent spirits cross through the toriis. For each world protected, you will be granted a new tail, until you become the mythical nine-tailed fox.You may be interested in:The full game will feature 24 levels (with the possibility of adding some extras).2 types of turrets, upgradable to level 3, with 5 elemental options to customize each one.New powers and abilities for Zenko.8 different worlds, with fully hand-painted backgrounds.17 unique enemies, all Yokai demons.Adorable benevolent spirits to help along the way.

Detailed Description: In this game, you control a ball to complete levels, Each level has a gate that requires all players in co-op mode to be present to advance to the next level, By collecting keys. Use the keys to continue and find crystals to buy items like skins and traps. You can trap your friends for fun or compete to climb the top 100 leaderboard. Host a session to play with up to 5 friends or enjoy offline modes:Hardcore: Every time you lose in a level, the keys respawn, so you need to collect them again. This mode is also for the top 100 leaderboard and speedruns.Singleplayer Normal: Play normally and chill with easier progress where you need to collect keys only once per level. If you lose in the same level, the keys won't respawn, giving you an easier experience.

Detailed Description: At last!  ASTROSMASH, the 1981 million-seller for the Intellivision console, is now available in its original version on Steam. In this retro arcade hit, you control a laser gun and have to shoot asteroids, bombs and other objects to collect points and ensure your survival. The game combines elements from Asteroids and Space Invaders, but offers its own unique style. As well as the original version, there's also a fantastic remake on Steam that brings the nostalgic action back to life with modern graphics and gameplay - perfect for retro fans and new players alike!

Detailed Description: Welcome. Right off the bat, you will be working on a surveillance      assignment. However, this is not just a surveillance assignment. If something      strange happens while you are monitoring, you will be asked to report it as an "Anomaly"."Monitoring All Night" is a self-proclaimed ‘scary but not too scary’ horror game in which you report anomalies while performing surveillance duties. Report the abnormalities appropriately and survive until the end of the workday. Also, be careful of the aliens.There are three locations to work from: Apartment, Backrooms, and Asylum.There are three shifts available: short from 0:00 to 2:00, middle from 0:00 to 4:00, and long from 0:00 to 6:00. You can work the shift of your choice.Aliens are often reported before dawn. Detailed Description: All Hail Gloop!In All Hail Gloop, chaos reigns supreme as you take control of Gloop, a destructive force like no other! This top-down action-survival game challenges you to destroy everything in your path, collect gold and items, and use your spoils to become an unstoppable powerhouse.Rampage across colorful hand-drawn landscapes, flattening houses, and gathering gold to upgrade your stats and abilities. The more you destroy, the stronger you become—but beware, enemies lurk around every corner! Can you outlast the hordes and grow your fortune, or will Gloop's destruction come to an end?Key Features:Destruction Frenzy: Tear down houses and collect gold as you pave your way through an endless world of chaos.Endless Upgrades: Use gold to upgrade Gloop’s health, damage, and speed, and unlock powerful passives like Buzzing Good Time, Rocket Man, and In Gloop! We Grow—each boosting your destructive capabilities.Survival Mode: Survive as long as possible while collecting as much gold as you can to increase your power.Unique Art Style: Immerse yourself in a vibrant, hand-drawn world, where every item is ripe for destruction.Strategic Builds: Save your build, experiment with different passive skills, and become the ultimate Gloop of destruction.It’s time to take over the world, one house at a time. All Hail Gloop will test your reflexes, strategy, and hunger for chaos in this fun and frenetic destruction-fest!

Detailed Description: Driving a drone with a Keyboard, destroying 101 targets with an onboard machine gun and missile.Targets also attack and destroy the drone of the player in various ways.The number of missiles mounted on the drone increases one by one for each destruction of targets with a machine gun.The battlefield is divided into five stages,Stage 1 focuses on a training process that allows users to handle drones well and gather missing files while destroying 20 targets, so it can pass without difficulty. However, caution is required because it gives damage to drones in various ways.(In stage 1, it can only be destroyed by finding a brightly shining target and shooting until the target's energy is zero.)Stage 2 requires one huge monster to be knocked down. It is possible with machine guns, but it is very advantageous to use the missing file collected in stage 1.Stage 3 requires destroying 10 airplanes. It is a method of defeating one by one by one.Airplanes cannot win if they find weaknesses in attacking drones by software programs and fail to attack them properly.Stage 4 requires the destruction of 20 enemy drones and 5 turrets. The five turrets are so destructive that they must be destroyed first by using the missing file at the risk of the player's damage. If there is no missing file, the enemy drone must be destroyed and the turret must be destroyed by obtaining the missing file. Enemy drones that meet the conditions attack the player's drone at once.Stage 5 can only be won by entering the airborne monster base and destroying more than 45 of the 50 monsters. The 50 monsters appear and disappear repeatedly, so there is no distinction between destroyed and destroyed. Once destroyed, you can never destroy. Therefore, remembering what you destroyed is the secret to victory.When the energy of the player drone becomes zero while playing 1-5 stages, return to the beginning of stage 1 and start playing again from the beginning.The operation button of the keyboard and the method of play are always displayed on the screen when the speed of the player drone is stopped to zero. Let's not give up and let's win because it's built to win if we repeat the play.

Detailed Description: In this RTS game, you either fight for victory in linear missions, or you build your own base in very dynamic skirmish battles, in order to then defeat the enemy by any means possible.The prerequisite for this is that you have your resources under control. Invest enough resources in your research to ultimately realize the extraction of synthetic metal in large quantities. This achievement will mean your victory. At least that is my belief.Always pay attention to your energy levels, because too little energy means poor visibility. You also have to expect consequences if buildings are damaged. But hey, you can do it.The more energy you invest in your radar and communication systems, the more extensive and stable the connection to your AI-controlled units on the battlefield will be.The enemy will challenge you a lot with special operations, flank attacks and support missions, and they will also continue to develop. Hopefully more slowly than you do. So, be warned.It should be noted at this point that due to the high dynamics, every mission start in skirmish mode, even with the exact same settings, leads to completely different outcomes.There is an extensive skirmish editor at your disposal, which massively increases the replayability value. Among other things, it is possible to change the resource management in 3 stages.In addition to the freely rotatable camera, there are other cameras at your disposal, including a cinematic camera that brings you as close to the action as possible, and all of this with day/night cycles if you want.
Short Description: Hyperwar is an RTS game with many classic elements such as base building, research, unit production and resource gathering, but it also contains new approaches and ideas. Paired with modern graphics and a freely moving camera, this game is a completely new experience in the genre.

Game Name: STAY ALIVE MY SON (PC Version): A True Story About A Father's Search For His Son
Detailed Description: OVERVIEW  Spanning over 45-years, Stay Alive My Son (SAMS) is a groundbreaking virtual reality odyssey where you are transported into the life of Yathay Pin, a survivor of the Cambodian genocide to witness the world through his eyes, where every decision you make unfolds his poignant story of family separation, survival, and resilience. This narrative is based on the true events described in Yathay Pin's compelling novel Tu Vivras Mon Fils (Stay Alive My Son), making every moment of the game an authentic dive into history.  Made by a small team with purpose, SAMS is more than an experience through the life of one man; it's a bridge to the past, an exploration of the depths of human endurance, and a testament to the indomitable spirit of love and the essence of what it means to persevere, to forgive, and to heal.    Honored with the Producers' Guild Innovation Award and five Telly Awards for breaking new ground in storytelling, SAMS revolutionized cinema history by creating a new genre in filmmaking called “Cineplay.” This genre merges cinematic storytelling with interactivity, allowing you to live the life of a real person with a deeply human and emotive narrative. By pioneering a hyper-realistic digital representation of Yathay and integrating volumetric capture of real actors, SAMS brings Yathay and his family to life inside the game engine, enabling you to relive key moments leading to his family's separation and his quest for atonement.   THE EXPERIENCE  Your journey begins outside Yathay’s home, where you meet an eighty-eight-year-old man, brought to life with a hyper-realistic digital human powered by AI. As light gameplay mechanics guide your path, you delve deeper into the psyche of a father haunted by choices from his past. In a ceremonial rite that intertwines your fate with his, your hands become his; you see the world through his eyes; his memories and dilemmas flood your consciousness. In a surreal twist reminiscent of "Alice in Wonderland," you plunge into the depths of his memories, initiating a quest for redemption and understanding.  Navigate the cavernous labyrinthine symbolizing the recesses of Yathay’s mind to uncover the rich history of Cambodia and confront the moments and decisions that have defined Yathay's life leading to his family's separation and abandonment of his six-year-old son, Nawath. Relive the powerful moments that shaped his existence, feeling decades of sorrow and the relentless anguish of not knowing his son's fate.  Taken on a mythical branch, your odyssey culminates in the mystical echoes of Angkor Wat, a metaphorical beacon in the darkness of Yathay’s journey. Here, in the candle lit sanctuary, you'll uncover the final, elusive memory. It's in this moment of revelation that Yathay's unyielding spirit shines brightest, revealing a tale of enduring love and the transformative power of forgiveness.  OUR TEAM  With limited resources and taking over 5 years in the making, a dedicated team of nine artists who were passionate about storytelling, aspired to shape society and culture through technology by delivering an immersive experience with a mission to change the modern day narrative of family separation into one of reunification through a profound, life-altering journey of the heart, made with heart.  Carrying PC's and VR headsets in suitcases, we traveled relentlessly across continents to screen SAMS in over 25 countries and to share this true story with thousands of audiences, technologists, policymakers, NGO's, and Heads of State in an effort to humanize the trauma of family separation and urge people to join our mission to educate, empower, and reunite modern day families torn by conflict. By joining us on our journey to bring this powerful story and mission to wider audiences globally, your support is not only for this project, but a movement of change for these families. Your support serves as a beacon of hope amongst hopelessness, love in hate, and light against the darkness. We thank you!   Victoria, our cast, crew, and team UME  p.s. We know many of you do not have headsets and would like a desktop version.  Due to our limited resources, it was only possible to make it in VR and we also felt this would be the most powerful use of the medium. But, we are listening and will find a way to bring SAMS to you! We also dropped the price to help spread the story. Please know, we are doing our best to find the funds to convert this project for desktop, albeit with some adjustment, and will continue to listen to your feedback because you and this community is our backbone.  CAST & TEAM  CREATOR: Written & Directed By: Victoria Bousis   CAST:  Elodie Yung (Cleaning Lady, Marvel's Daredevil, GI Joe Retaliation) Arnold Chun (Man In the High Castle, Bullet Train) Vincent Rodriguez (Mortal Kombat 1, Crazy Ex-Girlfriend, Raya & the Last Dragon) Abraham Sigler (Disney's Wish, Raya & the Last Dragon) Lucas Sigler (Disney's Wish) Kostas Filippoglou (Captain Corelli's Mandolin, Wild Bees)  PRODUCTION STUDIO: UME Studios

By joining us on our journey to bring this powerful story and mission to wider audiences globally, your support is not only for this project, but a movement of change for these families. Your support serves as a beacon of hope amongst hopelessness, love in hate, and light against the darkness. We thank you!   Victoria, our cast, crew, and team UME  p.s. We know many of you do not have headsets and would like a desktop version.  Due to our limited resources, it was only possible to make it in VR and we also felt this would be the most powerful use of the medium. But, we are listening and will find a way to bring SAMS to you! We also dropped the price to help spread the story. Please know, we are doing our best to find the funds to convert this project for desktop, albeit with some adjustment, and will continue to listen to your feedback because you and this community is our backbone.  CAST & TEAM  CREATOR: Written & Directed By: Victoria Bousis   CAST:  Elodie Yung (Cleaning Lady, Marvel's Daredevil, GI Joe Retaliation) Arnold Chun (Man In the High Castle, Bullet Train) Vincent Rodriguez (Mortal Kombat 1, Crazy Ex-Girlfriend, Raya & the Last Dragon) Abraham Sigler (Disney's Wish, Raya & the Last Dragon) Lucas Sigler (Disney's Wish) Kostas Filippoglou (Captain Corelli's Mandolin, Wild Bees)  PRODUCTION STUDIO: UME Studios

Detailed Description: Single player, souls-like third person story driven revenge action-adventure. Fight your way through waves of alien monsters defending your precious land from evil force. Choose from variety of weapons, magic and skills. Destruction fueled missions and touching cinematics will lead you through "The Righteous Scar"Set in futuristic world, story follows Lucas Kane, a man consumed by grief and rage after his wife,  is tragically killed. due to a toxic spill from a facility owned by the global tech conglomerate OmniCore, a company known for unethical mining, energy harvesting, and destroying entire ecosystems for profit. Lucas' initial confrontation with OmniCore is local, a personal vendetta against a seemingly untouchable corporate giant."He who makes a beast of himself gets rid of the pain of being a man"Ever wonder what happens when you reach too high? When the numbers become everything? Funny thing is, they never see it coming.I’ve seen what greed does—how it twists, breaks, and buries everything worth saving. People who think they own the world because they can buy it. Like gods, they believe... Untouchable.But the higher you rise, the farther you fall. I learned that the hard way. Walked through it. Now? I don’t care about their numbers, their power plays. I’ve lost something—something they’ll never understand. And when you lose everything, you find clarity.I’m not here for revenge. Not really. I’m just here to remind them that everything has a cost. They’ll feel it soon enough. In the dark corners where they think they’re safe, when they hear the whispers... they’ll know.LK

Detailed Description: In Ryder, you’ll embark on a journey through a vibrant, low-poly world filled with puzzles and creatures waiting to be restored. As a Ryder, you can bond with over 60 creatures, each with unique traits that help you solve more than 100 puzzles. Explore three colorful regions, use creature abilities to overcome puzzles, complete your bestiary, and climb the Sanguine Mountain to fulfill your destiny.Start Your JourneyStep into the role of a Ryder—an ethereal being with the ability to inhabit living creatures through a process known as bonding. You are tasked with restoring the souls of creatures hidden away long ago and must journey to the summit of the mystical Sanguine Mountain.Solve Sacred Site PuzzlesEach creature’s soul is stored behind a Sacred Site puzzle. Puzzles are solved by retrieving and intermediately using orbs from within the puzzle area. Strategically switch between your party of creatures in the right sequence to get the orbs to the Sacred Site. Completing a Sacred Site brings the creature back into the wild.Use Your Creature AbilitiesEach creature in your party has abilities that are crucial for solving puzzles, but no two creatures are exactly the same. While many may share similar abilities—such as wind jumping, teleportation flowers, or freezing objects—their individual characteristics, like weight and size, make them uniquely suited to specific challenges.  Some creatures can reach hidden areas by fitting into small gaps, while others with heavier weight can trigger pressure plates to open new pathways. Understanding how each creature’s abilities and traits interact with the environment is key to mastering the puzzles on your journey.Complete Your BestiaryCollect 300 creatures, including special variants, and build out your Bestiary. Every creature you bond with strengthens your party and unlocks new possibilities for solving puzzles and progressing through the game.Traverse to the Sanguine MountainExplore three vibrant regions, each teeming with distinctive creatures and collectibles, before embarking on your final climb to the summit of the Sanguine Mountain, where your ultimate destiny awaits.Features:Immerse Yourself in a Unique Puzzle Adventure: Experience an open-world puzzle style blended with the creature-collecting genre.Play as Over 60 Creatures: Control creatures of various sizes, each with abilities that reflect their region and unique traits.Solve Over 100 Puzzles: Face increasingly challenging puzzles that require strategic combinations of creatures and abilities.Complete Your Bestiary: Discover and collect 300 creatures, including special variants, to expand your party and unlock new abilities.Explore 3 Colorful Regions: Journey through vibrant, low-poly regions filled with hidden creatures, collectibles, and secrets.Utilize Puzzle Accessibility Aids: Toggle camera views for a clearer look at puzzles or activate the puzzle visualizer, which briefly draws connections between important elements on the screen.

Many cases remain unexplained. Individual stories are shown in the credit sequence at the end of each episode.

Detailed Description: Dreamwalker is a top-down story RPG game with deckbuilding combat. Embark on a journey through dreams and nightmares in Dreamwalker, a top-down RPG set in a mesmerizing pixel art world where every choice you make shapes your destiny. You are a wandering traveler, drawn to a small village shrouded in mystery and cursed by an ancient evil. Villagers lie trapped in an eternal slumber, their dreams twisted and haunted by dark forces. As the last hope for this village, you must harness the power of dreams to navigate an intricate, story-driven adventure filled with secrets, peril, and unforgettable characters. Venture into surreal dreamscapes, each with its own unique challenges and puzzles, where the line between reality and illusion blurs. Engage in tactical card combat against the nightmares lurking in the shadows, using your deck to unleash powerful abilities. Adapt your strategy with every turn, combining the right cards to counter your enemies and overcome the trials ahead. FeaturesBuild and Customize Your Deck: Collect, upgrade, and enhance cards of different types and rarities as you journey through the dream realm. Dynamic Card Combat System: Master a tactical, turn-based combat system that blends RPG elements with deck-building mechanics. Use Dream Essence strategically each turn to play your cards and wield the elements like fire, water, ice, and lightning. Each card choice can mean the difference between victory and defeat as you outmaneuver enemies in epic encounters. Immersive Storytelling: Dive into a rich narrative that unfolds through both main story arcs and side quests. Each villager’s dream tells a unique story — solve their mysteries, lift the curse, and reveal the truth behind the Nightmare King’s sinister plot. Explore and Solve Puzzles: Dreams are full of hidden secrets. Uncover clues, solve minigames, and engage in puzzle mechanics that challenge your mind and reveal deeper layers of the story.  Collect Dream Tokens: Earn Dream Tokens as you progress through the game. These tokens act as currency, allowing you to upgrade your deck and purchase new cards. Stunning Pixel Art World: Immerse yourself in a visually captivating world where every dreamscape is brought to life through vibrant pixel art. From lush forests to eerie graveyards and ancient ruins, every environment is crafted with attention to detail, offering a nostalgic yet fresh visual experience. Discover Hidden Achievements: Unveil hidden achievements as you explore the village and its mysteries.  Your journey is not just about battling nightmares; it’s about uncovering the truth, healing the hearts of those trapped in their dreams, and facing the darkness within yourself. The choices you make will shape the future of the village and reveal the true nature of the curse that binds it. Are you ready to become the Dreamwalker and lift the shadow over the village? Your adventure awaits!

Build powerful card decks and engage in tactical combat while navigating a rich narrative filled with twists. Can you lift the village’s shadow?

Detailed Description: Liminal Shift is a unique atmospheric suspense game developed using the latest Unreal Engine 5 technologies such as Lumen and Nanite. With every step you take, Liminal Shift pushes you deeper into an eerie, unsettling experience like no other.In Liminal Shift it's all about exploring. There is no such monsters or jumpscares in game. It's just you and the environment. Listen, feel and find a way through.Powered by the next-gen capabilities of Unreal Engine 5, Liminal Shift pushes the boundaries of immersive suspense with photorealistic lighting and environments brought to life by Lumen and Nanite technologies. Prepare to lose yourself in liminal corridors, abandoned pools, and labyrinth-like structures that challenge your mind and senses.If you're a fan of psychological suspense games that leave you questioning reality, and experiences that immerse you completely, Liminal Shift is for you. The game takes inspiration from the strange, eerie, and often unsettling worlds of liminal spaces and Backrooms and combines them with the technical excellence of Unreal Engine 5 to deliver a thrilling experience like no other.Note: Liminal Shift features unsettling enclosed spaces and themes of getting lost in liminal environments, which may cause distress for players with claustrophobia or a fear of disorientation.

Detailed Description: This is a puzzle game where you upgrade numbers by connecting them together.Basically, upgrades occur when you connect numbers with the same number or color.Detailed rules are as follows.When two numbers with the same color collide, an upgrade occurs, and the upgraded color becomes a mixture of the colors before the upgrade.When two numbers with the same color (1 to 9) collide, or when two numbers with the same color (10 or higher) collide, an upgrade occurs.For numbers 10 or higher, an upgrade occurs when the sum of numbers that are touching, smaller than the number itself, and have the same color as the number itself is equal to or greater than the number itself.The bar meter fills up depending on the color of the number that has been upgraded.When the bar is filled to its maximum, it becomes clickable. Click the bar and then click any number from 1 to 9 in the box. The color of the number you clicked will change to the same color as the bar, and the bar meter will be reset.If the number goes outside the box, the game is over.[About the two modes]There is an [Endless] mode where you keep playing until it's game over, and an [Over 19] mode where you compete to see who can make numbers over 19 the fastest.

Detailed Description: In "Oh No, Orcs!", you take on the role of a brave archer defending your fortress from a dangerous horde of orcs determined to destroy the main gate. Strategically positioned at the top of a tower, your mission is to prevent the invaders from reaching the gate using your skills with a bow and arrow. But be careful: over time, the orcs become more organized and powerful, bringing with them improvements that will challenge your dexterity and endurance!Gameplay: With each wave of attack, the orcs become more cunning and adaptable. At first, they are basic and simple shockers, but soon you will face orcs armed with sturdy shields, trained in combat tactics that deceive the player and even mounts that increase their speed. It will take a combination of skill and strategy to take down these forces before they can reach the gate.Challenges: As the attacks intensify, the orcs will present improvements such as dodging arrows, shields and even beasts as mounts, making the defense of the gate even more complicated.Resistance Under Pressure: With each passing minute, the level of pressure increases, and you must remain calm and agile to resist. Your ability to make quick and accurate choices will be crucial.Battle Mood: Get ready for a true test of skills in "Oh No, Orcs!". Show your bravery, shoot with precision and defend your fort until the last second! Victory is within your reach, but will you be able to hold out until the end?

Each abduction raises suspicion, and soon humans will start wandering around the farm, looking for trouble. Detailed Description: JumpKin Adventure Begins!Step into a sweet but competitive world! Are you ready to challenge your friends with your pumpkin characters? This colorful, energetic platformer is both fun and strategy at the same time!Choose from more than 10 different characters with unique designs. Which pumpkin will you choose? But when friendly competition is involved, things can get complicated. Everyone plays with their own strategy! Jump, run, quickly explore the map and collect objects. The more points you collect, the more you'll want to win, but you also have to be careful of other players! If one of your opponents suddenly jumps on you, you may lose a point you were earning.Great Powers Await You! Gain an advantage by collecting power-ups hidden on the map! But these powers are random and limited, so getting the right power at the right time will be part of your strategy. For exampleInvisibility: You can become invisible in the map and score points without getting caught by your opponents.Double Jump: Get one step ahead of your opponents by easily overcoming obstacles!Fast Run: Nothing can stop you; lightning across the map with your speed.Shield: Strengthen your defense and you won't lose points even if your opponents jump at you!But watch out! You already have a duration of special powers. Plan your strategy accordingly and make your move at the right time to outmaneuver your opponents!In the end, whoever scores more points will win! But it's not just about winning; it's also about who laughs the most and makes the best memories in this fun and action-packed adventure!The most enjoyable way to spend time with your friends, compete and have fun is waiting for you in JumpKin Adventure.

Detailed Description: Wasteland Travelers is a gritty zombie survival game with gorgeous pixel graphics. You have to do everything you can to survive and thrive in a world flooded by zombies and bandits. The apocalypse happened in the summer of 2035. The society led by the Giant Corps collapsed within a month. In the world of Wasteland Travelers, merely surviving is challenging. You must be prepared to face the lack of supplies, severe weathers, radiations and infections. You also need to fend off crazed zombies, hostile robots, and enemy factions' pursuit.Compared to other survival games, Wasteland Traveler has a vast system of factions, quests, and NPCs. You could scavenge weapons, medical supplies, vehicles, and tools made by the Corporations pre-apocalypse to reach your goals and solve your problems.       There are four rules you have to remember.      Firstly, slow down and be alert. While you explore the devastated Area 5, you need to watch out for zombies and marauders lurking in the shadows. Even though there are great risks in the wasteland, the reward for besting it is immense.       Secondly, tell friends from foes. Those who are trustworthy are the anchor points that will sustain your survival. Not everyone is your enemy, but keep an eye out for those that are.  Work will your faction members to help each other survive in the harsh world, restore order, and rebuild a society.     Thirdly, keep exploring and don't stop. Through the clash of the factions and the dark schemes of the Giant Corporations, find the truth behind the apocalypse in the North.Lastly, take your PAX!       The wasteland welcomes you, survivor!Join our Discord Server!
Short Description: Society governed by the Giant Corporations fell. It's all you now. Travel to the Marion Military Outpost and scavenge, fight and fend off the ferocious zombies and bandits, and eventually obtain the key to restoring civilization in Area 5.

Detailed Description: 《Shape of Dreams: Prologue》 is a free prologue version of 《Shape of Dreams》, a game that combines MOBA-style combat with action roguelike elements. Compared to the demo version of the main game, the prologue version includes 1 new character, new items, an endless mode, and experimental beta features.Explore the dream world, edit your memories, and create your own unique character!The Rapids, the realm between dreams and realityOne day, the boundary between the dream world and the real world collapsed, allowing travel to the in-between world called "The Rapids" through dimensional rifts. With rumors of unknown origin that reaching the end of the dream world will grant any wish, heroes set foot into the unknown world, each with their own reasons.Memory EditingYou can edit your memories to create your own unique character. Utilize past memories in battle to crush your enemies. Attach mysterious gems called Essences to your memories to grant special effects and create synergies.A ranged dealer with absurdly powerful melee attacks? A self-destructing mage? Anything is possible!Uncover the secrets of The Rapids The dream world is always changing. In the procedurally generated world, dream inhabitants, quests, various events, and hidden secrets await you. The diverse secrets that exist in the world will provide a new experience each run. In the process, unlock over 200 collectibles. But be careful, the Hunters are always watching you.Challenge yourself endlesslyWith difficulty selection and a permanent upgrade system, you can enjoy everything Shape of Dreams has to offer even if you're not exceptionally skilled at games. Nevertheless, if you enjoy a challenge, merciless trials await you, such as Lucid Dreams that can directly alter the rules of The Rapids and powerful hidden bosses. Overcome the trials and prove yourself!Diverse characters and playstylesAre you confident in your extreme control skills? Then we recommend Mist, a fast and agile melee attacker! How about Vesper, a sturdy and powerful tank character? Or perhaps you want to carry your friends as a ranged dealer?Shape of Dreams has characters of various roles prepared, including ranged dealers, bruisers, tanks, mages, and more. Find a character that perfectly fits your playstyle.Alone or with friendsShape of Dreams provides a complete experience even in single-player, but also supports co-op multiplayer for up to 4 players. Experience outstanding cooperation through the rich interaction systems of healing, buffing, crowd control, and more!

Detailed Description: In this game, you have a unique chance to win a big prize! Your task is to go through a series of 50 rooms, but each room presents a challenge. In every room, two doors will appear in front of you – one will lead you further along the path to winning, while the other could send you back.Rules:Each room has two doors, and only one of them is the correct one.The correct door is randomly chosen in each room, meaning there is no pattern to help you figure out which way to go.If you pick the right door, you move on to the next room.If you pick the wrong door, you might be sent back several rooms or have to start the entire journey again.If you manage to pass through all 50 rooms, you win!Luck is crucial – every choice is tense, and there's no way to know in advance which door is the right one. Will you take risks or play it safe? Can you make it all the way to the end and claim your well-deserved prize?

Detailed Description: Remember when you were a kid, and the streets were your territory, where every curb, puddle, and sidewalk turned into an epic mission? Bambas! brings that magic back with a sandbox game that lets you relive those street adventures, thanks to a groundbreaking control system. Explore a vibrant, detailed Mediterranean coastal city where creativity rules and exploration is your passport to fun. Use the controller’s sticks and triggers to control each sneaker independently, as if you were moving your own feet. Here, walking straight ahead isn’t enough; you’ll need to navigate crosswalks, kick cans, balance on curbs, and pull off impossible jumps to complete hundreds of challenges and unlock countless customizable sneakers.    Bambas! isn’t just a game; it’s a tribute to urban culture. Break stereotypes with its non-linear narrative and environmental storytelling, where stories unfold around every corner. Discover hidden spots that hold secrets and characters that will lead you down unexpected paths. Lace up your kicks and step boldly, because every move in this game is an adventure with its own style.

Detailed Description: Shut the Box is a classic game of strategy, luck, and creative thinking. With roots tracing back to pub games of old, this board game with dice has been reimagined in a sleek digital format, perfect for both casual gamers and those who enjoy a challenge.  How to Play: The goal is to turn down as many tiles as you can by rolling dice and using the numbers you roll to match the tiles. At the start, all the tiles are standing. The game ends when a player reaches 45 points. The player with the fewest points at the end wins.   Can you shut all the tiles before running out of options? Whether you're aiming for a quick game or mastering high scores, every roll tests your decision-making and luck.  Features:Championship: Test yourself in 20 stages across 4 leagues and climb the global top.Quick Play: Challenge yourself to beat the advanced AI.Hotseat mode: Go head-to-head with friends.Relaxing music & visuals: Enjoy a stress-free gaming session with calming sounds and a clean, intuitive interface.  Whether you're a seasoned Shut the Box player or trying it for the first time, this game offers the perfect blend of simplicity and depth. Roll the dice, shut the box, and see how far your strategy will take you!

Detailed Description: Return to the world of “A Vampyre Story” in this new gorgeous supernatural comedy point and click adventure!Mona, a Parisian opera singer, is kidnapped and taken to a castle in Draxsylvania where she is turned into a vampire. Fortunately, she’s aided by her loyal companion, a wisecracking bat named Froderick. You’ll guide both Froderick and Mona through a landscape of crazy characters and puzzles, including Dr. Legume’s Home for the Sanity Challenged, the Executioner’s Practice Grounds, the Mortus Labs™ and many others! It will be up to you to help Mona escape the clutches of a mad scientist and stop his evil plan, find a daytime guardian, and continue her quest to return home.Enjoy the beautiful hand-painted environments mixed with stylized 3D art and modern visual effects, filled with tons of animation and cinematics. Accompanied by excellent sound and music with voice overs by actors who have worked on Return to Monkey Island, Sam and Max, The Walking Dead, Layers of Fear, Assassin's Creed and more.Experience a control scheme perfectly adapted for the best possible experience with both a mouse and a gamepad.Travel with not one but TWO playable characters conversing and building the world around them, as well as constantly putting their heads together to solve a wide variety of classic point-and-click puzzles mixed with a twist on the use of your inventory. With Froderick’s wit and Mona’s charm no one will stand in their way!Bill Tiller, Dave Harris and more ex-LucasArts veterans who worked on The Curse of Monkey Island and other all time classics join forces with Tag of Joy, the team behind the recent award winning point and click game Crowns and Pawns: Kingdom of Deceit, to deliver you an exciting and fresh addition to the adventure genre!

Detailed Description: “少侠出来行走江湖，可有什么追求？”“武功、钱财、美人、大官，我全都想要！”-----------------------------------------------《江湖宝鉴》是一款武侠题材，带有轻度肉鸽元素的文字冒险游戏。你将扮演一位初出茅庐的少年，踏上游历江湖世界的旅程。通过不断的抉择，寻找最后人生归宿。精彩的主线剧情3条主线剧情，12个结局分支，等你体验。是一心向善，带领村民抵抗山贼侵扰，成为村长东床快婿；还是落草为寇，卷入山贼寨子中的阴谋诡计，身不由己；抑或是访仙问道，遁入山林逍遥自在，都在你的一念之中。丰富的奇闻逸事数十个路上的奇事、怪事、诡事等你探索。树下小伙愁眉不展，有何心事？林中木屋传来异响，是人是鬼？深夜路上少妇邀约，有何阴谋？这一切究竟是人性的扭曲，还是道德的沦丧？你的选择，将决定这些故事的走向。四种人物预设，多样互动方式偷窃、欺骗、卖惨、贿赂、动手...总有一种方式，让你度过路上难关。游戏采用双骰子判定机制，玩家具有武力、敏捷、口才三种属性。仔细投入属性点数，让你在江湖路上无往不利。更有十几种江湖珍宝秘籍，等你搜集。

Detailed Description: Quantum Joe is a classic arcade platformer with over dozens of levels of fun to enjoy both solo and with a friend! Collect power gems to unlock the door to safety, all while avoiding spikes, lasers, proximity mines and more. Jump through portals, control multiple clones of yourself, and invert gravity to see your way to victory. Do you have what it takes?!Features:  - Over 100 combined single and local co-op levels to play through. Challenge yourself for the fastest clear times and fewest deaths for each level! Work together with Graviton Sam to complete co-op levels as well.  - Build new exciting levels for you and your friends with a fully featured custom level editor. The possibilities are endless! - Complete challenges to earn achievements -- and Stickers!. Then use those stickers to decorate your handheld playroom. Neat!

Detailed Description: MARSBOUND is a survival game which combines elements of economic strategy and psychological thriller. The player assumes the role of an AI manager, leading the international mission "Mars – The New Home." In their hands are the lives of Earth's brightest specialists.When unforeseen events push the first Martian colony to the brink of disaster, carefully laid plans will crumble, and survival will become the main priority. To accomplish the mission despite all challenges, the player must develop technologies, explore unknown territories, and build life-supporting infrastructure, while Mars grudgingly offers resources but generously throws up obstacles. Every decision brings the colonists closer to either prosperity or catastrophe, with consequences often delayed in time.The dangers aren’t only outside the base. Isolation, stress, and conflicts threaten to tear the team apart from within. We must not only meet the colonists' needs but also monitor their mental health, preventing hostility toward ourselves and outbreaks of madness.MARSBOUND is about managing resources and people while balancing on the edge of disaster every day. Strategic thinking, composure, and courage are the player's steadfast allies on the path to victory.

Detailed Description: A puzzle adventure game about a quirky cat with rather curious demands.Featuring surprising encounters, lovingly-crafted puzzles and satisfying sounds.Navigate around the different worlds and fetch the right ball combinations for your cat in increasingly challenging levels.Colored balls rain from the sky, and your cat, Mister Antonio, has specific preferences for which ones you have to collect. Your task is to fulfill its demands by delivering the correct balls in the right sequence. Navigate around the different worlds and fetch the right ball combinations for your cat in increasingly challenging levels. As you progress, the puzzles become more challenging, introducing new characters offering strategic twists to the puzzles.A Bart Bonte puzzle game.Enjoy!@BartBonte

Detailed Description: “With an analog camera, a gift from my father, a photo of the missing tourists and the illusion of my first big news I prepare to enter with the brothers to the enigmatic baptistery.”Try to escape the nightmare and prove the disappearance of the tourists, but be careful, there are terrors beyond human comprehension inside the Baptistery.Nostalgic graphics with a modern twistThe baptistery gets a new lease of life thanks to the use of graphics inspired by the PS1 era, but with modern touches that enhance the gaming experience.Ambience above all elseThrough the use of a specifically designed soundtrack and sound effects  for the environment and the visuals you will feel like you are inside the Baptistery itself.Investigate, defend yourself, but above all run.The camera will be your greatest ally, with it you will be able to collect the necessary evidence to be able to write your first big news, but it will also be your only help when you have to face the dangers that lie in wait. Detailed Description: 🚀 Join the Fight in Rise of the Vanguard! 🚀Hey there, future Guardian! Are you ready to gear up and dive into an action-packed universe where chaos reigns and your squad is the last line of defense? Welcome to Rise of the Vanguard—your ultimate PvE squad shooter experience!Join forces with up to 7 friends (or brave strangers) and tackle missions that will have you battling against the Xenocratic Order, ruthless Pirate Syndicates, and the savage Ra'tic! Whether you prefer the thrill of first-person firefights or the tactical advantage of a third-person view, the choice is yours. Choose your playstyle and unleash your inner warrior!What’s in store for you?Epic Co-op Gameplay: Team up with friends or find new allies in a universe filled with danger and excitement. You’ll need every bit of teamwork you can muster to take on the Xenocratic Order, the Pirate Syndicates, and the terrifying Ra'tic!Dynamic Missions: No two missions are the same! Our DMG (Dynamic Mission Generation) system creates unique challenges each time you jump into the action, keeping you on your toes and craving more! Whether you're battling in a bustling city or a hostile alien jungle, expect the unexpected.Switch It Up: Prefer to take aim in first-person mode or want to see the action from a third-person perspective? You can easily switch between the two and find your sweet spot for unleashing chaos!Squad Goals: Work together, communicate, and develop strategies to tackle all kinds of missions. Scheduled Playtests: Join in on the action! We’re running random and scheduled playtests where you can dive into the fray, share your feedback, and help shape the game. Your voice matters!Get ready to rise through the ranks of The Vanguard and unleash your inner hero! Whether you're a lone wolf or a team player, there's a spot for you in this intergalactic adventure.Grab your gear, gather your squad, and let’s show the galaxy what you’re made of! The fight for the universe starts now. Join us and become a guardian of the stars!

Detailed Description: As you explore the shadowy halls, solve intricate puzzles that unlock the secrets of the corporate nightmare. But beware! Monstrous entities lurk around every corner, waiting to pounce on the unsuspecting. Communication and collaboration are key—can you work together to escape the horrors that await?Levels will be added throughout early access.Explore alone or  with a team up with 3 others for a total of 4 player co-op. You must find the exit alive to escape. Trapped in a nightmarish office environment, you and your friends must navigate through five uniquely terrifying levels, each brimming with suspense and mystery.With a haunting atmosphere and unpredictable gameplay, Endless Shift will keep you on the edge of your seat. Face your fears, unravel the dark truths, and discover who among you can endure the endless shift of terror. Are you ready to escape the nightmare?Traverse though 5 unique levels with different puzzles and entities. Each level features a different way to escape with various puzzles along the way.The built-in voice chat adds even more tension and realism to the gameplay. Players can easily communicate with each other, discussing strategies, sharing discoveries, and warning about approaching entities.WarningThis game contains flashing lights that may make it unsuitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Detailed Description: Welcome to the Hermes Library. It is the main library of the Hephaestus University, the most famous university in the United Nation of Europa. As a junior named Rainn Echo, you will become the new librarian working at the front desk. While performing your daily duties, you will also witness several mysterious incidents there.【How to Become a Capable Librarian】You will help students, faculty members, and alumni to check out and return books. Using the workbook provided, you will check if every reader has complied with the library's rule: if they have checked out more than they should, if they have returned everything on time, if they have used their own ID card... Pay attention to details, and you will become an outstanding librarian!Work time is divided into two parts: the morning and the afternoon. You will need to help about 12 readers every day with their return and check-out. During their conversations, you will get a glimpse into the lives of these students, professors, and alumni and piece together a rich campus environment.Check-out: the reader needs to provide their ID and the book they want to borrow. If they have a reservation, they will tell you the title of the book so that you can take it out of the reservation area on the left. The first step of check-out is to use the scanner on the ID card. The information of the reader will appear on the screen on the right. You need to check the information and make sure that they are using their own ID and they have the authorization to borrow. Then you can press the "receipt" button on the bottom of the screen, type in the title of the checked-out book and the return date, and press "print." Then you can give the printed receipt along with the ID card and the now-checked-out book to the reader.【Hidden Messages in Books】As you handle many books at the front desk, you will find hidden information in them. By collecting and utilizing what you may find in the books, you will uncover the truth behind the incidents happening at the university. Maybe you will get to know some special people as well.The Hephaestus University experienced several abnormal incidents since the beginning of the term: a certain award-winning professor is rumored to act inappropriately towards students? A philosophy PhD student died under suspicious circumstances? Furthermore, body parts preserved by the medicine department was stolen by an unknown person? Is there any truth in the rumor? Did the PhD student commit suicide or was there a killer on campus? What is the goal of the culprit who stole dead bodies? Different arguments and theories are passed around in the Hermes Library in silence, but they also fuel passionate debates. Collect pieces of information from these notes and help the detective and the reporter find the truth behind these incidents.【Enter a World of Steam Punk】During every lunch break, you can take a break with your best friend Lilith Puck at the Cafe in the Hermes Library and talk about the news of the day. Every weekend, as the librarian on break, you can go and experience different activities with your friend: parade, club fair, exhibition...... All novelties and innovations from the steam punk world.【Daily-Updated News Bulletin Board】The news bulletin board is updated daily to bring you the latest information about the incidents. It also advertises for interesting activities on and off campus. A variety of clubs and student organizations also put their description and recruitment information here. Notes from certain special people resonate with you. Keep communicate with them, and you may develop something deeper with them. When you return to your dorm after work, you can check all the notes you have collected. The salary paid by the library can also be used to purchase different kinds of decorations and blank notes.

Detailed Description: Super Space Frogs is a 2D physics-based rocket game. Design, Deploy, and Fly awesome space crafts using a wide variety of ship components. On a barren desert planet, the inhabiting frog civilization struggles to survive. Forced underground due to the harsh surface conditions, their species' continued existence is threatened. The newly elected Frog President has just issued a radical new policy change, throwing all of the planet's resources into space exploration. As the head of this new space program, your fellow frogs are counting on you!Rocket Ship DesignerTake advantage of a flexible ship designer, using a drag and drop interface to connect together various ship components. Rocket engines, fuel tanks, command pods. Anything you need to save your species, the government will find a way to get it!Physics-Based FlightThe 2D physics system provides a challenging and immersive rocket flight experience. Build strong and stable ships, keep your velocity in check, and try not to break off any of your ship components along the way (They're really expensive).ResearchConduct experiments to learn about the world around you. Unlock new technology to build bigger and better rockets. For the glory and perseverance of the frogs!Build FacilitiesFound a juicy titanium deposit on the Muun? Deploy a mining facility to suck up all those resources! Need more space marines for the cause? Build another colony facility and pump those numbers up. Rely less and less on purchasing resources as you build up your own facility network. StoryWhy is the Frog president so keen on rapidly expanding the space program? Is it truly the only way to survive? Either way, you've been given free reign and a fat check to get you started. Explore the solar system and unlocks the mysteries it holds.

Detailed Description: This walking simulator is a tool that makes it easy to get exercise and lose weight at home.Information such as calories burned, distance walked, elapsed time, number of scenes, and rate of progress is displayed in real time while walking, making it easy to maintain motivation.How to playStand in front of the computer and click on the play time to start. With the scenery flowing and the sound of footsteps echoing, begin the foot-stomping exercise.You may find the exercise more comfortable if you lay a mat under your feet.Perform the foot stomping while swinging your arms firmly, and it may feel a little hard at first.However, as you continue, your body will become accustomed to the exercise and you will gradually begin to enjoy walking.Eventually, you will feel a sense of exhilaration and hope.Motivation for DevelopmentI had been suffering from a lack of exercise and an inability to maintain a diet, and I decided to develop this simulator because I thought it would help me overcome these problems by making it easy for me to walk at home.This simulator is the perfect tool to execute my own ideal walking exercise.Currently, I continue to train with this simulator every day to promote my health.Night Terror Mode.When you select [Night Terror Mode], a scene with an eerie nighttime atmosphere is played back.This mode is perfect for those who want to enjoy a slightly thrilling night walk.[Enjoying Nature]While the video progresses in real time, you can enjoy the changes in time zones such as day, evening, and night.Fourteen different beautiful nature scenes unfold, providing a motivating element during the walk that makes it easy to continue.
