Detailed Description: Experience Night at the Office, a walking simulator, puzzle horror game focused on placing you into the heart of an environment full of terror, suspense and surprise. Night at the Office focuses on delivering a story-rich murder mystery coupled with many horror elements to make the experience far more exciting.Joseph Anadam was found at the bottom of the elevator bank at the Emerging Group Lp, a death where nobody yet knows the true cause. It is now nighttime and you are working late at the office trying to get some extra work done. Throughout the night, you begin experiencing headaches and phenomenon which begin to tie many causes to Joseph’s death.Who killed Joseph Anadam and why are you the one who is being put through the terrors of uncovering his death?Night at the office is estimated to be completed in 1 hour and offers the following:-          Mid-way checkpoint to allow you to resume or experience multiple endings.-          3 endings, each revealing a new element to the storyline.-          1 Easter Egg, as always…-          Several puzzles of varying difficulty to test your observation and critical thinking.-          Multiple achievements to allow you to experience all the game has to offer Thank you all for your support. This has been an excellent game to develop after not pushing any new title out for almost 2 years. As always, I am super excited to read your reviews and hear your thoughts on the game once it is released!Stan. T

Detailed Description: “The Weather Gage” is a single player naval simulation set during the Age of Sail, Horatio Nelson and Napoleon. The player follows a career as navy officer and commands a single sailing warship to capture or destroy warships and merchants of enemy countries. Realistic physically based  sailing, simulating real forces of sails, hull, rudder, anchor, boats, ...Combat ship to ship and ship to fortifications with cannons or carronades using solid shot, grape shot & canister shot. Damage to the hull, sails, crew or rudderCrew combat from ship to ship  or boat to ship with small firearms and boarding actions with edged weaponsNPC controlled ships consider relationship to other ships, own crew morale, terrain elements & wind direction to decide their behavior. Perception from NPC ships is modelled to consider light (day/night), weather (e.g. fog) or  false flagsCoastline based on real world data, including sea depth, with ports & fortifications modelled according to historical data on their real positionsThe simulation is based on the historic events between 1793 & 1815 (French Revolutionary Wars, Napoleonic Wars​, War of 1812) and has a great focus on historical authenticity & single ship actions (frigates or smaller ships). ​It draws inspiration from naval history (characters such as Thomas Cochrane) and fiction (Aubrey Maturin novels, “Hornblower” or “Master & Commander”).

Perception from NPC ships is modelled to consider light (day/night), weather (e.g. fog) or  false flagsCoastline based on real world data, including sea depth, with ports & fortifications modelled according to historical data on their real positionsThe simulation is based on the historic events between 1793 & 1815 (French Revolutionary Wars, Napoleonic Wars​, War of 1812) and has a great focus on historical authenticity & single ship actions (frigates or smaller ships). ​It draws inspiration from naval history (characters such as Thomas Cochrane) and fiction (Aubrey Maturin novels, “Hornblower” or “Master & Commander”).

Detailed Description: This game features a highly dynamic background soundtrack, offering players an intense and thrilling challenge. Players use the ASDW keys to control the movement of a cannon and the left mouse button to fire bombs, defending against incoming objects from all directions. In the game, the cannon must move flexibly, accurately aim, and destroy the incoming objects to avoid being hit. Players have three chances to make mistakes; if hit more than three times by the incoming objects, the game is over. This not only tests the player's hand-eye coordination but also requires quick reflexes and good strategic planning. The game's visuals are clean and lively, with well-designed sound effects. Each successful destruction of a target is accompanied by a satisfying explosion sound, greatly enhancing the game's fun and challenge.

Detailed Description: Void Echo is a psychological horror game that plunges players into the unsettling and surreal atmosphere of liminal spaces. Viewed through the grainy lens of an old camera, this first-person experience evokes a sense of isolation and unease as you explore vast, non-linear environments that seem both familiar and otherworldly. In Void Echo, you are stranded in a world that feels trapped between reality and dreams, where each space hides secrets and fragmented memories of a forgotten past. Guided only by the flickering light of your flashlight, you must uncover hidden paths, solve environmental puzzles, and survive lurking threats to escape the eerie, dreamlike environments.

Detailed Description: In the ‘80s, there were no aquaparks in your country. Or, at least, that was the case until you opened one yourself. As the owner, you want to memorize this moment and record everything on your VHS tapes. Everything is perfect, people are happy and have fun all day. However, at night,  you start to notice something unsettling, creepy, dark…Game features:Dark Atmosphere - immerse yourself in the thrilling atmosphere of an aquapark, where not everything is as it seems.Aquapark Management - manage your aquapark, serve the customers, restock the shelves, and record everything.Day and Night - talk to happy customers during the day and embrace darkness while being alone at night.Blissful Dream - let the customers in, check their tickets, sell toys and swimsuits, sometimes clean the aquapark. It’s a dream job…during the day.Recurring Nightmare - check cameras, patrol the aquapark, and search for anything unusual. Even if everything is unusual…Strange Events - for a second you thought that you saw a head between balls. Was it real? Or was it just your imagination? You can never be sure.Secrets and Mysteries - discover hidden places, stories, and secrets of your aquapark.Aquapark:You built your aquapark yourself. Or you paid for it, to be specific. You thought of everything - water slides, playgrounds, sports swimming pool etc. However, as you keep an eye on your facility, you start to notice new sections. Hidden rooms, sections that definitely weren’t included in the project. There is only one way to find out what they are.Unravel the mystery:As more and more unsettling events occur, you are desperate to find out what’s happening. Some NPCs may know more than you could imagine. Talk to them, make your choices and discover the true cause of strange events in your property. Will you be able to unearth the truth?

Detailed Description: Embark on a quest to kill the Undying King of Annam, who managed to achieve immortality through sinister means. The King traps millions of souls under his rule, preventing them from death and reincarnation.Angered by the King’s act, the Netherworld deities are summoning Revenants of forgotten past back to the mortal realm. Your quest: Kill the King who cheated death. Parry-focused combatChallenging combat that emphasizes going toe to toe against enemies with chainable parries, skillful dodges and Yin & Yang combo system. Detailed Description: About This GameDiliria VR is a psychological horror experience that immerses you in a fog-filled, abandoned town where unsettling secrets lurk beneath the surface. After surviving a car crash, you awaken disoriented in an eerie, desolate town—yet something feels deeply wrong. The crash didn't happen here, and the fog conceals more than just decaying streets and crumbling buildings. As you explore the claustrophobic alleys and unsettling environments, your sense of reality starts to unravel.With only a cryptic radio signal and scattered clues to guide you, you must navigate the labyrinthine streets, encounter terrifying creatures, and unlock the dark truth behind your past. Each step brings you closer to confronting the painful memories you've buried—especially the truth about your sister's mysterious death.Key Features:Immersive VR Horror: Feel the tension and dread as you explore the foggy, decaying town in full virtual reality. Experience every unsettling sound, shadow, and moment of isolation like never before.Engaging Storyline: A deeply personal narrative that unfolds through cryptic radio broadcasts, eerie flashbacks, and spine-chilling encounters. Face the truth of your past and the consequences of your actions.Atmospheric World: The town is a character in itself—every street, building, and object reflects the protagonist's fractured psyche. From claustrophobic alleyways to decaying hospitals, every location immerses you deeper into the mystery.Psychological Horror: Diliria VR focuses on slow-burn tension, guilt, and psychological torment, rather than jump scares. The creatures you encounter represent your inner fears and the darkness you try to hide from.Challenging Exploration: Solve puzzles, gather items, and find new paths as you navigate blocked roads and crumbling buildings. The town's layout changes subtly as your journey continues, adding to the feeling of unease and disorientation.The Truth is Buried in the FogDiliria VR is a game about guilt, loss, and facing the consequences of our actions. Will you uncover the truth, or will you remain lost in the fog forever? Venture deep into the mystery, but be prepared for what you may find. The truth is waiting… but it’s not what you expect.

Detailed Description: Unlike traditional tank battle games, this game is played from a first-person perspective. Players follow instructions on the walls to collect keys, and clearing the level requires collecting three keys within 5 minutes. Tanks of different colors have unique behaviors. For exampleThe Green Tank constantly searches for the Green Sphere. If the Green Tank is hit by a Red Tank's bullet, it explodes and drops a Green Key.The Blue Tank constantly searches for the Blue Sphere. The Blue Tank explodes and drops a Blue Key.The Yellow Tank moves towards the Yellow Sphere, stopping before it approaches it without colliding. The Yellow Tank should have the ability to push other spheres, especially the Green Sphere. By strategically pushing the Green Sphere, the Yellow Tank can manipulate the Green Tank's movement, directing it towards the large button in the arena. If the Yellow Tank is hit by a Red Tank's bullet, it explodes and drops a Yellow Key.The Red Tank fires at the player as long as he is in sight. Other tanks should not count as cover, allowing the player to trick the Red Tank into shooting at them.The game includes sprint and jump functions to help you dodge attacks from the red tanks.

Detailed Description: White Knuckle is a first person speed climbing game.Ascend through the guts of SUB-STRUCTURE 17 using precision movement mechanics. Sharp reflexes and resource management will take you to the highest peaks under ten thousand meters of concrete and decay.Just don't lose your grip, it's an eternity below you.You're not alone down here. Strange life flourishes far underground, and darker things haunt the halls where humans used to work. Something oozes from deep in the world, following you, growing angrier, faster, and it won't let up.Travel through different regions with unique threats and gameplay challenges during your attempted escape of the underground megastructure. From the deep dry storage of the Silos, through the putrid sewers of the Pipeworks, to the haunted piers of Habitation, each new area will require adaptation to new obstacles and denizens.Manage your inventory or become encumbered and fall to your death. Failure to grab what you need from your bag in time is a sure way to die.

Detailed Description: Gun Shop Manager invites you to a dynamic world where you become both a master gunsmith and the manager of your own shop. Customize every weapon to your heart’s content and add them to your store’s inventory, offering unique products to your customers. Engage in meaningful conversations with your clientele, understand their needs, and grow your business by keeping them satisfied.But don't stay confined to the shop! Detailed Description:
◆　Controls
Left Click: Confirm
Right Click: Cancel
ESC: Menu
Alt+Enter: Toggle Fullscreen

◆　Notice
All characters in this game are over 18 years old. 
This game features an auto-save function, allowing you to resume your game anytime after closing it.

◆ Story
Nam, the swordswoman known as the "Dark Flame," has obtained information about the "Mirage Mansion" and set off to a certain desert to acquire the hidden treasures within. However, unknown dangers await her there.

◆　Game Content
This is a deck-building roguelike RPG. Collect cards and items to create more powerful decks and combos as you challenge the deepest parts of the mansion. There are multiple branching paths in each stage and within the stages themselves. Events and enemy placements are random, even in the same spot. The game features replayability elements. If you are defeated, you can restart from just before the battle. If you find a battle impossible to win, you can restart from the beginning while carrying over some of your gold and levels.

P.S. Nam, the heroine, was one of the characters in Disaster Dragon x Girls from Different Worlds released five years ago. While this game is mostly new, one of the defeat CGs was reused from the previous title.

◆　H-Scenes
25 new basic CGs

Detailed Description: Elemental War Clash combines classic tower defense with roguelite and RPG mechanics as well as different elements to combine and create more powerful towers. As a best of Elemental War 1 and Elemental War 2 it provides the most content, best features and stunning visuals while you defeat your portal, beat other players in PvP or build new maps in the level editor.The foundation of Elemental War are the different elements. With element crystals you get every five waves you can summon powerful bosses, the so-called elementals. By defeating the elementals you unlock their element to improve your towers and get access to new abilities and upgrades by combining up to three elements.The heart of the Elemental War series is the Hero Mode as it adds quests and items to the game. By solving quests you unlock new items for your item pool that then will drop throughout your runs. Items can be passive bonusses, active abilities or tower equipment to customize your towers.Elemental War Clash features the cross-platform PvP multiplayer mode "Clash" in which two players will fight each other. You both will have to defend your portal as well as send monsters to your opponent at the same time. Who will be able to survive longest?FeaturesDozens of different towers with different abilities and strengths3 singleplayer modes: Hero Mode, Classic Mode, Survival ModePlenty of passive and active items as well as tower equipmentMonster abilities from Gold Rush to Invincibility to make each run uniqueDifferent and visual stunning environments from desert to ice worldDifferent skills with multiple upgrades to customize your playing behaviorPlenty of different monsters and elementalsSeveral quests to unlock new items for Hero ModeLevel editor to create and share new maps

Detailed Description: Golfie Up! is a precision platformer that rolls you to the edge of glory and the brink of madness! Jump, roll, and master the art of momentum in a world where every slip could send you tumbling back down. Play solo or with up to 8 friends, collect hidden treasures, and test your skills in heart-racing speedruns. Just remember: falling is part of the game—but the climb is always worth it!In the spirit of Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy and Chained Together, this game tests your skills, patience, and possibly also friendships!In a nutshell:Difficult roll-a-ball-y platforming with nuanced jump and recovery mechanics.Use fun power-ups to boost, fly, teleport, or even explode!You will fall, and you will lose progress, but it’s never unfair! Gather collectibles in hidden- or extra challenging places!Bring a friend on the journey for a co-op experienceTry speedrunning to get on the leaderboards!From momentum-based challenges to anxiety-inducing jumps, there is much fun (and pain) to be had in this game!

Detailed Description: Family Land - Farmer Simulator Prologue is an introduction to the full adventure of a farmer's life, the description of which you will find below.Many people dream of escaping the hustle and bustle of city life for the tranquility of the countryside.When you inherit a farm in Tennessee, you don't hesitate for a moment. Nestled in a picturesque spot, surrounded by forested hills, it’s truly awe-inspiring.But there’s a lot of work ahead. The buildings are falling apart, the equipment is in disrepair, and the fields are slowly turning into a forest. Even Old Bill, who sold you the farm, is still living in the shed, reluctant to move out.The farm needs a serious renovation to become an ecological agricultural enterprise. Detailed Description: Welcome to Restaurant Owner! Where your adventure with the world of culinary enterprise awaits! In this management simulator, you take on the challenge of running your own restaurant.Put your business skills to the test! Take your first steps as an owner of a humble diner and work your way to the top as the crème de la crème of restaurant tycoons!Key FeaturesMenu design Restaurant management          Staff management         Sales system         Finances         Decor customization          Living environmentManagementServe your customers, organize your storage space, order ingredients, furnish your eatery. Expand your venue, hire more employees, get fancier equipment. Watch as the world outside your restaurant’s doors responds to its success by actually getting a bigger crowd queuing for a table at your place.Dive into the challenge of culinary enterprise with Restaurant Owner!

Detailed Description: REVEREX: DX is the expansion and commercial release of the award-winning game, REVEREX. The scientists at the Zlyodomov Biomedical Manufacture Concern (ZBMC) think they’ve created a device which can pull people out of comas: the REVEREX. As their top technicians, its up to you and a friend to operate the machine through it’s maiden voyage, ensuring the stability of your patient’s mind and body through the entire ordeal. Navigate stages rife with unusual geometry, shifting gravity, and strange visuals. Complete challenging maintenance tasks to make traversal easier. Get out again before the dream world, or your patient, are destabilized for good. Navigator: The Navigator is responsible for navigating the trippy and unusual dream world of the coma patient. Run, Jump, and Parkour your way through the dream world!Vitalist: The Vitalist must complete minigames designed to maintain the vital stats and health of the patient’s physical body. The outcome of these minigames directly impacts the performance of the Navigator.Please note that REVEREX: DX contains flashing lights, bright colors and other visuals that may cause adverse effects to individuals with photosensitivity issues including Epilepsy. Exercise caution before playing if you have a history of photosensitivity.
Short Description: REVEREX: DX is a 2-player asymmetric experience that blends platforming action and microgames on a visually stunning trip through the mind. Don the roles of Lab Technicians operating an experimental Coma Treatment device, explore the deepest reaches of the subconscious and rescue your patient!

Detailed Description: Prepare to dive into the adrenaline-pumping world of Pirend7, where high-speed racing collides with explosive combat in a 40-player battle royale! In this sci-fi racer, survival isn't just about speed; it's about strategy, firepower, and skill. Whether you're gunning for the finish line or fighting to be the last one standing, every race is a test of wits, reflexes, and pure combat prowess.UNLEASH THE POWER OF THE PIRENDS The stars of the show are the Pirends—futuristic, heavily armed vehicles built for speed, destruction, and strategic dominance. Each Pirend is part of a distinct class, offering unique passive, primary, and ultimate abilities that can give you the edge in combat. Whether you’re dominating the battlefield with raw firepower or outsmarting opponents with strategic precision, your choice of class and abilities will define your approach to victory.DIVERSE WEAPON ARSENALEquip your Pirend with an array of over 25 weapons that suit your combat style. Whether you prefer the precision of rifles, the raw power of cannons, the close-range devastation of shotguns, or the relentless spray of machine guns, your loadout can be tailored for any situation.TACTICAL GADGETRYMaster the battlefield with up to three tactical gadgets. Choose from 7 unique gadgets, like deploying a "Shield Barrier" to absorb incoming fire, dropping a "Smokescreen" to lose pursuers, or amplifying your firepower with a "Weapon Amplifier." Gadgets offer a wide range of strategic options that can turn the tide of any encounter, and with the ability to swap gadgets mid-game, you can adapt to any situation on the fly.ADVANCED MISSILE SYSTEMSEvery Pirend is equipped with a versatile missile launcher, capable of firing 7 specialized missiles to suit your needs. Whether you need to punch through armor with an "Anti-Armor Missile," disable enemy shields with an "Anti-Shield Missile," or scramble electronics with an "EMP Missile," your missile launcher is your go-to tool for dealing serious damage.AUGMENT SYSTEMAs you race and battle, you'll unlock random augments that enhance your Pirend's capabilities. With 40 different augments available, you can reduce the cooldown of your gadgets, double your missile launcher's firepower, or fortify your shields, allowing you to adapt and evolve your strategy on the fly.DYNAMIC RACE TRACKSRace tracks in Pirend7 start wide and gradually narrow, pushing players into intense close-quarters combat. Get ready to fight for every inch of road!

Detailed Description:
Step into the radiant world of Glow Storm, a top-down 2D bullet hell where you wield a powerful shield that serves as both your defense and offense against enemies in glowing, neon-lit arenas. With a unique blend of strategy and fast-paced combat, you'll need to master your shield’s brief but crucial activation to destroy foes that bullets alone can't take down. Once defeated, harvest their sparks and turn them into temporary allies.

With its vibrant neon visuals and intense gameplay, Glow Storm challenges you to balance offense and defense in a world where timing is everything. After conquering the main game, push your limits further in Hard Mode for the ultimate test of skill.

Detailed Description: Age of Respair is a strategy castle builder where you'll manage every aspect of your kingdom: Gather resources and establish production chains.Grow population to expand your castle and economy.Strengthen defenses to survive relentless sieges.Build massive armies to storm enemy castles.Play a story-driven campaign or engage in intense skirmishes against AI opponents.Gather essential resources like wood, stone, and iron. Workers collect these resources and deliver them to your stockpile, making them available for use in production chains. Don’t forget to feed your population - choose between quick options like apple farms or build more reliable food systems, such as wheat fields that supply to mills and bakeries. Every decision shapes the prosperity of your kingdom.Managing your population’s happiness is essential for maintaining a thriving kingdom. If your people are unhappy, they’ll abandon their work and even your castle. Build churches, taverns, and decorations to boost morale, but be careful - more people means more buildings to keep them content. Alternatively, you can rule through fear by placing intimidating structures like torture machines, increasing productivity at the cost of happiness. Balance your reputation wisely: Happier citizens pay more taxes.Fear can drive higher resource production.As your kingdom grows, so do your needs. Start with basic buildings and upgrade them to improve efficiency, ensuring your economy scales with your ambitions. Strategic upgrades are key to maintaining a robust and thriving economy.Fortify your defenses with strong walls, strategic towers, and deep moats to safeguard your kingdom from enemy invasions. Protect your king at all costs.Once your defenses are secure, shift focus to your offensive strategy. Produce weapons, train soldiers, and deploy siege machines like ballistas, catapults, and siege towers to conquer enemy castles. With the fog of war hiding enemy locations, careful scouting and strategic planning are essential for victory.Join our Discord to connect with us, share your thoughts, and be the first to experience the game in alpha and beta stages. Help us shape the game and connect with fellow enthusiasts as we build something amazing together.

Detailed Description: Shovel & Swindle is a co-op game where you and a friend explore a graveyard  and rob graves to earn money while avoiding the guards and uncovering many secrets. Make sure you balance exploring and gaining money to progress.  Inspired by Burke & Hare, you'll go into a graveyard with the sole intention of robbing graves either alone or with a friend... But be wary, there are bobbies patrolling the graveyards, it seems they've been alerted from recent graverobbers trying to make easy money. You only have 10 minutes to complete a single graverobbing night. As you understand more of the graveyard, purchase more upgrades, you'll be able to delve deeper into the graveyard. But don't slack on your graverobbing duties, otherwise you'll fail to pay your rent. Work your way through the level by solving puzzles, purchasing upgrades for quicker runs, to find the grand prize hidden in plain sight. Only then will your graverobbing days be behind you.Explore more locations! Find more secrets! Solve more puzzles!Uncover the secrets hidden right before your eyes to obtain what you desire most.

Detailed Description: Build your own kingdom, day and night, with your unique set of cards.   From cropland to forest, from academy to conqueror's guild, expand territory of your kingdom. As the kingdom grows, crises will quietly arise. No worries: prepare to use the resource cards to train a group of powerful guardians to eliminate enemies and protect your kingdom. Grab the axe to be a lumberjack, take the sword and become a soldier. In Kingdom of Cards, a peasant unit can be turned into different characters by picking up different prop cards. With axes, pickaxes, swords, torches, sorcerer books, hammers... A peasant unit can be transmuted into whatever character you want. Some units are guessable, but more need to be explored by yourselves. By consuming different cards multiple times, a peasant can become a super powerful combat character.  In the unfolding journey of the kingdom's expansion, there will inevitably be those who remain oblivious. Vanquish them with your formidable forces to unlock even greater treasure cards.  Different units each possess their own unique traits; they need not fight alone—let them join forces.  You may revisit challenges and draw wisdom from past experiences with each new attempt. FeaturesOver 200 unique cards Explore and create new cards through combinations Units with varied abilities Replayability with endless possibilities

Detailed Description: Deprived of your memories, you find yourself in an unfamiliar place. Tremendous power smolders within you, waiting for the right spark to rekindle it. Recall the incantations required to summon creatures to fight for you. Cast spells to enhance your allies and hinder your enemies. Collect artifacts of old to further mold your magical talents.Your foes might be innumerable, but your potential is limitless.Cards? Check. Deck building? Check. Turn-based gameplay? Not this time.Into the Underworld offers a mix of auto-battler and real time strategy games with the sublime thrill of constructing your own, unique play style from a plethora of options. Complete your deck, discover powerful card combinations and hone your strategy against varied enemies in tense, real-time battles.This is a dangerous place, steeped in dark fantasy lore. Every secret has to be torn from the obscuring shroud of ages past, and the hands of the Underworld’s corrupted servants. You will perish, but death cannot stop you for long - and you will return from each expedition with new knowledge and power.Unlockable, persistent upgrades and an evolving storyline will keep you coming back to face the darkness again and again.We are a small team who believes in making the kind of titles we ourselves like to play - and we think you’ll enjoy them too. If Into the Underworld looks like your cup of tea, please consider adding it to your Steam wishlist - it helps us a lot!We encourage our community to take active part in the creation of our games, and this one is no different. Jump onto our Discord server, leave a note on the game forums or shoot us an email - we’d love to hear your thoughts on Into the Underworld!

Detailed Description: In a small lost village in the Far West, the Sheriff is on the alert! An unknown outlaw is committing crimes at different locations in the city. Who could it be? Will the Sheriff be able to catch him before all the villagers pass by? Compete against a friend and play as the Sheriff and the Outlaw respectively in various matches. At each game, choose a new power to add some diversity to the game !The OutlawTake on the appearance of a simple villager and reach your targets without being spotted by the Sheriff. Once the objective is reached, try the ultimate jackpot, and kill the Sheriff without him realizing it!The Sheriff Open your eyes and ears, the outlaw is somewhere in town. Monitor the behavior of the villagers and react as fast as possible when an incident occurs to catch the criminal! But be careful, it could be anyone... Use smoke bombs, get the vision of animals or even place decoys on the ground to mislead your opponent... It's up to you to understand as quickly as possible which power your opponent has chosen!

Detailed Description: Tall tales are often rooted in truth. After finding The Tales of Violet Valley book at your local library, you discover that the stories within are based on real events. You feel compelled to learn more. You do your research, you narrow down where the town is, and gather up your friends. It's time to explore.     Your group will explore different areas of the town. Each location hosts its own enemies and objectives while telling a small piece of a bigger story: what happened in Violet Valley? Multiplayer: Tackle each location with up to 4 players. Solo play is supported, but teamwork is essential for the horror ahead. Locations: Start your journey with a set of locations patrolled by Robbie. Each of these areas features different objectives, enemies, and pacing. Some areas encourage running for it, while others require a sneakier approach. Hidden locations follow a different set of rules...Objectives: Objectives are designed to get you further into a location.Items: You're equipped with nothing but a flashlight and a couple of items you can use to distract Robbie. Detailed Description: Zombie Tower Survivor is a top-down, tower-defense game with survival elements set during a zombie apocalypse. Customize a magic tower with various talents and upgrades to fend off the undead. As the zombie waves grow stronger, refine your defensive strategies and adapt to the increasing challenges. Jump right into the action — choose your tower, which defines its unique features, main ability, and difficulty level. The tower shoots the zombies automatically, so you can focus on buying the upgrades and collecting treasure chests. The game is perfect for all experience levels. Just relax and immerse yourself in a survivor-like gameplay loop that's sure to boost your dopamine.Take on five increasingly tough difficulty levels. Your mission: survive each level and eliminate as many undead as possible within 20 minutes. As you pass through each difficulty level, the challenges increase, but so do your opportunities to unlock new abilities and upgrades. Test out different combinations to conquer each difficulty level and kill every single zombie.As zombies grow stronger, your tower must too! Use gold to buy a wide range of upgrades from the shop, which you can access anytime during the level. Enhance your defense with talents, buffs, auras, and effects. Open treasure chests as you play to get free upgrades. You won’t be doing it alone — a little furry helper will gather buffs for you.No two play sessions are the same. With plenty of upgrades, abilities, and towers to choose from, you can mix and match to create a unique strategy each time. Unlock everything to explore different combinations and find the best way to beat the zombies. Create a game plan that’s perfectly yours and discover the ultimate ways to pass all difficulty levels.Features:Explore a variety of main abilities, with even more on the wayUnlock and play with various towers boosted through the meta-progression systemExperiment with hundreds of upgrades, talents, buffs, auras and effects to customize your towerFace and defeat powerful zombies Pass difficulty levels to unlock additional skills and towersEnjoy quick play sessions with 20-minute levelsExperience unique builds every time you play

Detailed Description: Slime Virus Defense brings a fresh twist to the tower defense genre. Your mission is to protect your computer from waves of virus-like slimes that come in small, medium, and large sizes. But you’re not alone! Animal towers with 9 unique classes—Poison, Ranger, Sniper, Fire, Hybrid, Line Magic, Splash Magic, Pure Magic, and Ice Magic—are here to help. Detailed Description: Bird is a social impact game about mass incarceration where players explore the memories and artwork of Darrell Fair. Darrell is an artist, activist, and mentor, represented by the Exoneration Project. He was wrongfully convicted in 1998 due to a coerced confession and has been serving time in Illinois ever since. Bird is a documentary, a virtual art gallery, and a video game all at once. The central framework of Bird is built on a metaphor from Michelle Alexander's "The New Jim Crow," which compares mass incarceration and racism in the U.S. to a birdcage. “One theorist, Iris Marion Young, relying on a famous “birdcage” metaphor, explains it this way: If one thinks about racism by examining only one wire of the cage, or one form of disadvantage, it is difficult to understand how and why the bird is trapped. Only a large number of wires arranged in a specific way, and connected to one another, serve to enclose the bird and to ensure that it cannot escape.11”― Michelle Alexander, The New Jim Crow: Mass Incarceration in the Age of ColorblindnessThis metaphor permeates Bird’s gameplay, and inspires players to ask themselves, what can I do to free this bird?The story of Bird is told through animations, hand-drawn in Stateville Correctional, recorded audio interviews with Darrell and his family, and a dynamic choral soundtrack with lyrics taken from interviews conducted in Stateville and sung by the multi-Grammy-winning choir, The Crossing. Bird Main Features:Rich narrative depicting the true story of Darrell FairExplore, collect, and reveal artifacts and memories of Darrell’s life and his experiences in Cook County Jail and Stateville Correctional Unique interactions including telephone calls from Stateville Correctional, diegetic “home-movie” style videos and interviews played through radiosHand-drawn artwork and animations, created frame-by-frame in Stateville and mailed to be scanned and collated Facts about the criminal justice system presented through interviewsDynamic choir music sung by The CrossingHand-Drawn Animations from Darrell Fair Created at Stateville CorrectionCollect Memories by Exploring Surreal EnvironmentsFind Struggle, Loss, and Hope Behind Prison Walls
Short Description: In Bird, collect hand-drawn animations and recorded interviews to reveal the heart-wrenching true story of Darrell Fair, an artist and activist wrongfully convicted in 1998 and still fighting for his freedom. Bird is an intimate, artistic journey that asks what would you do to set a caged bird free?

Detailed Description:
Embark on a gaming odyssey like no other with ReHash, where every button press is a step closer to speedrunning glory! Brace yourself for an adrenaline-fueled journey through a labyrinth of challenges, where reflexes and precision are your greatest allies.

At the heart of ReHash lies a mesmerizing array of 30 unique buttons, each one a gateway to unlocking the next level of mastery. From the familiar WASD for movement to the dedicated Sprint key (Shift) that unleashes your inner speed demon, every keystroke is a testament to your skill and determination.

But ReHash is more than just a test of button-mashing prowess; it's a symphony of controls that demands finesse and strategy. Every jump, every dodge, every seamless transition between actions is a dance choreographed by your fingertips, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the gaming realm.

As you dive deeper into the immersive world of ReHash, you'll be enveloped by a captivating atmosphere that transcends the screen. The diverse soundtrack, carefully curated to complement your every move, serves as the perfect backdrop to your adrenaline-fueled exploits. From heart-pounding beats to serene melodies, each track enhances the gaming experience, drawing you further into the game's hypnotic embrace.

But don't be fooled by the breakneck pace of ReHash; amidst the chaos lies a surprisingly relaxing rhythm, inviting you to find your flow and conquer each challenge with grace and precision. Whether you're chasing a record-breaking run or simply seeking refuge from the demands of everyday life, ReHash offers an escape like no other.

So, if you're ready to test your mettle in a world unlike any other, where speed and strategy collide in a symphony of controls, then ReHash awaits. Step up to the challenge, and embark on a journey that will push you to your limits and beyond.

Detailed Description: You’re an operative stuck in a time loop, always brought back from the dead to the same point. Choose your loadout and enter quantum unstable zones rich with active matter – the most valuable and the most dangerous resource in all multiverse. Fight against rivals from other timelines, survive physics-breaking anomalies and try to stay alive. Harvest active matter, gather loot and extract to a safe place before the whole zone ceases to exist with everything inside it. Active matter changes things and bends space and time, so you might encounter operatives and other survivors that lost their mind and humanity after exposure to this substance. Other players, though, would always be your most dangerous enemy. Expand your syndicate base, upgrade your arsenal and participate in fierce battles between syndicates over the key sources of active matter, as they’re your only chance to break out of the loop and gain control over your destiny. PvPvE extraction-style raids Players go solo or in small squads inside the quantum unstable zones in their quest for active matter and other loot. Active matter can be harvested by killing AM-transformed creatures,  taken away from other players or picked up directly from active matter clusters. Join this never ending hunt to improve your chances to find the way out of the time loop.Realistic weapons and gearActive matter randomly brings things from other timelines to the quantum unstable zones and allows you to replicate a specific item from other timelines in the safety of your base. Despite the mysterious origin of your weapons, your arsenal is always rooted in real-world military technologies and tactics, as war seems to be the only constant in this chaotic multiverse.  Gameplay-influencing active matter effectsMind-bending anomalies that change gravitational force and space topology right in front of your eyes. Thrilling encounters with eerie SCP-inspired objects would send shivers down your spine, and creatures transformed by active matter would attack you on sight.  Intense PvP  battlesSyndicates of operatives fight over control of a passive source of active matter, using all the weapons and other gear they can bring into battle or craft on site. Join PvP battles you like and make a real impact on the fate of the multiverse!Fascinating mapsBattles take place at locations that exist outside of space and time boundaries. Active Matter features a variety of maps, including a huge island with rusty Soviet industrial complexes and cryptic science labs that were among the first to study this new phenomena. Explore these places to find hints on the origin of active matter.

Will you defeat all the secret bosses and change the fate of the world?THE GARAGEDiscover cars like the Giant, Eagle, and DX Turbo, all revamped with a sleek new look. Game Name: The Demons Told Me to Make This Game
Detailed Description: The Demons… is a nonlinear dark comedy / Eldritch horror narrative adventure, featuring a colorful cast of charismatic people and terrifying demons, a mysterious little town of American Midwest, and a healthy forkful of time loop shenanigans. Ever heard of a hero with a voice in their head? Well this time, you get to be the voice, and you’ll have the heads of a whole crew of heroes at your disposal!  You play as Dark Wisp, a disembodied entity unbound by the constraints of time and space. Unfortunately, you are also stripped of any means of interacting with the physical world except one: by possessing some special people and whispering into their ears.  Brought to existence by unknown force, you find yourself in the middle of a hellish outbreak, threatening to turn Red Hives — a poor, obscure, and dying Midwestern town — into a poor, obscure and dying Midwestern town, now with demons. A crew of brave yet outrageously incompetent demon fighters is attempting to save the day, and (what are the odds?) they're the ones who can actually hear you! Now, before you speak to them, there’s only one thing left to figure out: whose side are you on?FEATURESPick your hosts. You can have only one human puppet at a time, the others will be left to their devices. Choose whom and when to possess to avoid unnecessary casualties. Talk to them. Assist them. Mock them. Bully them. They may not always listen, but they will always hear you. Get to know them. It may seem counterintuitive, but your hosts are more than just walking meatbags. They are bright and deep personalities, and each will require a unique approach.Bend their will. Your hosts disobey and all attempts to reason with them fail? Sounds like it’s time to play a mini-game and brute-force them into doing what you want. Explore timelines. You’re the master of time. Make choices, learn from your mistakes, then go back in time and try again with your newly gained knowledge. Collect clues. Red Hives is riddled with mysteries begging to be unraveled. Even before the demons, there was something deeply wrong with this town… No combat. Who needs it, anyway? Truly intelligent beings resolve their differences through dialogue. Demons included. Mostly. Be your worst self. Come on, kick that old lady. Don’t be afraid. We’ll rewind time, she won’t even remember. Come on. You know you want it. It’s okay. Just do it.

Detailed Description: Wishlist & follow!About the GameWelcome to a collection of fantastical and imaginative worlds, packed to the brim with memorable characters, rich stories, and unforgettable encounters. With regular updates bringing fresh features, new tales and more ways to support your favorite creators, there’s something for everyone.Jump into our Discord and let’s discover our next adventure together, shall we?

Detailed Description: WARNING: Extra Extra Poison contains flashing images. If you experience epileptic seizures or blackouts, immediately stop playing Extra Extra Poison and consult your doctor before resuming.A simple strategy board game featuring 20 different immune systems! Each immune system field is unique to it's employee, so vaccinate and cure them all! Fight off the employee's infection and get the highest score! In order to get the highest score, cover more space on the immune system field than the opponent. Features include saved high scores and unlockable secret quotes by our employees! We need them back at work ASAP! Also, please no vain photographs or video recording at work! In 2004 a local movie theater went out of business leaving their employees without a job. Not too long from it's closure a former employee named Bernard Jays decided to open his own movie theater a year later, and called it Bernard Cinemas. It was an absolute success! Since 2005 Bernard Cinemas became known for it's support of independent films and freshly made popcorn butter! Unfortunately during the early years of prosperity, thousands of employees who made the butter on a daily basis were infected and exposed to it's "Poison". Infected employees over time reported having fever, god complex, yellow skin, and yellow blood. Many have died due to complications of the Poison, but Bernard Cinemas never lost it's reputation or financial support. The hundreds of deaths did not put a dent in the company's operations. Film companies continued to flock, the wealthy continued to donate, politicians continued to protect, and the unfortunate continued to apply.Eventually, in 2018 when Bernard Cinemas gained a certain billion dollar threshold, corporate finally took exertion and decided to act by creating a vaccine called "Cell Disc" to combat the Poison. Since then every new generation of infected employees are required to take Cell Disc. Those who were able to survive the one-hour curing process were gifted with overtime and of course free movies! As of today, the Cell Disc vaccine has retained many hard working employees from possible death, giving them a newfound purpose to live and serve Bernard Cinemas forever!XX

Game Name: Lilia: The Fallen Flower in the Prison City
Detailed Description: The Grand Isles is a world filled with large islands. Centered in these islands is the royal capital of Freesia, where humans and demons coexist. Since angient times, humans have viewed demons with disdain, discriminating them for their vulgar appearance and inferior abilities, but not anymore. The king of the current era made it his mission to rectify the wrongs of the past and do away with discrimination and prejudice. However, it will take a lot of work and time before humans and demons can live together in peace and equality.In the trade city of Marigold, a spirited woman is setting off on her grand adventure. Her name is Lilia Flores. She's working as an adventurer to explore dungeons and save up money to fulfill her dreams. However, Lilia isn't someone with amazing athletic abilities or powerful magic talent. Facing failure after failure, Lilia continues to keep her head held high, positive that her next adventure will be better than her last. The daring Lilia sets off to a dangerous dungeon where a rumored expensive magic stone lays hidden.Meanwhile, in the royal capital of Freesia, a royal knights called Sheryl, who is working tirelessly to bring peace between humans and demons, receives an order: To investigate the recent demon disappearances. After finding a lead about a suspicious individual who has been frequenting the dungeon, Sheryl deduces that humans who have a deep grudge against the demonic race may have captured the missing demons! Bidding farewell to her lover and housemate, Roy, Sheryl ventures forth to investigate this case on her own.What will happen to Lilia and Sheryl when they meet in the depths of the dungeon? Can these two women, with their vastly different backgrounds and personalities, help each other escape the dungeon?Features:A Classic RPG ExperienceExplore the Depths of the DungeonGain Levels and AbilitiesSolve the Mystery of the Missing Demons

Detailed Description: Chaos Faction and Chaos Faction 2, the iconic Flash games that defined a generation, come together in the Chaos Faction Legacy Collection, both in their original format. Whether you’re a veteran of the chaotic battles or a newcomer ready to experience the mayhem for the first time, this collection is the ultimate tribute to the legendary brawlers.Two Games, One LegacyThe original Chaos Faction set the standard for fast-paced, explosive arena combat. Customize your character, select your weapons, and face off across a range of creative and dangerous levels. With its simple yet addictive gameplay, Chaos Faction became a staple of Flash gaming, now available to relive in its full glory.Chaos Faction 2, the sequel, builds on everything that made the original a hit and takes it to the next level. Battle through 15 campaign levels, each filled with weapons, characters, and moves, plus even more explosions. Progress unlocks powerful new fighters and gear (Three brand new bonus characters included!), leading to an epic showdown with the Hypergon.Endless Gameplay ModesWith multiple gameplay modes, including Campaign, Deathmatch, and Survival, you can enjoy countless hours of chaotic action. In Campaign mode, every victory unlocks new characters and weapons, pushing you closer to the ultimate battle. Deathmatch mode lets you create your own rules, offering endless replayability with customizable maps, enemies, and allies. And in Survival mode, test your skills against an onslaught of increasingly difficult foes.Join the ChaosWhether you’re playing solo or with a friend in Local Co-Op, the Chaos Faction Legacy Collection delivers non-stop action, hilarious mayhem, and a nostalgic gaming experience. Customize your characters, dominate the arenas, and relive the legacy of one of the greatest series in Flash game history. It’s time to reclaim your place in the chaos!

Detailed Description: In the ancient world, a sharp mind could take you far. But a sharp sword would take you farther.Since the beginning of recorded history, mighty empires have emerged to dominate the world, only to crumble into dust.Legions lets you relive the most glorious struggles for power in the ancient world. The Peloponnesian War, Caesar's conquest of Gaul, and the rise of Charlemagne are among the 10 challenging scenarios that will test your empire-building skills in this detailed strategy game.In Legions, as in life, there's more than one way to conquer the world. As the leader of an empire, you must balance diplomacy, economic manipulation and military strategy to attempt to overwhelm your opponents. You must position your armies strategically, then lead them into battle — where you may taste the bitter dregs of defeat, or bask in the glory of victory.Ten historical scenarios - from 1200 BC to 800 ADUnique role-playing opportunities - king, economic minister, diplomat, general, and moreRealistic market economy simulatorRandom scenario generator for those who want to write their own historyWhen diplomatic and economic maneuvering fail, let loose the dogs of war!

Game Name: ワールド・ネバーランド～オルルド王国物語～EXPERIENCE OF FICTION LIFE
Detailed Description: ◆Enjoy a Variety of Life ExperiencesIn "The Kingdom of Orurudo," you can enjoy a variety of life experiences in a peaceful, small-scale country through various milestones such as tournaments, romance, family, child-rearing, and work.◆Residents Are Also AliveThe residents of this country are not just "message boards" or "guides," but living beings with their own purposes, just like the player characters. In other words, the player's actions and interactions influence the lives and destinies of the residents, making every player's actions part of the scenario.◆Play Across Generations and Enjoy Various ElementsPlayers can pass their player character onto their children, allowing for multi-generational gameplay. Enjoy various elements such as league competitions, the DD Cup, and events that unravel the mysteries of the world.◆What is World Neverland?The concept of World Neverland is to realize the fantasy of entering a world that serves as the setting for stories in games and movies, where one can freely act and roam.There is no fixed storyline in this game. Players are able to create a virtual country where residents act according to their own will, allowing them to weave their own stories as inhabitants.This virtual world includes land, nature, buildings, social organizations, and people living their lives. Days pass from morning to night, seasons change throughout the year, annual events and seasonal festivals take place, residents are born, marry, have children, grow old, and eventually pass away, with their activities continuing across generations.Moreover, due to its simulation nature, no two countries are exactly alike."The Story of Orurudo Kingdom" marks the inaugural title in the World Neverland series.
Short Description: In the peaceful, fictional country of "World Neverland," where many people live, players can freely enjoy work, training, romance, child-rearing, participation in events and tournaments, and all aspects of life. It’s a game where you can relax, unwind, and feel happy.

Detailed Description: Welcome to Kerazand: Enchantments of Alchemy! In Aether Brew, you take on the role of an apprentice alchemist who escapes from a neighbouring continent and through a chance encounter inherits a long-discarded potion workshop in the mystical realm of Kerazand, near the cozy village of Verdale. Under the guidance of Eldwin, a ghostly former master alchemist, and his magical feline sidekick, Mr. Mittens, you will embark on an adventure to revive the old workshop, brew magical potions, and re-ignite the enchantments throughout the region. Explore, scavenge, and brew your way through a world where magic is dying—it’s up to you to restore its brilliance! Explore, Gather, BrewAether Brew is a game of discovery—new ways of interacting with a living, handmade world. Travel through a succession of varied, magical landscapes, from the serenity of Cerulean Grove to ember-hued plains and mysterious caves. Gather magical ingredients and put them to work in your upgradeable workshop, crafting base elements into spectacular potions that will help you earn the gold and experience to change the world around you. As you progress, recipes will grow more complex, brewing skills will improve, and new secrets will come to light. Simple yet DeepWithin Aether Brew, from the most straightforward to the deepest, the brewing system is approachable yet deep for any level of player to have fun brewing. Experiment with mixing ingredients, or help the eccentric inhabitants of Verdale, and unlock the clues of ancient brew guides they might have. Be it brewing a simple concoction or a powerful elixir, there is always something to be discovered. Meet the CastMemorably vibrant characters with stories and quests flesh out the world of Kerazand: Ivy, the gossipy tavern keeper who knows all local rumours; Arlo, the eccentric artisan who crafts magical trinkets. From the mischievous grove guardian Zephyra Dewleaf to Silvan the wandering merchant who you sell your potions to. Each character brings depth and intrigue into your journey, sculpting a magical world around you. A World to Explore!Kerazand is a world full of charming little details. Verdale, which once was the heart of the magical trade in the area, has fallen into decline due to the drying up of its magical energies and lack of magically skilled individuals. Delve into quests that will unleash hidden secrets, restore lost charm to the village, and bring balance once again to Kerazand's magic in the region. You'll be forming bonds, collecting powerful ingredients, and bringing back the magic that once flowed so freely through this land while you're out exploring Verdale and its surroundings. Key Features:- Hand-Crafted World: Enter the world of Kerazand, replete with unique locations, magical creatures, and charming lore.- Deep Alchemy System: Brew potions out of a huge variety of ingredients. Discover potions through trial and error or find lost brewing notes in the world!- Engaging Quests: Help the inhabitants of Verdale, solve mysteries, and restore magic to a region in peril of losing its magic.- Upgradeable Workshop: Craft your alchemical workshop to fit your style of brewing with various tools, marvellous machines, and upgrades. - Gripping Story and Characters: A vast cast, each with their own stories, quests, and relations with the magical world.

Detailed Description: Cube Jumper VRStep into the immersive, cube-filled world of Cube Jumper VR, where one wrong step could send you plunging into lethal lava! Designed for VR, this fast-paced platformer challenges your reflexes and agility as you jump, collect diamonds, and survive increasingly difficult levels—all in a stunning, 3D virtual reality environment.  Gameplay:In Cube Jumper VR, dive into an action-packed adventure where your goal is to collect every diamond scattered across a variety of engaging levels. As you leap through the cube-filled environment, you’ll face numerous obstacles, including traps and enemies designed to challenge your progress. In Shooter mode, the stakes are even higher: in addition to gathering all diamonds, you must shoot down all targets to complete each level. The game tests your reflexes and strategic thinking as you navigate increasingly difficult and time-consuming levels.Creativity is essential—some diamonds are located in hard-to-reach spots, requiring inventive solutions and clever maneuvers to access them. Collecting diamonds and shooting targets not only helps you progress to the next level but also earns you valuable points and unlocks achievements. These points contribute to your ranking on the global leaderboard, adding a competitive edge to your gameplay, while achievements showcase your skills and milestones. Game Modes:    • Free Play: Explore the cube world at your own pace, collect diamonds, and master your jumping skills.     • Time Attack: Race against the clock for the fastest time while navigating tricky levels and avoiding dangerous falls.    • Shooter: Grab your weapon and take on hostile NPCs like spiders and drones. Shoot down targets while keeping yourself above the lava in this action-packed mode.Key Features:    • Immersive VR Gameplay: Experience platforming like never before in full 3D, where every jump and fall feels real.    • Pickups and Power-ups: Collect diamonds and resources to enhance your abilities and score higher.    • Three Game Modes: Free Play for exploration, Time Attack for speedrunners, and Shooter for those who love action-packed combat.    • Intense Combat: In Shooter mode, defend yourself against a variety of enemies, avoid traps, and shoot at targets to complete levels.Platforms and Requirements:Available on PC VR systems.Note: An Oculus VR headset is required to play this game. Ensure that your headset is properly set up and that your PC meets or exceeds these requirements for the best experience.Call to Action:Get ready to jump into action—literally! Add Cube Jumper VR  to your wishlist and prepare for an intense, cube-filled adventure!

Detailed Description: The story of the 100-day adventure of Solaris, a a Less magic power witch, and her homunculus sidekick.Players choose from six daily activities to improve their abilities, learn skills, and earn money while confronting enemies. They can also develop weapons and equipment and rest to recover their strength.The greatest feature of the game is its beautiful fully animated combat and tense battles with QTE (Quick Time Event). The variety of buffs and debuffs make the battles a pleasure to play. If you lose, you have to start over from day 1, but you will enjoy finding strategies through repeated challenges.The attractive characters are also not to be missed. The story is further deepened by interactions with a variety of characters who contribute to Solaris' growth, including the excellent rival wizard Tetia, the store owner August, the strict but kind mother Croise, and the three wise men Balthazar and Melchior, who manage the town.

Detailed Description: Japan Trip is a captivating visual novel that takes you on an unforgettable adventure through the bustling streets of Tokyo, where every corner holds new experiences and every encounter could change your life forever. You’ve arrived in Japan’s vibrant capital city, looking for something more—more excitement, more connection, and maybe even more love. But as you explore Tokyo’s bright lights and hidden corners, you soon discover that it’s not just the stunning cityscape that has your heart racing—it’s the people you meet along the way.Tokyo is full of fascinating personalities, and soon you find yourself drawn into the lives of several intriguing women, each offering a unique perspective on life, love, and everything in between. Your journey is filled with choices, and each one could bring you closer to a heartfelt connection—or a hilariously awkward misstep. Will you find romance amidst the whirlwind energy of Tokyo, or will the city’s complexities leave you tangled in a web of charming chaos?Meet the Characters:The Sweet Country Girl: She’s left her small village behind, coming to Tokyo with big dreams and wide-eyed wonder. She’s just as overwhelmed by the city as you are, and her innocence and sincerity make her a refreshing change from the fast-paced life of the metropolis. Together, you might just find the comfort of home in the middle of the neon-lit chaos.The Lady Boss: She’s a sharp, no-nonsense businesswoman who commands respect in the boardroom but harbors a secret longing for something more personal. As your boss, she’s all about results—until she starts seeing you in a different light. Will you dare to get closer to this corporate shark, or will you keep things strictly professional?The Wild Party Girl: A whirlwind of energy with a rebellious streak, she lives for the night, the music, and the thrill of Tokyo’s underground scene. With her ever-changing style and love for karaoke, she’s a bundle of contradictions—unpredictable, fiery, and a little dangerous. Can you keep up with her pace, or will she leave you dizzy with her antics?The Mysterious Heiress: She lives a life of luxury, but there’s an air of solitude around her. She’s elegant, composed, and always in control—but beneath the surface, she’s curious about you and your perspective on life. She might even want to bring you into her world… but are you ready to be treated like her personal pet?The Nightlife Diva: A star of Tokyo’s secret nightlife, she’s seen the city’s shadows as well as its lights. Her path hasn’t been easy, and she carries the scars of her past with quiet grace. But there’s something alluring about her world-weary wisdom and her ability to navigate Tokyo’s hidden side. Are you brave enough to dive into the underworld of Tokyo with her?Features:Engaging Storyline: Experience a rich narrative that combines romance, humor, and drama, set against the backdrop of Tokyo’s electrifying nightlife and serene cultural sites.Character-Driven Interactions: Develop deep, meaningful relationships with five unique women, each with their own story to tell and secrets to uncover.Multiple Endings: Your choices matter! Shape the story and your relationships, leading to multiple possible endings with each character.Stunning Visuals: Immerse yourself in beautifully illustrated scenes that capture both the bustling energy of Tokyo and its more intimate, quiet moments.Animated Intimate Scenes: Enjoy fully animated adult scenes that bring each encounter to life with fluid motion and sensual detail.Lush Soundtrack: Set the mood with a rich, atmospheric soundtrack that perfectly complements each moment, from tender conversations to pulse-pounding nights out.

Detailed Description: About This GameOne Turn Kill is a PvE card game focused on drawing and deck control. The system is centered around the thrill of drawing cards and the challenging condition of defeating the enemy within a single turn. Even just one slip-up may be fatal, leading to a suspenseful and unique play experience. Join the protagonist in a pixel art wasteland to face off with the strongest of enemies and see what story awaits.Game FeaturesUnique system where draws cost:Drawing cards from the deck costs card uses. Enjoy highly reproducible combos with abundant draws while also strategizing to avoid running out of cards.Synergistic deck building:Cards and skills differ in their compatibility. By skillfully combining them, you can achieve more powerful effects than when using them alone. Players can unleash a wide range of strategies using a deck limited to 20 cards. How you build your deck will determine whether or not you are victorious.Speedy and suspenseful one-turn battles:If you cannot defeat the enemy on the first turn, the enemy's counterattack will soon determine who wins. This condition allows you to enjoy tough battles requiring quick and precise action.Visuals and Background MusicUsing cards allows characters to move in sync with one another with rich animation. Enjoy catchy background music that matches the game's quick pace and lingers in your ears, creating an even more immersive gaming experience.

Detailed Description: Weapons of War is a world filled with hundreds of quests for players to complete over the course of thousands of hours. Take to arms with five vastly different classes and take down the world's greatest enemies with equipment that requires diligent upgrading, and fight on the battlefield against other players to see who's the best.In ancient orient, there lies a peaceful and serene continent where the human race has lived in peace and harmony for many generations. Happiness enveloped every living creature, eager to maintain the tranquility of their daily lives. However, beneath the stillness of the vast lands lays an ancient evil, quietly collecting energy for years on end, preparing to be born again.  When the dark force finally regained its strength and power, the unknown evil breakthrough the surface and wreaked havoc and carnage to all living creature, spilling blood on the once peaceful evergreen. Hence the dark force was called the Blood King and has claimed the Blood Palace as its kingdom. The Blood King’s onslaught continued, slaughtering thousands of mortals and other living creatures further strengthening its power by absorbing the precious soul energy residing in everyone. Those were the dark time. The whole world was bathed in blood and fear. People became destitute and homeless. The once beautiful and peaceful continent became a hell filled with corpses and vile creatures.Amidst the terror, a spark of hope remains. The great rabbi Master Tian Meng of the North brought with him a mighty force never seen before. Fortified with unique abilities and gifted with the power to wield mighty weapons at their will, this army rallied to stop the bloodshed and regain peace once more. They invaded the Blood Palace in what was known as the Great Blood War. This historical battle lasted for five days; with the death of the Blood King under Master Tian Meng’s super skill known as Heaven Ice. The evil forces were sealed inside a mystical ice block and locked deep within the icy pools of the Green Scarp.After the Blood King was sealed and imprisoned beneath the icy depths, the villagers began to rebuild their home-stead. The whole continent gradually regained peace and harmony, similar to their loves they led before the Blood King shattered the tranquility. In order to safeguard the human race, Master Tian Meng and his Soul Benders decided to create their own heroes and accepted numerous apprentices whose main duty is to safeguard the lands. And so the Monk, Wizard, Fairy, Tamed and Assassin – the five heroes came into being. The force of Justice became stronger and stronger as the years went on.Several decades have passed since the mighty army of Soul Benders stood and defeated the Blood King. Unknown to many, the icy prison lying deep within the chilly pools of the Greens Scrap has disappeared. Once again the dark force has awakened calling forth all evil alliances, destroying all that crossed its patch, causing mayhem among simple folks and spilling blood of its victim as part of its revenge. Terror and confusion filled the air. The five righteous heroes were appointed to act together to find out the truth.

The whole continent gradually regained peace and harmony, similar to their loves they led before the Blood King shattered the tranquility. In order to safeguard the human race, Master Tian Meng and his Soul Benders decided to create their own heroes and accepted numerous apprentices whose main duty is to safeguard the lands. And so the Monk, Wizard, Fairy, Tamed and Assassin – the five heroes came into being. The force of Justice became stronger and stronger as the years went on.Several decades have passed since the mighty army of Soul Benders stood and defeated the Blood King. Unknown to many, the icy prison lying deep within the chilly pools of the Greens Scrap has disappeared. Once again the dark force has awakened calling forth all evil alliances, destroying all that crossed its patch, causing mayhem among simple folks and spilling blood of its victim as part of its revenge. Terror and confusion filled the air. The five righteous heroes were appointed to act together to find out the truth.

Detailed Description: 《静府·刺眼》是一款以女性为主视角的明式密室逃脱解谜游戏。 身为女警，莫名魂穿到了一座诡秘府院之中。静寂悚然的小院，身形可怖的尸体，格格不入的物什，似曾相识的怨灵……冥冥中似乎有一股天意让人无法后退。推开院门，剖解迷局，逃脱此地，或许，还会了解到更为幽远的秘事，一切才刚刚开始。掠杀、庇护，静寂的府邸下暗流涌动；  仇恨、珍爱，苦痛的心脏中光明永存。 贯穿几代女性的存亡故事，讲述生命的挣扎与不屈。 冷硬而和润， 渺远却了然。 利用雅致幽深的美术音乐，烘托别有意境的独特氛围。  外能无力，内念长存。 透过个性鲜明的人物角色，与其红尘际遇产生心灵共鸣。丝丝缠连，环环相扣， 一切答案尽存于心中。 打造易于上手的点击式冒险机制，操作鼠标去解开一连串的谜题。

Detailed Description: In Reaper Rules, you will switch between two characters with distinct perspectives that completely change the gameplay style and your approach to victory. Get ready to face challenging levels, epic bosses, and an engaging narrative full of choices and surprises. Discover the purpose of each character as they fight to save those they love.Two Perspectives, Two Experiences:Embark on a journey focused on narrative, where interpreting the characters’ points of view is essential. The game blends platforming action with top-down gameplay, thanks to the two protagonists who each have unique camera styles and abilities.Side-Scrolling Perspective (Asso): Take on platforming levels, defeat enemies, and face brutal bosses, all while following the rules set by the Reaper. Armed with a scythe, you’ll battle enemies for a greater purpose, trying to escape a mysterious place... but where exactly? No spoilers here! 😉Top-Down Perspective (Jake): Shoot enemies from all directions and transform into a powerful creature to destroy everything in your path. Surviving these challenges will be key to understanding your motivations and reaching your goals.A Deep Story:Reaper Rules isn’t just an action-adventure game. It offers a captivating narrative that blends violence, drama, tough choices, and triumph. Dive into the motivations of the characters as they attempt to escape the virtual world that traps them.Key Features:Varied Gameplay: Switch between side-scrolling and top-down perspectives, with entirely different levels and challenges.Action and Adventure: Use the scythe, shoot enemies, and face bosses that will test your skills to the very end of the journey.Intriguing Story: A rich narrative with alternative choices and dramatic moments that affect the characters’ fate.Humor and Surprises: Unexpected twists and witty jokes that will keep you glued to the screen.Are you ready to uncover the secrets and escape this deadly game?

Detailed Description: At Blacklands Manor Orphanage, life takes a chilling turn for Esther when a donation box arrives, containing three seemingly innocent toys: a tiger named Mr. Stripes, a panda named Miss Bo, and a rabbit named Mr. Hopp. Esther and her two friends, Molly and Isaac, are delighted and quickly grow attached to them. However, their joy is short-lived as strange and unsettling events begin to occur, centered around the toys. Esther notices strange happenings and an ominous atmosphere that settles over the orphanage. Soon, the situation escalates when Molly and Isaac mysteriously vanish without a trace, leaving Esther desperate for answers. Determined to find her friends, Esther begins to investigate the mystery of the toys and their connection to an ancient malevolence known as the Entity. Through her investigation, she learns about the dark history of Blacklands and the true nature of these donated toys. As Esther confronts eerie manifestations and deciphers cryptic puzzles, she sets out to defeat the Entity and rescue Molly and Isaac, hoping to lift the long-standing curse that has plagued Blacklands. Step back into the world of the indie hit Mr. Hopp's Playhouse 2, now in this stylized HD remake!

Detailed Description: Mobility scooters, chaos, and laughs—welcome to the wildest ride of your life!Ready to unleash some ridiculous scooter-driven mayhem? Take on the role of an old, grumpy driver in a turbocharged mobility scooter as you race through the city of Bompidorm. Your mission? Pick up humans scattered throughout the madness and deliver them to safety—all while outmaneuvering your equally grumpy rivals. PvP? Oh, you bet. Ragdoll physics? Absolutely. Laughs? Guaranteed.  It’s you versus everyone else! Whether you're blasting rivals off the track with a well-timed explosion or speeding toward the hospital, the only thing standing between you and victory is a city full of chaos. Who will be the ultimate grumpy champion?  Expect the unexpected—because in this game, anything can (and will) happen. From scooters flipping out of control to pedestrians being hilariously thrown across the map, it's all part of the fun. Embrace the unpredictability, and just go with the flow (or the crash).  What's better than causing chaos alone? Causing chaos with friends, of course! Play with your buddies, or make some new enemies—because nothing brings people together like throwing them off their scooters in hilarious fashion.  Think you have what it takes to be the ultimate grumpy driver? Grab your scooter, rally your friends, and dive headfirst into the most ridiculous game of your life. The city’s waiting—just don’t crash (too hard). 🚀"Buckle up, it’s going to be one wild ride!"Get ready to laugh, rage, and everything in between. Join the madness, and remember: scooters aren’t just for getting around—they’re for domination. 🏆

Detailed Description: Reach the furthest stations in the postapocalyptic top down shooter and platformer looter. Loot tunnels in side scrolling mode and survive from waves of monsters on the stations in a top down twin stick shooter mode. How far will you go?Destroy boxes to find crucial loot in tunnels, between stations. Boxes contain upgrades, weapons, ammo and coins and you have only 40 seconds to find whatever you need during platformer tunnel phase. Light shuts down every 5 seconds, during which you will have to move forward.Upgrading your axe skill will make smashing boxes faster. Keys found in monsters bodies will open boxes faster.Shoot your way through stations in a top down twin-stick shooter phase of the game. Quantity and thoughness of enemies go slowly up with every next station, along your upgrades and weapons. 20 different types of enemies will be waiting for you at the stations. You can hold and use two weapons at the same time, manage your ammo responsibly. Additionally you will have special abilities at your disposal, such as landmines, shield, glue trap and teleporter, that will help you leave every station alive.Upgrade temporarily and permanently.Open boxes with green arrows to find upgrades of your skills and weapons. Each upgrade improves your stats by small amount but you can keep upgrading endlessly. Buy permanent weapon upgrades for collected coins.Unlock achievements for permanent upgrades of your character's skills.Survive as many stations as possible.Fighting enemies will not always be the best solution, sometimes you can avoid them or run away from them.Every tunnel has a healing chamber at the end of it. The more time you will save, the more life points you will restore before all lights shut down.

Detailed Description: What do you get when you mix FPS, Roguelike, Parkour, and... robots that want to destroy you? TowerUp!In the main mode, you’re a robot (yes, another robot... but this one has attitude and an endless supply of bad jokes). Your "dream job"? Escaping from a magic portal, navigating through rooms filled with traps and robots that only exist to mess with you. The cherry on top? Every time you die (and oh, you’ll die a lot), you earn money and upgrades. Because, let’s face it, dying should have some perks, right?Game modes:TowerUp: The main adventure where you fight robots, explore a procedurally generated complex filled with enemies, and try to take down the company that, surprise, created you. Easy peasy... or not.Duelo: Because nothing says "friendship" like challenging your buddy to a 1v1 and rubbing those kills in their face.Arena: Like Duelo, but now with teams of up to 5 robots, ready to see who can wreak the most havoc in a massive map.But believe me, TowerUp isn’t just about how many times you’ll die. It’s also about moving with style: parkour, insane jumps, and that sweet, sweet feeling of gliding over enemy robots while pulling off some cinematic shots.Features:Singleplayer, Multiplayer, and modes that will test your patience and reflexes.A power-up system that makes the chaos even more fun.Ultra-dynamic movement – because walking in a straight line is for chumps.Lots of robots... but you’re the robot with guns and a dream of destruction!TowerUp: be the robot everyone wants to see blow the place up!
