Detailed Description: THE GAME IS (NOT) OVER! GAME (not) OVER is an innovative Deck-Building Survivors-Like, taking blending elements of both genres to offer a fresh game. Lost in the world of video games, use cards to summon hero allies, and defend yourself from the hordes of villains who want to claim their revenge on you! NON-STOP SURVIVORS ACTION! Your character is no hero… but their video game allies are!Position cleverly your allies around you and watch them blast away the hordes of incoming enemies.In classic "bullet-heaven" fashion, you’ll face hordes of increasingly strong enemies. But your allies will get stronger too!CHOOSE YOUR CARDS, THEN SUMMON AND LEVEL UP YOUR ALLIES! GAME (not) OVER is also a deck-building game! Each turn, lasting about 30 seconds, you draw five cards, and you’ll need to use wisely the energy you have to summon allies to protect you! Including…The peasant, defending himself with his pitchfork!The wizard, commanding thunder!The witch, throwing powerful fireballs! The ninja, attacking enemies with his shuriken!The cyborg, slashing with their energy swords!The fury, summoning powerful tornadoes!The space admiral, summoning beams from above!The knight, blasting enemies away with his sword of light!The ice queen, freezing enemies in their tracks!And more!But remember, your enemies can kill your allies too… and if they do, you’ll lose their firepower!AN EXCITING BLEND OF GENRES! Defeat your enemies to gain experience, and use that experience to pick up new cards that will allow you to summon new allies when you play them! Play these cards again with your allies in the field to level them up, making them more powerful! Take your time strategizing, choose which allies will protect you the best… Then blast away your enemies with their powerful abilities!A run in this rogue-like lasts about 30 minutes. Will you survive, in the world of video games?

Detailed Description: Contact UsAbout the GameRest in Peace is a rogue-like adventure game, possessing an exciting journey in a weird countryside setting against legends of Chinese folklore, imbibes huge amounts of anecdotes and old saws.Players in Rest in Peace, watchmen from the nether world, have taken ‘exorcising devils’ as their core mission. You are free to choose combinations of spell-like skills, to decide the path of enhancements for skills on your own. -Bizarre World: Between Yin and YangRest in Peace is a rogue-like adventure game set in a ghast countryside filled with evil spirits and demons, located in a bizarre region on the fringes of the human and ghostly realms. -Adventure: Weird and Fascinating Players, as watchmen from the nether world, will exorcise the demons hiding in a ghast countryside surrounded by dark dank scrubs and trees. Some of those watchmen have familiar faces and were well-known within the thousands-of-year folk culture of China. Some are strange but still vivid characters,  unique in Rest in Peace, created by our talented fellows according to outlandish tales based on their own experiences.Also, the demons in Rest in Peace, which players will take themselves as encounters, are evil spirits and weird monsters often seen in folklore spread widely in our culture. Those demons have tortuous and fantastic backstorys, providing players endless fancy and imagination.Besides the core mission: exorcising the demons, huge amounts of temporary missions awaited in Rest in Peace. In those extra missions, players will see more annoying spirits and monsters. We hope those missions can provide players with exciting feelings in adventures as much as possible.-Battle: A fancy match of gameplay, replay value, and pleasurePlayers will get rewards by defeating evil spirits and monsters in Rest in Peace. Those rewards can enhance the power of their avatars in different ways.By picking up some of those rewards, players’ avatars can learn various spell-like skills; Meanwhile, combine those skills to create the strongest packages of skills for follow-up battles. Players can adjust their skill packages at any time: changing choices of skills, selecting the appropriate combination of skills, decide the direction of enhancement of skills, which will make every second of battles a brand-new experience.-Promising future: constantly and gradually updatingGame designers are committed to providing players with fresh, timely, interesting gameplay content. We are willing to give a satisfactory answer to players who like and support the whole mechanics of game design.We are eager to hear feedback from passionate players. Your valuable ideas can help us to optimize the quality of Rest in Peace.

Detailed Description: Help our ‘heroes’ solve a ghoulish enigma that revolves around the university in this old-school point ‘n’ click adventure.Just like it happened to the A-team, our main characters will be accused of being the authors of an atrocious malefaction they didn’t commit. The story begins with them testifying in front of a pissed off student council which demands an explanation of the incident. Here, each of our main characters will offer their side of the story.3 boneheads under your command: Unlike what happened in Randal’s Monday, this time you will be able to control 3 different characters (Randal, Matt and Charlie). Each of them will have access to different locations, items, skills and dialogue options that will be exclusive to each of them.Solve each puzzle your way: Not everything is just ‘use the appropriate item in the correct spot’. Sometimes we will be forced to go under interrogations, riddles, or problems that require logic. However, they can be solved in many different ways, depending what character you are controlling at the time and how bad do you want to see them suffer.A plot that delivers: In this story we will jump from one character to another, there will be many flashbacks and the best cards will be saved for the home stretch. But if you enjoy surreal humor and unexpected plot twists, this game is for you.A college vibe to it: Want to chug from a beer keg while doing a handstand? Cheat on a test? Go to a toga party? Beat some nerds on a role-playing game? Take some chick to the spring ball? Overcome some of the toughest trials to join an exclusive fraternity? Then, you belong here.Nerdy collectables: The campus will be overflowing with different items that you can collect. But you will also find many bootleg copies of some epic games such as Ultimate Fantasy VII or Plastic Gear Solid. These collectables will be added to a list for you to check anytime. If you find them all, there’s an additional surprise for you.To keep the mystery alive and to avoid spoiling some of the game’s connections with Randal’s Monday we cannot really talk about the game’s plot in depth so this section will not be too long. In fact, we would’ve been better off by just skipping it, but we had created the ‘story’ sign already and we thought it would be a pity not to use it.Anywho, as stupid as it may sound, everything begins on a Wednesday, early in the morning. Our three protagonists are testifying in front of the Student Council leaded by no other than the Dean himself. They have been accused of committing a horrendous act (players don’t know about it just yet) and this is the only chance they have to try and clean their names.Each of them will then explain what they did on the previous day, narrating the game’s plot through flashbacks, although, at certain points the story will focus on the present again.There will be some connections in the storyline with Randal’s Monday, but don’t fret, you don’t need to play Randal’s Monday to be able to understand and fully enjoy the game. We would like to insist on this point.

Detailed Description: 《孤行》是东北砍王工作室制作的第一款视觉小说。《游戏背景》在古代社会制度下，张四与父母、朋友在宁静村安然度日，每一个清晨都伴随着阳光与欢笑，每一个黄昏都被宁静与祥和笼罩，生活就像一湾平静的湖水，没有丝毫波澜。然而，战争宛如恶魔般突然降临，无情地打破了这份宁静。战火纷飞中，张四的世界崩塌了，他被迫踏上了一条充满未知的荆棘之路。在后续的旅程中，他遭遇了重重困难，误解如影随形，各种纷繁复杂的事情接踵而至，形形色色的人在他的生命中穿梭。这些经历如同磨刀石，一点点打磨着他的性格，让他在命运的漩涡中不断挣扎、蜕变，最终走向一个无法预知的人生彼岸，是沉沦于黑暗，还是破茧成蝶，一切都在你的探索之中。《游戏特色》➤剧情以简易的鼠标点击操作，轻松开启一段段精彩对话。在精美的画风渲染下，每一个场景都仿佛是一幅栩栩如生的画卷。细腻的笔触勾勒出角色的一颦一笑，色彩的搭配营造出或温馨、或压抑、或神秘的氛围，让你仿佛置身于那个古老的世界，与角色们同呼吸、共命运，沉浸式体验剧情的跌宕起伏，感受其中的喜怒哀乐。➤战斗通过键盘灵活控制角色移动，仿佛你就是战场上的斗士，而鼠标则是你手中的利器，轻轻点击即可发射飞镖。这种简单易上手的战斗方式，无需复杂的操作技巧，让你在紧张刺激的战斗中如鱼得水。战斗环节巧妙地融入剧情体验过程，为整个游戏增添了别样的趣味性，使你在欣赏剧情的同时，也能感受到战斗带来的热血与激情。《开发人员》程序：砍王美术：透明渡

Detailed Description: Monsters have returned to our lands! Undead and goblins are trying to destroy us. Stop them before they reach the portal! Place towers that will attack them! Summon soldiers, place barricades to stop them! You can summon a slowing fog that will appear near the towers and slow down the movement of enemies along the roads. For destroyed enemies, rubies are given, which can be spent on building towers. Use magic, which is gradually restored. Enemies come in different types, some are fast, some have a large supply of health. Act carefully and you will win!Many enemiesInteresting gameplayDynamic gameplay

Detailed Description: GPS5: THE ULTIMATE SIMULATION OF TODAY'S WORLD Geopolitical Simulator 5 - aka GPS5 - is a simulation of our current world, recreating its features in-depth and across a number of domains: economic, political, military, social, financial, environmental, energetic, transportation…Every country and major multinational corporation are represented with their own variables and functions. The calculation and scenario engines include more than 150,000 facts and figures, 20,000 texts, and 12 hours of recorded dialog. An ultra-detailed and animated 3D map with vegetation, bodies of water, every border, regions, production facilities, and important strategic sites around the world become your playground.The game combines management stages of economics, commerce, wargames, construction, espionage, simulation, and political influence and manipulation.You can opt to control one or more countries or one or more major corporations simultaneously and devise collaborative strategies to change your own destiny or the world's. Game sessions are customizable in several ways: activity level of terrorist organizations, probability of natural disasters, reactions of the people, outbreak of wars... More than twenty contextual scenarios with current events from today's world are integrated.The game engine, Geopolitical Simulator 5, includes over 600 data elements for each of the 175 playable countries and calculates their changes in real time throughout the game based on players’ actions. Some examples include popularity ratings, political relations, and economic exchanges between countries. More than 3000 major worldwide companies are included along with their real world data and several thousand others are simulated for all economic sectors and all the countries of the world. The simulator technology of GPS 5 is used by various organizations for instruction or training purposes, including NATO.WHAT'S NEW IN GPS5New Map The new 3D world map is 10 times more precise than GPS4, with almost 2 million polygons and more than 10 million grid squares for you to build on along with the ability to zoom in closer to the ground. There are new high-resolution textures (forests, rocks, farmland...) along with the modeling of rivers, lakes, bridges, tunnels, and more than 60 types of buildings (commercial, factories, infrastructures...)The military unit movement AI is optimized according to the type of terrain and highways.New Macro-Economic Engine It has been restructured to include the simulation of thousands of worldwide companies that contribute to the GDP of the country, with finer detail on economic exchanges between countries, product shortages and surplus situations, price variation, taxes, embargoes, etc. The engine includes all the buildings present on the world map and in all activity sectors (in GPS4, only the energy sector was included). New sectors have been added: fertilizer, hydrogen, food industry, medical equipment, mobile phones, etc.New Interface The interface has been completely redesigned and revamped to be more dynamic and user-friendly.It is designed to adapt to different-sized screens and to make use of their respective configurations, especially for 4K screens or double screens. The player can also choose the scale of the interface for optimal viewing and to pre-position game windows to organize and personalize their space. A generalized information system allows the player to access detailed explanations or additional information on game elements.TURMOIL AROUND THE GLOBE In 2024, points of tension are emerging almost everywhere, threatening to destabilize the global geopolitical equilibrium and whose outcomes are extremely uncertain.Four new scenarios to illustrate this chaotic world:US Elections: with the candidate of your choice, you the player run your campaign to win the presidential election and redefine American politics.Threats to the Olympic Games: terrorist organizations redouble their efforts on the Olympic Games in Paris. The player must act quickly to thwart any attempted terrorist attacks.New Data on France: after the surprise dissolution by the French head of state, you become the head of the opposition party or the new head of the French government after legislative elections, with an eye on the presidential election in 2027.PLAY AS THE HEAD OF STATE Over one thousand playable actions. At the country’s helm, the player/head of state can act in many areas: budget, taxation (nearly thirty types of taxes), currency, economy (over 130 economic activities), foreign and domestic affairs, defense, society, labor, health, social security, education, environment, transportation, culture, and more.Propose bills to be voted on in Parliament, for example: setting social welfare benefit minimums, changing the retirement age, developing atomic weapons in secret, subsidizing the auto industry, hiring teachers, defining the powers of unions, setting speed limits on roads, regulating prostitution, creating an international film festival, etc.The player can also construct elements on the world map, which will change accordingly: nuclear plants, wind farms, military bases, pipelines, high-speed train lines, airports, and many more.PLAY AS THE OPPOSITION At the head of a legal or illegal organization, the player can take power by force, revolution, diplomacy, or democratic election. To that end, players have many actions at their disposal: manage the budget of the party or illegal organization, intervention in the media, give voting advice to Parliament, launch protest movements, lobbying, manipulation of influential persons, funding or recruitment campaigns, creation of violent cells, purchase military equipment, raise an army, seek allies, engage in armed conflict... During elections, players must manage their campaign budget, establish their political agenda, complete their meeting itinerary, confront their adversary in televised debates…PLAY AS THE CEO OF A MULTINATIONAL CORPORATION As the head of one or more of these companies, you have all the tools and all the information necessary to lead and develop your companies.Each company's data is precisely detailed: revenue, market shares, sales by product, competition, shareholders, staffing, balance sheet...You must engage in multiple activities within the company: production, commerce, marketing, human resources, finances, taxation, research, security, legal, and politics.You'll have advisors in various domains and you can also speak to your banker, shareholder representative, or union leader.Reaching these goals - for example, becoming one of the largest multinational companies in the world or joining the ranks of the billionaire class - will also require resolving conflicts with the union AI, demonstrating sound strategy concerning the competition by making financial decisions (takeover bids, creation of subsidiaries, initial public offerings…), even crossing over to the dark side (along with the risks involved) by engaging in malfeasance of all kinds (paying out kickbacks, tax evasion, tax fraud, illegal price fixing, political lobbying).LOBBYIST AND CHARACTER AI All actions of the player as head of state or opposition have repercussions and lobbies, social groups, and important national and international figures will intervene if their artificial intelligence deems necessary (press interviews, resignations, protests, strikes, unrest, blocked roads, wars...).To prevent tensions or forge alliances, the player can meet any figure during the meeting or intervene in the media (more than 12 hours of dialogue in the game).REALISTIC WARGAMES AND CITY BATTLE PHASES The world map incorporates all places of conflict down to the smallest detail: occupied territories, besieged cities, locations of military units, international military bases, personnel and equipment of terrorist groups...As a warlord, players can direct all of their units from real bases during military conflicts. City battles are shown on precise maps with all the major buildings and intersections. The players, according to the side they represent, can direct police, hooligans, military personnel or armed extremists to these locations and construct barricades, send in snipers, loot the banks, or have armoured vehicles move in.SECRET SERVICESSecret services play an important role. They have an arsenal of espionage and special operations: reveal scandals about an opposing political party, dismantle terrorist networks, sabotage foreign infrastructure, assassinate an opponent, send reconnaissance drones or position satellites to locate enemy units, etc.INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONSInternational organizations (over 50 organizations included) play an important role. At the UN, for example, the player can denounce a nation in order to obtain the Security Council’s authorization for a military intervention. The player can also create his or her own organization.SIMULATION OF MAJOR GLOBAL THREATSGeopolitical Simulator 5 simulates all the major perils that threaten the planet and produces a comprehensive assessment for each one from the results along with specific graphics. The list of threats is substantial and many of them are interconnected: global warming, the widening of social inequality, the risk of global atomic war, overpopulation, unemployment, atmospheric pollution, terrorism, cybercrime, regional conflicts, food insecurity, world hunger, deforestation, natural disasters (storms, floods, drought, extreme heat...), rising sea levels, ocean acidity, disappearance of animal species, climate refugees, epidemics, endocrine-disrupting chemicals…MULTIPLE OPTIONSSingle-player game in multi-country mode allows the player to play multiple countries and/or companies simultaneously● Game settings: terrorist activities, probabilities of natural disasters, reactivity of the populations, outbreak of war● Player ranking online and in real time● Incorporation of your own photos, logos, names to make the game even more realistic● Interactive tutorial and game help available at all times during the game● Configuration options with double screen or 4K screen, choice of interface size for optimal viewing, and the option to personalize and reorganize your space.● Generalized help screens to access detailed information about game elements● Text and dialog 100% in English

Detailed Description: StoryEvery nook and cranny in Bloom Paradise was once filled with flowers of every color, until one day when pesky pests came and ravaged the land, rendering it unrecognizable. Thus, flower fairies Tamabo and Hanabo have joined forces, setting off on an adventure to restore Bloom Paradise to its former glory and get rid of those irksome pests.How to PlayPlay as either Tamabo (Player 1) or Hanabo (Player 2) and make flowers bloom. Fill all the grounds in each stage to clear it. How you bloom flowers differs between single-player mode and two-player mode. In single-player mode, flowers bloom on the ground as Tamabo walks across. In two-player mode, however, when either Tamabo or Hanabo walks across the ground, only flower buds appear. The other character must then touch these buds to make them bloom. Work together to take back Bloom Paradise from the pests. Both Tamabo and Hanabo can shoot water in the direction they're facing with the use of the attack button. Flowers can't bloom when the ground is covered in mud, so use water to clean up and eradicate any pests standing in your way.Features・100 total stages ・19 types of bothersome yet likable pests・Single-player and two-player coop modes with differing ways to play・Game design reminiscent of late 80s arcade games

Game Name: OCEANIDES of the World's End: Legend of the Big-Breasted Swimsuit Beauty Guardian
Detailed Description: In a world where everything has sunk into the sea, protect the ark with big-breasted swimsuit beauties!A high-tempo defense game with simple controls! The ark "Mobile Oceanic City GFM Oceanus" is inhabited only by big-breasted beauties in swimsuits. The visitor, Neptes, must fight against the [Creatures of the Abyss] who threaten them and uncover the mystery of the [Great Abyssal Goddess].Prepare for stronger enemies with each wave by selecting cards and upgrading your characters.Selected cards include passive skills, active skills, parameter level-ups, and heroine upgrades. There are over 60 types of cards!Each stage features unique mechanics, chance events that can turn the tide of battle, recovery events, and shops. You can also sometimes specify the three attributes of enemies, adapting to your build for an advantage.The ExArts, which heroines can use at regular intervals, are spectacular! Detailed Description: Feature ListPlay solo or with up to 8 players in online co-op on player-hosted worlds.Explore a massive, procedurally generated open world.Discover randomly generated dungeons and caves located throughout the world.Choose from multiple fantasy RPG classes such as Cleric, Colossus, Executioner, Paladin, Pyromancer, and more.Experience a deep and engaging character-gearing system with attributes (strength, dexterity, intelligence, constitution, spirit) and stats (such as critical strike chance, health regeneration, chance to apply ailments, poise, and over 60 more).Enjoy classic isometric ARPG combat featuring a dual-resource system with stamina and mana, along with additional combat mechanics such as active blocking and sprinting.Encounter a variety of hostile creatures with both creature-specific and world loot table drops, providing an engaging item-crafting experience.Engage in epic boss battles accompanied by themed orchestral soundtracks.Relax with non-combat RPG activities such as fishing, mining, blacksmithing, cooking, and more.Discover villages to gain access to various gameplay features, such as item-crafting and storage.Choose between WASD movement or the traditional click-to-move, depending on your preference.About the GameTaigania combines traditional isometric action RPG mechanics, inspired by previous titles such as Diablo and Path of Exile, with co-operative, procedurally generated open-world exploration reminiscent of games like Valheim and Minecraft. Choose your class, slay creatures, gather loot, craft items, discover villages, and explore a massive open world with 1-8 players online co-op in this isometric action RPG fantasy adventure. EXPLORATION  Explore a massive procedurally generated open world. Discover caves and dungeons, filled with dangerous creatures, gatherable resources, epic boss battles, and loot. You can choose between WASD movement or the traditional click-to-move, depending on your preference.COMBAT  Experience classic isometric action RPG combat with a variety of abilities to strike your enemies or aid your allies. Taigania aims to provide player combat synergies in co-op, enabling a rewarding multiplayer experience. Each class has access to a dual-resource system, where abilities consume either stamina or mana. Furthermore, combat mechanics such as active blocking and sprinting consume stamina.    VILLAGES Villages are located throughout the open world and serve as your base of operations for adventures, granting access to various gameplay features, such as item-crafting and storage.BOSS BATTLES Engage in epic boss battles, accompanied by themed orchestral soundtracks, to acquire special crafting patterns, materials, equipments, skill gems, and other loot to further empower your character. CHARACTER BUILD CUSTOMIZATION  Every class has access to various abilities, of which 5 can be simultaneously slotted to the skill bar.Abilities scale from attributes (strength, dexterity, intelligence, constitution, spirit). Most abilities have various effects that scale from different attributes.Every piece of armor grants attributes. Craft and equip armor pieces that grant attributes that suit your playstyle.Armor pieces may also grant stats (such as critical strike chance, health regeneration, and over 60 more). Higher rarity armor pieces grant more stats. Craft and equip armor pieces that grant stats that complement your playstyle.Gather skill gems, which can be slotted into abilities to alter their properties (such as reduced cooldown, increased damage with increased cooldown, conversion of an offensive spell into a healing spell, and many more). Skill gems come in different tiers of rarity, and the total number of slotted skill gems per ability is limited. Gain access to an arsenal of Masteries, which alter the playstyle of your character. Only one mastery can be active at a given time. For example:1) Using a strike skill increases the damage of your next slam skill by 10%, stacking up to 3 times. Using a slam skill empowers your next strike skill to regenerate 10 additional stamina, stacking up to 3 times.2) Gain 40% more health regeneration from all sources. This effect is doubled when below 35% health. Applying a hard crowd-control effect on an enemy grants X health regeneration for 12 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. 3) Using an ability increases your size and area of effect by 8%, stacking up to 5 times. At 5 stacks, your next ability deals 70% more damage, consuming all stacks.

Detailed Description: After Midnight is an open-world, online multiplayer ghost hunting game that plunges you into a vast and eerie world filled with haunted locations waiting to be discovered. Whether you're braving the darkness alone or teaming up with friends, your mission is to explore this chilling world, uncover its secrets, and identify the terrifying entities lurking within.During early access, there will be frequent discounts on the game. Once it is fully released, discounts will be less common. Additionally, the game will see more gameplay mechanics, maps, items, VR support, and controller features integrated. After Midnight is expected to be fully released by the end of 2024 or early 2025. Players can join the Discord to communicate directly with the developers and suggest features or mechanics for future updates. This is a pre-release version, and while we expect bugs and crashes, they are being addressed weekly. Purchasing early access grants you all future updates for free, and the game is not pay-to-win.We are a strong small team that looks forward to revolutionizing the ghost hunting genre of games.Travel freely across a variety of haunted environments, from abandoned asylums to cursed houses, each location unlocked as you delve deeper into the mystery. Use your wits, specialized tools, and teamwork to gather evidence and uncover the truth behind each haunting. Will you unravel the mystery and survive the night, or will the unknown forces claim you as their next victim?Key Features:Open World Exploration: Navigate a vast, interconnected world filled with haunted locations to discover and unlock as you progress.Co-op Multiplayer: Team up with friends in a four-player cooperative experience, or take on the spirits solo if you dare.Immersive Horror: Feel the tension build with every creaking floorboard and whispered voice as you navigate terrifying environments.Detective Gameplay: Use tools like EMF readers, spirit boxes, and thermal cameras to gather evidence and identify the entity haunting each location.Dynamic AI: Encounter unpredictable spirits with different behaviors and abilities, making each investigation a unique experience.Replayability: Procedurally generated hauntings and randomized objectives ensure that no two investigations are ever the same. Prepare yourself for the ultimate ghost-hunting adventure in After Midnight. Will you uncover the truth, or will you become another lost soul in the darkness?

Detailed Description: About Rise of ElementsIn Rise of Elements, you will play as one of the Champions of Aetheron, tasked with restoring balance to a cosmos disrupted by the mysterious Void. Armed with your Champion’s unique abilities, harness the powers of air, earth, fire, water, and void to engage in strategic battles across the realm. Gather elemental shards to fuel your Champion’s power, and realize your full potential by achieving elemental combat mastery. Emerge victorious in Argos’s Tournament of Champions to restore balance to the world of Aetheron and triumph over the Void’s untethered chaos.Tactical Match-3 CombatUse match effect gemstones to unleash powerful elemental attacks on your opponent. Rise of Elements follows a Match-3 gameplay structure, with each gem representing an element: Air, Earth, Fire, Water, and Void. Each element possesses unique attributes that trigger effects when like elements are matched. Match three or more gems of the same element to charge your Champion's abilities. Matching 4 or more gems creates special gems that change the way you play, like bombs, amplifier gems and power gems. Out-Match your rivals and achieve victory in head-to-head combat!Play Casually or Competitively with Different Game ModesTake your time in Moves Mode, or engage in a hardcore test of skill in Timed Mode, a fast-paced, more competitive take on the core Rise of Elements experience. With multiple ways to play, choose the Mode that best suits your needs and skill level!Choose Your Champion Select one of the Champions of Aetheron and take on opponents in one-on-one battles, harnessing their unique elemental abilities and skill sets. Each Champion has their own style, story, and motivations to master and discover!Discover the Story of AetheronImmerse yourself in the epic world of Aetheron, where elemental power reigns supreme.  Uncover the secrets of Aetheron, its Champions, and even Argos himself in exciting PvE narrative adventures.Are you ready to fight for Aetheron? Emerge victorious from Argos’s Tournament, and seize your destiny as the reigning Champion of the Elements!

Detailed Description: Introduction to the game "Arcane Chaos"Welcome to "Arcane Chaos", a unique game that combines top-down 3D shooting and role-playing elements! In this fantasy world, you will become a cute robot hero and embark on an endless adventure.Core gameplay:In "Arcane Chaos", your task is to defeat waves of enemies, from cute little mushrooms to ferocious demons, each enemy has a unique appearance and attack mode. By killing monsters, you can gain experience points and gold coins to upgrade and learn new skills. There are currently about 15 unique skills designed in the game for selection. In each game, you can randomly select three of them to match and create your own fighting style. As the level increases, these skills will continue to evolve and become more powerful and cool.Visual and sound effects:This game uses a unique artistic expression method-combining the scene setting under the realistic background with the imaginative character design. Whether it is the delicate and realistic environmental details or the carefully drawn monster images, it will bring a visual feast to the players. In addition, each skill is equipped with stunning special effects animations, such as flames falling from the sky, ice crystals attack, etc., so that every spell casting can become the most dazzling existence on the battlefield.Single-player challenge:Although "Arcane Chaos" mainly supports single-player mode, it can still provide rich entertainment and exciting challenges. When facing groups of enemies, the refreshing feeling of "mowing the grass" will definitely make you love it!Suitable for people:Whether you are a player who likes a relaxed and casual experience or a core player who pursues high-difficulty challenges, "Arcane Chaos" can meet your needs. The game rhythm in the early stage is relatively gentle, suitable for everyone to get started; in the later stage, players need to show more sophisticated operating skills to cope with the increasing difficulty.Does it contain adult content:This game contains effects of gun shooting and blood splashing when monsters are hit, but other than that, it does not contain any other adult content such as violence or pornography.Are you ready for this unprecedented adventure? Join "Arcane Chaos" and start a legendary journey that belongs to you!

Detailed Description: Arabella Harlow is a governess seeking new employment in the city of Second London one Halloween season.  Her paths cross with an eccentric alchemist-inventor, who introduces her to his myriad of creations.  One particular automaton is Jack, a humanoid construct with ruby-red eyes and intellect on par with a human's.  But Jack cannot speak - not verbally.  So Arabella is hired on to teach him how to communicate through alternate methods.As they grow in their relationship - are they colleagues?  are they comrades?  are they confidantes?  Arabella herself is not quite sure. - a series of tragic, dramatic events culminate in a murder.  Secrets lurk in the city of Second London...secrets that may put Arabella's life in danger...A Victorian-inspired fantasy visual novel from the creator of Clash: Robot DetectivePlay as Arabella Harlow in this robo-otomeBuild your relationship with Jack - be distant, be friendly, or even become emotionally attachedMystery and horror elements fit in with the gloomy Halloween seasonSketchy sprites against dark backgrounds create an interesting appearanceDEVELOPER'S NOTE: this visual novel was made in a month for a competitive game jam.  It is not what one would call the most polished experience and it is most likely not going to receive any updates.  I am focusing my efforts on fulfilling a childhood dream by expanding this basic story into a fantasy novel.  By purchasing this visual novel, you will be helping me by supporting my efforts to write and publish a full-length book!  And so, thanks in advance!

Detailed Description: In Find This Pixel Anomaly your task involves monitoring real-time surveillance camera feeds. Identify any irregularities within the monitored areas. These anomalies can vary from missing furniture to cute visitors.Found an anomaly? File a report and hope it will get fixed in time. Otherwise you will get in trouble, because too many anomalies will end the game.EXTRA OBJECTWait, was this chair here before? Who put it there? Well, it doesn't matter because you should hurry up and file a report. These added items can blend in surprisingly well, so stay sharp.INTRUDERThey may look cute, but these creatures are up to no good. Each playthrough is a fresh challenge. Can you make it through the night without missing a thing?

Detailed Description: It's a grand search game where you walk around the vast and mysterious world of stars, as if you were in a dream, collecting numerous tools, musical instruments, important items, natural objects such as minerals, fossils, and shells, and listening to the stories of the inhabitants of the stars while searching for something you've lost.The story has philosophical and spiritual elements.The landscapes of the stars are diverse, and there are nearly 1,000 maps to walk around.There are more than 200 background music songs and more than 200 sound effects made up of various musical instruments and natural sounds.In addition to wandering around looking for things, on one planet,you search for and photograph more than 2,000 species of creatures living in the natural environment(all using real-world photos of animals and plants),on another planet, you deliver many works of art such as paintings and ceramics to museums(all using photos of real artworks),on another planet, you walk through a mysterious world while listening to natural science explanations about the real world, ecosystems, and creatures.In addition to the objective of finding things, there are many other addictive aspects to the game, such as capturing a wide variety of strangely shaped aquatic creatures that live underwater, reading real literary works such as poems and novels, cultivating pearls, and cutting gemstones. There is no combat. The game has been in production for over 10 years.

Detailed Description: Club House on Haunted Hill is a story-driven, adventure golf game that blends golf and narrative in the style of a 1960s horror movie. As you play the story you navigate through the haunted lands of the Island of Gallows Neck, each course telling a piece of the overall story.In addition to the campaign you will be able to play against friends locally or online on various haunted golf courses. Each hole offers an adventure filled with supernatural elements and horrifying hazards enhancing the challenge. Distribute points in Muscle, Cunning, Control, Mercy, and Sanity to create the perfect golfer tailored to your play style. You can max out muscle to have the longest drive, or put points in sanity to withstand the psychological terror of golf.   Cunning enhances your ability to judge distances and predict ball landings. With a sharp cunning of the game you'll be able to anticipate the ball's trajectory and make strategic decisions to outmaneuver your opponents.   Mercy increases good hit chances, even with off-target hits. Giving you a better chance of landing successful shots, even when your timing isn't perfect.   Sanity improves ball spin and loft control. By mastering this attribute, you can execute complex shots with precision, allowing you to navigate obstacles and fine-tune the ball’s spin.   Muscle determines how hard you will hit the ball and how far it will travel. This attribute gives you an edge on long fairways and challenging your competitors with powerful shots.

Detailed Description: Ever dreamed of being the lowest of the low, living a life so nasty and gnarly, even the rats look down on you? Well, in Pit of Goblin, that’s your everyday! Slap on your stinkiest boots and dive into crumbling crypts, ghastly caverns and ghost-infested ruins, every step is fraught with peril and surprises!Your purpose is feeding the Goblin King’s bottomless gut. The best part? You can drag your goblin buddies along for the misery!Join forces with up to 3 other goblin buddies. Teamwork is key... unless, of course, you are the kind of goblin that prefers causing trouble! Will you stick together, or sneak off and get into mischief? Either way, it’s gonna be gobliny chaosEvery crawl through the pit is a brand-new goblin tale, whether you're dodging deadly traps or tripping over your own oversized feet. No two runs smell the same!The deeper you go, the tougher the challenge becomes. And don't forget, you have to find your way back out... if you want to live to see another day.Scavenge for food and decide whether to hand over your spoils to the Goblin King, chow it down yourself to gain stamina or sell some off at the shop to prepare for your next descent-but one wrong move could mean the end of your goblin life.You’ve been warned,The Goblin King’s belly is a bottomless pit, he’s always got room for more food... or goblins!You’ll stumble through dungeons so spooky, even your toenails will curl! Whether it’s spooky tombs, cursed corridors, or just plain goblin clumsiness, nothing in this pit goes smooth... or quiet. Every meal is an adventure. Will you hoard your loot to survive or play it safe and keep the king happy? The choice is yours. Every dive into the pit offers the chance to upgrade your gear, but beware, disappointing the Goblin King could be your downfall!Game Features2-4 player online co-operative playVoice chatDungeons, castles, crypts and other spooky locationsScary meanines trying to get you!A hungry King!Food and loot!Wooden torches to set fire to!Fire… and friendly fire

Detailed Description:
Bandeirantes invites the player to experience the life of one of the bandeirantes who explored Brazil in the 17th century.

The game takes place in the year 1650 and the player's objective is to organize and lead a Bandeira within the state of São Paulo and parts of Minas Gerais, Goiás, Mato Grosso do Sul and Paraná.

Buy carts, animals, food, water, tools, weapons and hire bandeirantes in 10 different classes to fulfill your objective: Expand the map of Brazil and find riches such as Gold, Silver, Precious Stones and other minerals.
Enemies include terrain, disease, animals, hostile indigenous people, and Spaniards who do not respect the Treaty of Tordesihas.

Game Mechanics includes Plantation, Work, Negotiation with Indigenous People, Hunting, Fishing, Village Construction, Karma for your Decisions, among others.

Come be a modern Girl Scout and show how you would do to be the best among them all.

Detailed Description: You are a replicant engineered by the Corporation for a single purpose: gather valuable bio-species from abandoned facilities across various planets. Alone or with up to three teammates, you'll land on planet surfaces to explore and locate facility entrances. Inside, navigate dark, procedurally generated networks of rooms and tunnels to collect small creatures you can carry—but beware of monsters that aim to end you. Stealth, strategy, and teamwork are essential to evade or confront these threats. With limited time on each planet, you must act swiftly to meet your KPIs. Use in-game radio communication to share information and coordinate actions to access restricted areas. Finally, uncover the unsettling truth behind your mission.

Detailed Description: ★ All Presidents are treated with the utmost respect in this game. There’s no blood or fatalities. (This isn’t MK!) All names and likenesses of Presidents and celebrities are used in a fictitious and parodic manner.The Ultimate Political Party-Crasher! Finally, the way the Founding Fathers intended political differences be settled: By whoever’s better at video games! (Why do you think Ben Franklin was in such a hurry to invent electricity?) Presidential Beatdown is a silly local/couch 2-D multiplayer fighting game in which super-soldier Presidents battle it out for political dominance.⚠️NOTE:  This game is an unfinished work in progress. The only available fighters are Trump, Obama, and Washington.  We’re releasing the game gradually to gauge interest and hopefully support development. Completion of any planned characters or features is not guaranteed. The only features as of yet are the bare-bones fighting game, the ability for each Profile and Prez to start leveling up Independently, and unlockable cosmetics using Coins, an in-game currency earned at each level-up. Right now only 3 Prez’s are available, from The BOSS Pack: Trump, Obama, and Washington. ★ Trump (Red Team #45): “We will make America great again!” The Patriot-King comes down hot and heavy with hard-hitting fisticuffs and a golden lance fashioned from Old Glory herself.★ Obama (Blue Team #44): “We are the change that we seek.” The Champion of Change uses all of the tools of his trusty Obamacare utility belt with ninja-like speed and skill to harm his opponents or heal himself.★ Washington (White Team #1): “One Nation under God.” The Father of America cannot tell a lie but he can kick your ass with his mighty battleaxe and throwing hatchets. Unleash devastating Executive Orders, like Trump’s U.S. Space Force Directed Energy Weapon, Obama’s Do Some Harm (& Some Healing) combo of damage and HP replenishment, and Washington’s Model-1776 Chainsaw. That’s some good wood ya got there! Do glorious battle in 100 iconic all-American locals such as atop Mount Rushmore, on the deck of a US Navy battleship, and even in the tight quarters of the revered Oval Office. What else do we have planned? Plenty! The Heart of a Nation Pack:★ Lincoln (Red Team #16): “Liberty and Justice for all.” The Great Emancipator and Unifier controls the full breadth of the battlefield with both axe and pistol.★ JFK (Blue Team #35): “My regards to the CIA.” The rascally ginger turns the national tragedy on its head by becoming a master marksmith, on the other side of the sniper rifle.★ Ben Franklin (White Team): “Behold..the power of electricity!” He may never have been a President (Betcha didn’t know that? See, this game is ejumacational too), but he was a Founder. The Father of Electricity wields electric gauntlets of his own devising to give his adversaries high-voltage electrocutions. The Bad-Boys Pack:★ Nixon (Red Team #37): “I am not a crook.” We love everything about this guy. It’s those amazing eyebrows, I tells ya. He wields nunchucks (we got the idea from the end of the movie ‘Black Dynamite’) with bulldog-like ferocity.★ Clinton (Blue Team #42): “I did not have [censored] [censored] with [censored].” Slick Willy uses his famous saxophone to leave a dent in the heads of playa-haytas everywhere.★ Andrew Jackson (White Team #7): All we know right now is that he’s on the twenty dollah bill and Mount Rushmore. But we’ll do more research, promise! Presidential Runner-ups:★ Reagan (R#40) ★ FDR (B#32) ★ Thomas Jefferson (W#3)★ Ulysses S. Grant (R#18) or Teddy Roosevelt (R#26) ★ Jimmy Carter? (B#39) ★ John Adams (W#2) 7 Guest Characters: Not just Presidents!★ Elon Musk: The richest man in history uses a jetpack and space-age technology to rock the battlefield with his own charismatic flare and infectious smile.★ Saint-Pope John Paul II: The iconic face of mankind’s biggest religion, his Holiness uses incantations of light to summon holy flame, thunder, and healing.★ St. Joan of Arc: (Did we really have to go this far back in time for a kickass female?) Look around these environments but make sure to focus on the little guy.

Game Name: The Throne of The Clock - remasterd
Detailed Description: OverviewThis game is a remastered version of "The Throne of the Clock," which was originally submitted to the 2024 Korean RPG Maker Game Competition, "1 Chicken RPG Maker Game Jam."StoryEnoch was once a knight but now lives quietly in a village where humans and demonic coexist.On his wedding day, he finds his beloved bride stabbed to death with his own sword. Remembering the words of the witch who gave him the sword, "You will have to pay the price," Enoch, filled with rage, rides off.He heads for the throne of the clock, where the witch, bound by fate, awaits.Features of the Game[Story Features]Choices made during the game define the protagonist's personality, both past and present. Through these choices and the final dialogue, you can experience over 10 different endings, each with subtle variations.These choices may be intuitive, like selecting dialogue, or they might come unexpectedly. Who were you, who are you now, and who do you wish to become? The Throne of the Clock is waiting for you![Gameplay Features]Combat is real-time field action, though it is not the main focus of the game. In fact, after the first hunt, you can complete the game without killing anyone.Puzzles are intuitive and designed not to interfere with story immersion.The playtime is about one hour, and if you read the dialogue aloud, about two hours, making it ideal for a single livestream session.Remastered ElementsThe old turn-based combat system has been replaced with real-time action combat.An "Omake" section has been added, including concept art, jokes, behind-the-scenes stories, and a teaser for the next project, featuring about 400 lines of dialogue. (and FBI may shout "open up!")In certain battles, options have been added that allow you to affect the ending positively without giving up on the fight.Several scenes have been enhanced, added, or adjusted. (For example, the amount of pixel art for the female protagonist has nearly doubled.)Backgrounds, lighting, and weather effects have been enhanced, added, or adjusted.Some puzzle mechanics have been made more intuitive.The default font has been replaced with a more elegant one.In addition to Korean, the game now supports both Japanese and English.Various bugs have been fixed. (If you find any, please let us know via the community.)
Short Description: Enoch, sneaks into the bride's waiting room on their wedding day. He wanted to catch a glimpse of her But the she was found dead, stabbed by his sword. That sword was a gift from the Clock Witch, with the words, "You will have to pay." Enoch starts riding, towards the throne where the witch awaits.

Detailed Description: Handsome and Brave is a story about a World in turmoil and a Knight that can't save it. But he's not alone, he has you. As a Watcher you can pickup, move, and most importantly throw the ragdoll Knight. Together you'll embark on an epic adventure to vanquish the evil Wizard and restore Law to the World.Solving PuzzlesThe Knight's uniquely resistant body and can-do attitude make him the perfect tool for any occasion. Some of his uses are:Breaking RocksOpening LocksBaking BreadTurning CranksSwitching SwitchesFarming ProduceVanquishing villainsProducing lasting pieces of artAnd much more!It's up to you to utilize his ragdoll body to explore this beautiful broken World at your own pace and solve the clever puzzles left by the dastardly people that broke it.Helping PeopleAlong the way you'll meet an ambitious Director, distraught Villagers, and misguided gods. All of them have a story to tell and problems to fix.Travel the WorldIn order to save the World you'll have to travel from the highest peaks to the depths of the Underworld. There is no shortage of dangers to face and old secrets to uncover.

Detailed Description: Join with up to 100 other players in this massive team battle arena game where individual skill, squad tactics, and overall teamwork will determine the victor!From the makers of the Bloons series comes a brand new IP and brand new game genre - the massive team battle arena game. Mysterious cosmic forces have created the Fightland, and they’ve plucked warriors from across space and time to do battle there. Split into 4 teams of up to 25 players each, each team has enough players to conquer objectives, defend their positions, attack other factions, and scout for loot - it’s how well each team will coordinate and react that determines the winner.Featuring 3 main hero classes, a range of primary and secondary weapons, outfits that enable both play style and visual style, discoverable Battle Assets that can change the tide of battle, and 3 varied game modes, each game is a unique, exciting challenge.BUILD YOUR HEROGoing the Brute path gives you access to heavy-hitting weapons, slow but packing a wallop. With Rogue, you are fast on your feet, delivering quick, precision attacks. As a Mage, you can damage enemies at range, heal your allies, or join the fray directly.CHOOSE YOUR LOADOUTEach of the 3 Hero types has bespoke primary weapons, secondary items, and armored outfits, with tactical and visual reference from fantasy to steampunk to sci-fi. All weapons and items are designed to support certain playstyles, with the opportunity to create mix and match hybrids.MASTER YOUR WEAPONSWeapon progression is almost entirely lateral, so while you unlock new things, each weapon is awesome in its own right and is built to fit a variety of playstyles. But there is one key upgrade to every weapon - Weapon Mastery, where completing challenges with your favorite weapons will unleash their true potential and give them a stunning new look, too!COMING SOON To stay up to date with Fightland's development and Steam Playtests that we will host prior to launch, please follow and Wishlist!

Detailed Description: GameplayPlaytime: 15-30 minutesShards of the Mirrors is a story-driven puzzle game where the protagonist, trapped in a mirror world by chance, must find the scattered mirror shards around the house to escape. Explore and discover various endings as you solve the puzzles.Game StoryShards of the Mirrors begins after the protagonist returns home from their day. Quickly falling asleep, they are awakened by a loud noise. In the storage room, they discover a strange compass, and upon inspecting it, they feel someone behind them. Startled, they drop the compass and are suddenly pulled into the mirror world. What will the protagonist encounter in this mysterious place?Developer's NoteShards of the Mirrors was inspired by the concept of non-determinism, learned during a CSE355 class. While the game may not be highly polished, it's my first game, and I plan to fix bugs with frequent updates.Distribution:If you stream or share a video, I would appreciate it if you include the game's title or a Steam link in the description. It would be a great help to a solo developer. We are not responsible for any damages caused by unauthorized distribution of game videos.

Detailed Description: InterCorruption is an indie turn-based RPG where you must defend Molly (the main character) against corrupted enemies. Battles combine familiar elements (timed button-press attacks and dodge, items, spells, etc.) with new mechanics (corruption/debugging).You control Molly, an "NPC" living in a game that was abandoned back in the 90’s and that is now slowly decaying. She speaks directly to you and will need your help to find a way to stop the corruption from spreading. Throughout the adventure, you will be navigating between two worlds: the “normal world” and a scrapped build of the game known as the “Beta world". During battles, you can make Molly jump, duck, or block attacks (depending on the attack itself). Most of Molly’s attacks inflict more damage when timed correctly.You must keep Molly’s corruption meter low during battles, or the game will start to glitch and her stats will plummet. If the meter reaches 99%, it’s game over! You can fix errors and reduce her corruption, but that costs “memory points”.Corruption is inflicted on Molly if she gets hit by corrupted enemies or if she attacks them directly. If an enemy's corruption is too high, you would be better off debugging them.Debugging enemies takes the form of retro-inspired mini-games. Once in “debug mode” you must reduce the enemy’s corruption as much as possible before the timer expires or Molly’s corruption meter will start to increase rapidly! A unique and dynamic battle system. A highly interactive overworld where you can use items (bombs, tennis racket, etc.), lift objects, jump down ledges, and much more. Dungeons filled with puzzles, keys, switches, treasures, traps, and more. A multi-layered story with a lot of twists, intrigues, and mysteries. A main character that interacts with you and remembers your actions and choices. Multiple outcomes and dialogue variations that depend on your choices.An original soundtrack mostly inspired by 16-bit era video games. An optional CRT filter.

Detailed Description: Seeker's Alliance is a fast-paced Trading Card Game (TCG) where players choose Hero Units from one of three powerful Factions to build decks and embark on an epic adventure across a vast island. As they face off against other players and complete challenges posed by the island's Ruler, players must hunt down the 100 elusive Bounty Cards scattered across the land to become the island's next Ruler.Each with their own goals and desires, fighting by your side are Heroes from three different Factions, including: Van der Leck FamilyThe Van der Leck Family is a rising star in the Sea of Data. Members are impulsive, young, and ambitious, yet possess the cold ruthlessness and wisdom to see the big picture.House GalahadMembers of House Galahad are skilled hackers, relentless dreamers, and the fearless pioneers who first ventured into the new world.Mahdia AllianceMahdia Alliance is the guardian of ancient virtues, where blazing dragon flames accompany philosophers. It serves as the beacon that illuminates the path for all amidst the chaos of this new world.In Seeker's Alliance, players strategically deploy cards across three Zones: Attack, Speed, and Defense. Each card has its designated Zone, and outcomes in these Zones will determine the course of the game.Brute force isn’t the only path to victory. Heroes skilled in guerrilla tactics can seize an advantage by winning the Speed Zone, while slow, heavy units can establish a strong defense in the Defense Zone and use counter-attacks to devastate opponents. Of course, if you’d rather overwhelm your opponents with sheer power, you can prove once and for all that all strategies crumble when faced with absolute power.Each Hero in the game comes equipped with their unique ultimate skill, not only offering powerful, game-changing effects but also showcasing the Hero's charm with customized animations. Whether it's a cunning strategy to turn the tides or the strongest shield that stops all damage, these ults will be the key to your victory.■ True TCG: Collect cards and trade with your friends through the marketplace.■ Monthly Ladder: Build your deck, challenge top players on the ladder, and win exclusive rare cards available only for that month.■ Hero Arena: No deck-building required—select a Hero and their preset deck for a fair competition against other players.■ Boss Raids: Defeat bosses with unique abilities to earn powerful cards.■ The fate of the world Is in your hands: The outcomes of player battles will determine the fate of the three Factions, as well as which new cards will be released!

Detailed Description: INTERSTATE 35 is an evocative narrative game from Radiant Array which follows a young woman returning to her hometown in Texas after a nuclear disaster. Through lush, poetic writing, we follow her literal journey through the post-apocalypse on a scavenging mission, and retrace her figurative journey to see how she got here and where she might head next.Game OutlinePlayers click through text to both advance the current plot, and discover memories that they canare able to salvage in their inventory as keepsakes. Detailed Description: A brand new entry into the legendary Bitmap Brothers series! Venture into the grim future of 2138 where mega-corporations use Speedball to distract the downtrodden masses from their miserable lives.Once an underground sport reviled for its brutality, Speedball has risen to unprecedented heights of popularity and profitability.It is the only sport that allows two cybernetically augmented teams to go head-to-head at levels of speed and violence beyond human limitations, where any moment could be a player’s last.  BRUTALITYListen to the roar of the crowd and the crunch of broken bones as you engage in a brutal match-up with visceral takedowns.Sit back and watch as medbots drag your battered and beaten opponents out of the arena. It could be any player’s last match of Speedball! SPEEDWhether playing singleplayer, online, or against a friend in couch play, Speedball is fast-paced, explosive and unpredictable. You will need to master high-speed passing, coordination and shooting if you’re to climb to the top of the underground world of Speedball. STRATEGYSelect, position and organise your players based on their strengths, weaknesses and cybernetic augmentations. Will your team be known for all-out aggression, or will you develop a defensive powerhouse? Key features:Incredible fast-paced matches that are explosive and unpredictableFace off in a brutal, no-holds-barred futuresport featuring a wide range of teams and arenasTake advantage of arena specific obstacles and abilities to gain the upper hand against your opponentsArcade-style matches come together with sports management strategyOrganize a team that fits your playstyle based on their individual traits and talents Hone your skills against the AI and then compete online or against a friend locally Speedball is the continuation of the iconic Bitmap Brothers series, first released in 1988.

Detailed Description: About GameWhile on a mission with fellow agent A, Agent G is drawn into a strange phenomenon and loses consciousness. When G regains awareness and looks around, they find themselves in an unfamiliar, abnormal world, with their companion missing. Stranger City is an otherworldly realm filled with bizarre phenomena and monsters. Now, as Agent G, you must search for your lost partner and find a way back to your original world. Explore the strange stages of Stranger City, survive the threats posed by monsters, and make your escape!Strange City ExplorationStranger City is a side-scrolling single-player game. Players take on the role of Agent G and explore Stranger City, a bizarre world unlike the real one. Traverse through five chapters—Hospital, Orphanage, Slaughterhouse, Underground City, and Temple of the Evil God—as you search for an escape route.Various PuzzlesEach chapter consists of multiple rooms. Solve a variety of puzzles in spaces where the threat of monsters lurks, and make your escape. If you fail to solve the puzzles, you’ll soon find yourself standing at the doorstep of death.Threatening MonstersIn each chapter, monsters are waiting to threaten Agent G. Keep moving forward while avoiding the monsters' pursuit.Powerful Boss MonstersBoss monsters are formidable beings that players cannot defeat. Avoid their attacks in various ways, and escape to a different area out of the boss's sight.Warning: Photosensitivity Seizure Warning - Please read this notice before playing.A small number of people may experience seizures when exposed to flashing lights or visual patterns found in video games. Even individuals without a history of seizures or epilepsy may experience a condition known as "photosensitive epilepsy" when playing video games.

Detailed Description: Gravity Survivors throws you into an intense battlefield inside a massive cube, where each wall has its own theme. You’ll face enemies like medieval knights, futuristic robots, and cosmic creatures, and the action never stops as waves of enemies keep coming from all sides.Auto Firing WeaponsYour weapons fire automatically so you can focus on movement and loot. As you progress and survive longer, you'll unlock upgrades that boost your abilities, making each run unique and fun!  Combining Survivors with PhysicsIn Gravity Survivors you have to worry about explosions pushing enemies, where your black holes will throw them, and how your attacks will affect your own movement. By adding physics into the mix, Gravity Survivors offers a unique experience that leads to crazy situations and a lot of fun!Roguelike Progression SystemWith a roguelike progression system, no two runs are the same. Defeat enemies to earn upgrades and adapt to the cube’s ever-changing challenges. Waves of enemies become increasingly difficult, and gravity keeps shifting, adding complexity and excitement to every moment.Gameplay LoopIn Gravity Survivors, you go into each round and spawn into a massive cube, with each wall being a random map that you can explore to get rewards and fight different enemies. You collect guns through the shop at the end of each round. Once you defeat the floor's boss and get the shop, you can change the gravity in the cube and go into the next round. Keep doing this to unlock insane weapons like a black hole gun, time-freezing wand, and many more!Do you have what it takes to survive the relentless chaos of Gravity Survivors?

Detailed Description: There are many activities waiting for you in the Revived House.Development.Thanks to the detailed leveling system, you will be able to develop your skills in absolutely any field. The rules of the Revived House world are very close to real life, which makes this simulator as thoughtful as possible down to the most subtle details. During the game you will get to know not only the city and the natural areas around, but also the locals. Each character has his own character, life story and of course tasks for the main character. Interacting with the residents, you will gradually learn the traditions and culture of the town, the specifics of the internal problems and needs of the residents. By helping residents solve their problems, you are helping the city to become a better place. City. There will be plenty to do in a small old town. Visit the beach in the northeast and collect a collection of shells for a local souvenir shop. Go fishing or swim in the local lake. Go hiking in the mountains in the southwest. Help the farmers to sow crops in the fields and raise cattle on the southeastern outskirts of the city. Many administrative buildings require your support and attention.Characters.Each non-player character has his own place of residence, occupation, adaptive daily routine, behavior and history of the past.Craft.You will have to master various skills, thanks to which you will be able to help residents and the city: gardening, animal husbandry, construction, cleaning and much more.Interests.You will also have a lot of free time to find a hobby to your liking: play street football, arrange a bike ride, learn how to do tricks on a skateboard or scooter, take photos or videos, swim in the lake or dive with a mask, collect rare monster cards, repair an old bike to participate in a motorcycle race and much more.Holidays.The town is located in a climatic zone where the weather has four distinct seasons. Various holidays will be waiting for you in any weather."Revived House" is a game that you want to live in.

Detailed Description: LEVEL37 is an exploration game. The protagonist takes the elevator and accidentally enters LEVEL 37.The main thing about LEVEL 37 is to look around and listen to the sounds. It has nothing to do with winning or losing. You can say that this is like an art gallery, walk around and feel the atmosphere. There are no monsters chasing you or suddenly jumping at you in the game. There are very few things to solve, almost just a few mazes. Sometimes the game will challenge your navigation skills. But most of the time you are just exploring.Note: The game may be depressing. LEVEL 37 exploits people's fear of getting lost, dark and small spaces.There is no loud background music in this game. Instead, the game uses sound to make you feel immersive. The sound and echo will change depending on the room you are in. Walking in water slows you down. All of this makes the game feel more real and creates a tense atmosphere.There is no absolute story, no characters to meet, but through exploration you can probably imagine what it was like to be here before. As you explore further and advance, you begin to notice that the game world around you changes, as if these places have appeared in your dreams, and each place has its own mystery.

Detailed Description: Explore the eerie emptiness of the Backrooms in this atmospheric walking simulator.Immerse yourself in the unsettling calm of endless yellow corridors. Armed with only a VHS camera, wander through liminal spaces untouched by entities. Lose yourself in the maze-like architecture as you delve deeper into the mysterious depths of the Backrooms. Your journey through this surreal, abandoned realm will challenge your perception of reality and space.Experience the haunting solitude of the Backrooms and document your journey with an authentic VHS camera aesthetics. Immerse yourself in a tense, entity-free environment where the absence of threat becomes a threat itself. With multiple paths and areas to explore, each more unsettling than the last, you'll find yourself questioning the nature of reality and space. Are you brave enough to face the vast emptiness of the Backrooms, where the absence of threat becomes a threat itself?

Game Name: The Gods of the Red Planet
Detailed Description: The Gods of the Red Planet is an immersive sci-fi text adventure where every choice you make shapes the story. As the leader of a special task force, you are sent to investigate strange and mysterious events at the Mars Terraforming Center after contact with it is suddenly lost and the first team sent to investigate has disappeared without a trace.Step into the dark and chaotic atmosphere of the research center, where madness and disaster reign. Explore the abandoned offices and gather vital clues from your team: photos, reports, classified documents, voice recordings, and personal diaries. Piece together the horrifying events that started with a groundbreaking scientific discovery… and uncover what Mars has hidden for thousands of years.As the head of the investigation, you’ll make tough decisions and give orders to your team —but can you trust them? Some may have secrets, hidden agendas, or motives of their own. And is your management really as trustworthy as it seems? You’ll need to not only unravel the mysteries of the Terraforming Center but also manage internal conflicts within your team, all while an unknown force from the depths of Mars hunts down anyone brave enough to stand in its way.Each of your decisions leaves a lasting mark, directly affecting the mission’s outcome. Can you keep your team alive in the battle for humanity's future? Will you remain the mission leader as the truth grows darker and the cost of honesty rises? Can you save the Mars colonies — and with them, all of humanity? Your team awaits your command. Are you ready to take on the challenge?Features:Interactive Storyline: Every choice you make shapes the events and the ultimate outcome of the mission. With over 10 unique endings, each final will reflect the impact of your decisions.Team Dynamics: Navigate internal conflicts, make difficult choices, and choose sides. Protect your team’s interests and defend the investigation against management, but be prepared for the consequences of your actions.Gather Clues: Receive crucial evidence from your team—photos, reports, classified documents, personal diaries, and more. Use these to piece together the full story of what happened at the Terraforming Center.Tense Atmosphere: Immerse yourself in the dark, ominous atmosphere of a massive research center, where every step could lead to catastrophe. Strange anomalies, threatening signals, and silent corridors will keep you on edge, surrounded by constant danger.

Detailed Description: Through the Stars is an engaging blend of deck-building roguelike and turn-based tactics, where you lead a small space fleet to break through enemy lines and save your planet's population. The planet's defense is on the brink of collapse, and only you can change the course of events.Every decision you make matters. Explore a minimalist cosmos where the global adventure map is randomly generated, creating unique challenges at every turn. Collect cards representing abilities and upgrades for your ships that you can use in battle. Develop your deck by earning new cards as rewards for victories or purchasing them in the shop.The combat system consists of two phases: first, you select a ship and move it, and then you play cards that determine your ship's actions. Tactical challenges require careful planning, and the ability to utilize the environment on the map adds depth to strategic thinking.Fight against a variety of enemies, from regular foes to powerful bosses, each requiring a unique approach. Experience satisfaction from finding unconventional moves and solving tactical puzzles as you fight for your planet's salvation.Join the adventure in Through the Stars and become the last hope of the galaxy!

Detailed Description: Space Corps is still in development and plans may change between now and release. Space Corps is a digital collectible card game where players take command of a capital ship in combat against another capital ship. Launch fighters, bombers, officers and execute battle strategies by playing the cards in your hand. The game ends when one player has destroyed the opponent's capital ship.   Space Corps will offer a free to play set of cards for all players (Grey). Players can try out the game by using their free to play deck against other player's free to play deck. Free to play decks will not be allow to play against premium decks, but paid players will still be able to use a free to play deck to play with a friend that has not yet purchased a premium deck slot. A premium deck slot is included with each starter card pack purchased, which include enough cards one color set (Red, Blue, Orange, Green) to create a deck. Players can also purchase booster packs of cards, which include all color sets, to add to their card collection and further customize their deck. Premium decks play in the matchmaking queue that keeps track of stats and may include rewards for completing matches as well as periodic leagues. The free to play matchmaking queue is intended as a game demo and will not keep track of stats.The first game mode available will be 1v1 player vs player. After that, a player vs computer mode will be developed. After release of these first two game modes, a 2v2 player team game mode and a 3 player cutthroat game mode will begin development. A single player campaign mode is also a possibility.

Detailed Description: Project ARC is a team-based 5v5 PvP-focused top-down shooting game.Fast-Paced Military Gun ActionProject ARC delivers a realistic and fast-paced top-down shooting experience inspired by PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS. Weapons such as assault rifles, submachine guns, shotguns, long-range weapons like sniper rifles and DMR, pistols, grenade launchers, and more, each come with their own characteristics and feel.Experience skill-based, thrilling and realistic gunfights in a top-down shooter like never before.Combat Centered Around the CryptEnjoy the widely-known bomb mission rules, featured in various games, in top-down view with Project ARC.Your team's mission is to hack into the hidden Crypt within the building by installing a Decrypter. Use grenade launchers and explosive hammers to break through walls and defenses to reach the Crypt or ambush the enemy.Or you can be the defending team blocking the enemies from reaching the Crypt and installing the Decrypter by blocking doors, setting up barricades to bar access.When the Decrypter is activated, the crypt will change from blue to red, signaling that it has been hacked. The Crypt is used to control the Blue Chip. What could happen if it gets compromised?Deep CQB Cooperative TacticsIn modern warfare, indoor gunfights, or CQB (Close-quarters Battle), are based on disrupting the enemy’s line of sight, securing your view quickly, and attacking before the enemy notices you.Project ARC presents real-time line of sight shared with your teammates, which creates immediate, non-verbal cooperation, allowing you to experience fast-paced CQB combat with your teammates in real-time against actual players.Unique Characters and Specialized GadgetsThe characters in Project ARC each have their preferred weapons and distinctive gadgets.You will see familiar weapons such as the Mk14, AWM, and P90, and a variety of unique gadgets like Blue Zone grenades, recon drones, grenade launchers, and proximity explosives. And of course, staple throwable items like flashbangs and smoke grenades make an appearance.

Detailed Description: Upgrade chef skill to unlock the dessert recipesThe player is going to help the shiba grow up from newbies to a professional chef. As the raise of skill rate, the shiba could unlock more and more various dessert recipes. Those lovely shiba shaped desserts will satisfy the taste buds and eyes for the customers. And also warming up their hearts.Busy preparing ingredients and enjoy the process of making desserts Knead the glutinous rice flour into a dough, drop it into boiling water, and once it floats, scoop it out and let it cool. Carefully drizzle with a special secret sugar-soy sauce... Ta-da! The fragrant Shiba Riceball is ready to shine. What other cute desserts will you make with your furry paws to sell today?Every second matters! Pack dessert bento for your lovely customers The only reason that various customers are in the long queue is that they can’t wait to taste your delicious handmade dessert. In a limited time, you’ll put the correct desserts into bento boxes and sell them. Their happy faces are your biggest motivation.Decorate the kitchen and shop by hardworking earning money  No matter in reality or in the game, money is so useful! The player needs to use money to buy the ingredients for desserts, different kitchen utensils, beautiful decorations for kitchen and shop etc. We even use it to buy lovely aprons for the shiba chef. Grandma loves you so much! What’s the experience of having a grandma who loves traveling so much? The grandma always remembers her favourite grandchild. She will send the player postcards during the traveling. Those fun and interesting postcards become our precious collection. The only thing I could say is that the love by grandma is invincible!
Short Description: Woof! You step into the paws of a novice Shiba chef who inherits a dessert shop from your retired grandma. You'll buy ingredients, bake desserts, and sell them in bento boxes. Use your earnings to upgrade the kitchen, decorate the shop, and unlock new recipes to create the best bakery ever!
