Detailed Description: There is only you, the chosen one who rules over the village. You have to find out what the strange notes are about, where do they come from and what do they want to tell you? Besides, with your actions you will strengthen or weaken your relationship with your inhabitants. Make tough decisions that will haunt you longer than you might think. Expand your village to accommodate more inhabitants and explore new things in the laboratory, be it weapons, buildings and much more. However, you'll have to stay alert, because you'll be haunted by insidious beasts that would love to destroy your village. So you must train your troops and lead them into battle!Build your villageWith the help of your mines, the ores extracted from there will be processed by your blacksmith and in combination with the wood of the forester, great things can be built, such as new habitable houses, attractions for the inhabitants or yet barracks and defensive guns. With the help of your laboratory you can improve your buildings and make them more robust or you can have new, better buildings researched, which you can then use in your village!SatisfactionIf you want to work your way forward, it is of great importance to take care of your villagers. You need to monitor their happiness, either the overall happiness of your village or the happiness of the individual citizens. If the villagers are in a bad mood, you need to get to the bottom of it and, if necessary, fix the problems that cause it using the Satisfaction menu or the information provided by the individual citizens. But if you neglect their feelings, you have to expect deterioration in your production and further problems!Day managementThe daily schedule of the villagers is determined by you alone. You can determine the schedule of each citizen: You can make them work longer hours to boost your production, give them more free time or alternatively let them decide what they want to do. However, you must never forget that your actions affect the mood of each citizen, and their moods add up to determine the satisfaction level of your village. So make sure that the inhabitants have nothing to complain about!Low Poly ArtstyleDive into the world of the unique Low Poly Artstyle and experience relaxed atmospheres in the morning or mysterious mood in the evening. The interplay between the cartoon-like animations and the beautiful low poly look creates beautiful moments. The music, reminiscent of No Mans Sky in places, creates a great ambience with its style that always fits the situation.Combat and defense*Upgrade your town with barracks and guns to defend against the invaders! Upgrade your barracks to get better and stronger troops. Decide which strategy you want to follow, fight with weaker but more troops or less but stronger? And better to finish everything in close combat or to finish the enemy from a distance? Or both? You decide and lead your warriors into battle and decide still in battle which targets your troops should attack and how many of your soldiers should pursue this target!Story*Find out what the strange notes are all about! Make tough decisions and try to understand what this village is all about!*These features are currently planned but not yet implemented

Detailed Description: Heads up: the ToneStone beta is open and we’d love for you to join! Just click the green “Request Access” button on this page to join instantly. Here’s the deal: ToneStone is a platform for casual music making. Founded by the product lead behind Guitar Hero and Rock Band, ToneStone combines gameplay mechanics with easy-to-use creative tools and free sounds — transforming music production into fun, interactive experiences. You don’t need to know anything about music to get started — just jump into ToneStone to access experiences, tools, and sounds that help you create music quickly and easily.ANYONE AND EVERYONE CAN MAKE MUSIC. INCLUDING YOU.Our mission is to empower a global community to create music. We believe musical creativity and collaboration should be open to everyone — even if you don’t want to learn complicated software or an instrument.TONESTONE RIGHT NOWRight now ToneStone Studio is in beta — but there’s still a lot you can do. You can make music, whether it’s just for fun, for a video or game, or for whatever else you feel like doing. With ToneStone you can:You can make music, whether it’s just for fun, for a project, or Create license-free music using our simple tools and sound decks.Spark your creative process through ToneStone Sessions experiences.Record yourself singing or playing instruments, with layering and overdubbing.Share your creations to the ToneStone Discord communityExport your creations to MP3 to share on other platforms.You can also:Grab songs from ToneStone’s Discord server to remix.Find fellow users to collaborate with via Discord.Make custom decks using 100s of our free samples.THIS IS ONLY THE BEGINNINGWe’ve got big plans. Like expanded sharing and collaboration capabilities, new progression and achievement experiences, not to mention potential modding opportunities in the future. We’ve barely begun to reveal the many ways in which ToneStone will deliver fun, immersive creative experiences.We’ll be releasing new features and content regularly, and we also know that our early community is going to drive our roadmap decisions. Which brings us to our next point…FEEDBACK IS VERY WELCOMERight now we think ToneStone is good, but we think it could be great. We learned a long time ago that the best ideas come from the community, and that’s exactly why we wanted to open up ToneStone to enthusiastic beta users who will be brutally honest about what you love and what needs to be better.Once you’ve started using ToneStone, please share your thoughts with us — we love it when folks share feedback to Discord, but we also like feedback surveys too.CREATED BY A PROVEN MUSIC GAME DEVELOPERToneStone is founded by Greg LoPiccolo, a longtime musician with over 20 years’ of experience in the video game industry.Greg’s journey with interactive music experiences began at Harmonix, where he led product development and oversaw major titles like Guitar Hero and Rock Band. Even though these games were hugely successful, Greg always believed there was even greater potential for music and gaming. Eventually, Greg started building ToneStone, based on the core belief that music and gaming could yield incredible creative outcomes. By combining music with gameplay, on the scale of a platform with endless UGC possibilities, ToneStone is designed to bring musical creativity to all of you who have music in you, and want a better way to express it.Greg and the team are ridiculously excited about the promise of ToneStone — try the beta and let us know what you think!

Detailed Description:
WingMan is set in a vibrant and nostalgic world inspired by the 1970s and 1980s nightlife. Players will journey through a variety of iconic cities and locations around the world, each with its unique atmosphere, music, and style. From the neon-lit streets of Toronto, Montreal, and New York City to the beachfront clubs of Negril, Jamaica. You just have to get past the bouncers and avoid the dreaded lineups.

Players assume the role of a charismatic and stylish protagonist who's on a mission to experience the world's hottest nightclubs. This character is a suave and well-dressed individual with a passion for the nightlife scene. The core mechanics of Wingman revolve around navigating the nightclub scene. Players must use their wit, charm, and style to impress bouncers and get past the velvet ropes. The game is a combination of strategy, decision-making, and quick reflexes.

The primary objective of the game is to gain access to exclusive nightclubs by impressing bouncers. Players will face various challenges, such as answering trivia questions, solving puzzles, or completing style-related tasks to prove their worthiness. The ultimate goal is to experience the best nightlife each city has to offer.

To elevate your nightclub experience, you'll have the opportunity to choose from three distinct wingmen: Maximo, Yunny, and Tbone. The initial objective is to unlock these wingmen, each of whom brings a set of unique skills to aid you in your nightclub conquest. These skills include charisma, puzzle-solving, and dancing expertise. As you travel from city to city and club to club, the choice of the right wingman becomes crucial to overcoming the varied challenges and impressing the bouncers.

In "WingMan," your mastery of the nightlife hinges on your ability to immerse yourself in a world of nostalgia, strategy, and style. With your trusted wingman by your side, you'll navigate a world of iconic cities, immerse yourself in the pulse-pounding music of the '70s and '80s, and rise to the top of the nightclub hierarchy, all while making unforgettable memories in the glamorous nightlife scene. Your choices and style will define your path to success in this retro adventure game.

Detailed Description: Aplestia:Retold unravels the story of Britton, Summer, Rover and Marina, four friends that went on their first S Class Quest by mistake! Even though they are still rookie adventurers, they will try their best to tackle on a difficult, gem-related and full of mystery adventure! Follow their steps as they travel on the colorful and gem-monster pested Aplestia island! They will have to find secrets, solve problems, defeat various enemies and complete quests!For the most part, this adventure will challenge your exploration prowess. Secret rooms, super secret rooms, ancient ruins and hidden places are all there, waiting to be discovered. Be ready to utilize a plethora of skills, spells and permanent stat boosts to maximize your strategy! Epic weapons, armors and rings, unlockable mini-dungeons that will test your wit and powers, shops, side quests and interactive objects and characters! All of that and more are waiting for you on Aplestia:Retold!Will Britton, Summer, Rover and Marina be able to help the people of the island? Will they put a stop to darkness’ plan? Aplestia:Retold is the remade version of the 2017 game Aplestia and answers all of that and even more. This remade version features double the content, more story, lore and information about the world, technical fixes and better versions of previous mechanics. In addition, many new quests, places to visit and a completely reworked soundtrack are waiting for you to explore them!True Fullscreen mode from the OptionsChoose Window Skins from the OptionsController/touch/keyboard/mouse supportFPS Synchronization option for newer monitorsChoose your difficulty optionQuick Combat!Colorful, full of gems areas6 secret rooms with a visual cue10 super secret rooms with little to no cluesEpic Weapons, Armors and RingsFun and unique characters to interact with26 side quests – trackable with a Quest LogVirtual Notepad for any note-takingSave your progress anywhere you wantVisible, non-respawning enemy encountersMini-bosses and optional Bosses to challenge your strategy28 adventurous music tracksOver 12 hours of gameplay, depending on the difficulty and exploration

Detailed Description:
Sometime in the near past, a kid gets an ominous television transmission.
He has intercepted a cryptic message - and the Deathchron arrives at his house.
He is transported to an alternate future world, where robotic mechs have taken over,
and he has one chance to save the world. A.R.T. - his own automated robot transporter is
here to help, but it's much more than that. A.R.T. can be upgraded to shoot various weapons!

So, take a nostalgic trip back to 1987 when games were hard and they didn't make sense.
Deathchron is an NES style game inspired by titles such as Blaster Master.

Features:
8 bit style NES artwork
Action Platforming
Upgrades for your mech
Various areas to explore
Bosses that will eat you alive
